jobs.title: Network infrastructure project coordinator
jobs.description:
Network Infrastructure Project Coordinator

**Job Summary**

Join our dynamic team as a Network Infrastructure Project Coordinator, where you will lead the planning, execution, and delivery of complex network infrastructure projects. This role is pivotal in ensuring seamless integration of enterprise IT solutions, optimizing network performance, and supporting organizational growth through innovative infrastructure initiatives. You will coordinate cross\-functional teams, manage project timelines, and communicate effectively with stakeholders to drive successful project outcomes. Your expertise in technical project management and IT infrastructure will empower us to maintain a resilient and scalable network environment.

**Duties**

* Lead end\-to\-end planning and execution of network infrastructure projects, including hardware, software, cloud computing solutions (such as AWS), and enterprise software implementations.
* Develop detailed project schedules using tools like Microsoft Project, Visio, TFS (Team Foundation Server), VersionOne, and Jira to track progress and ensure timely delivery.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams—including IT operations, software development, security, and vendor partners—to gather requirements and define project scope aligned with organizational goals.
* Manage project risks through proactive identification, analysis, and mitigation strategies in accordance with PMBOK (Project Management Body of Knowledge) standards.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT), test case creation, and validation processes to ensure deliverables meet quality standards before deployment.
* Facilitate Agile methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban for iterative development cycles while integrating Waterfall approaches when necessary for large\-scale implementations.
* Oversee project documentation including SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) artifacts, disaster recovery plans, release management schedules, and IT governance compliance reports.

**Skills**

* Extensive experience managing technical projects within enterprise environments utilizing project management methodologies like PMBOK and Agile frameworks such as Scrum and Kanban.
* Proficiency with project management tools including Microsoft Project, SharePoint, Visio, Jira, TFS, VersionOne, and Microsoft Office suite (Word, Excel).
* Strong knowledge of IT infrastructure components including networking hardware, cloud computing platforms (AWS), databases (SQL Server, Oracle), and enterprise software systems.
* Expertise in requirements gathering, analysis skills, risk management strategies, and stakeholder communication to ensure project alignment with business needs.
* Demonstrated leadership in technical project \& program management supervision with excellent organizational skills and time management abilities.
* Familiarity with SDLC processes for software development and implementation; experience with test\-driven development (TDD) and user acceptance testing procedures.
* Ability to coordinate multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high standards of quality; skilled in negotiation and team leadership to foster collaboration across diverse teams.
* Knowledge of IT governance principles including disaster recovery planning and compliance standards essential for enterprise solutions implementation.

Join us to be part of a forward\-thinking organization committed to technological excellence! Your expertise will help shape resilient networks that support our mission\-critical operations while advancing your career in a vibrant environment that values innovation and teamwork.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:** 

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Project Coordinator to support both project execution and customer account coordination. This role sits at the center of communication between customers, engineering, production, and sales, ensuring projects move smoothly from concept through delivery.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced environment, enjoys managing details, and is skilled at keeping multiple teams aligned. If you are someone who anticipates problems before they arise, communicates clearly, and takes pride in delivering exceptional customer experiences, this role is for you.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Project Coordination

* Attend project and design meetings with customers and internal teams; document key details and action items.
* Review project documentation and drawings to ensure accuracy and completeness.
* Coordinate across engineering, production, and logistics to keep projects on schedule.
* Track manufacturing timelines and project milestones to ensure timely delivery.
* Manage project documentation, approvals, and submittals.
* Monitor project scope and assist with change orders or contract updates when necessary.
* Maintain detailed records of project communications, approvals, and changes.
* Estimate and create scopes of work for new projects.
* Assist with updating actual cost data once production is complete.

Customer and Account Support

* Serve as a key point of contact for customer updates and project progress.
* Build strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Assist with preparing proposals, quotes, and project documentation.
* Maintain CRM data and ensure customer records are accurate and up to date.
* Support the sales team with project coordination and follow\-up activities.
* Help track sales pipeline activity and key performance metrics.

What Success Looks Like

* Projects delivered on time, within scope, and with strong customer satisfaction.
* Clear communication across customers, sales, engineering, and operations.
* Organized documentation that protects the company and ensures project clarity.
* Internal teams rely on you to keep projects moving forward.

Qualifications:

Required:

* Bachelor’s degree in business, project management, marketing, communications, or related field preferred.
* 1–3 years of experience in project coordination, sales support, customer service, or a similar role.
* Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and CRM or project management tools.
* A proactive, solutions\-focused mindset.

Pay: From $70,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* AD\&D insurance
* Dental insurance
* Disability insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Opportunities for advancement
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Can you read drawings?
* This position is NOT remote. Are you ok working in person everyday?
* Do you have manufacturing experience?

jobs.description:
**Project Coordinator – Projects \& Implementation**

**Company:** Kei Concepts  

**Location:** Orange County, CA  

**Job Type:** Full\-Time, Non\-Exempt  

**Compensation:** $31–$36 per hour, based on experience

**About the Role**


Kei Concepts is looking for a Project Coordinator – Projects \& Implementation to support company projects across new restaurant openings, post\-opening follow\-up, construction coordination, Field layout planning, equipment planning, Standard Operating Procedure rollouts, software launches, packaging projects, catering projects, and other cross\-department initiatives.


This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, detail\-oriented, proactive with follow\-up, and interested in growing into a stronger project leadership role. The Project Coordinator will help maintain project trackers, collect updates, prepare meeting notes, follow up on open items, and make sure project information is clearly documented and easy for the team to understand.


The right candidate should be comfortable working with restaurant Field teams, vendors, and internal departments. Restaurant operations experience is preferred, but we are open to training the right person who is organized, proactive, and willing to learn.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain Project Management boards and project trackers for assigned projects.
* Track open items, owners, due dates, next steps, pending decisions, and project risks.
* Follow up with internal departments, vendors, and Field teams.
* Support new restaurant opening and post\-opening project follow\-up.
* Help organize layout, equipment, construction, and Field feedback updates.
* Support communication between Field Operations Team, Concepts Development Team, Marketing, IT, Accounting, vendors, and leadership.
* Prepare meeting notes, project recaps, and action\-item lists.
* Support Standard Operating Procedure rollouts, software launches, packaging projects, catering projects, and other company initiatives.
* Collect files, quotes, invoices, photos, plans, vendor updates, and approval records for reference.
* Escalate delays, missing information, and decision\-needed items to leadership.
* Keep project communication clear, organized, and easy for others to follow.

**Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in project coordination, restaurant operations, administration, construction coordination, hospitality, or a related field.
* Strong organization and follow\-up skills.
* Clear written and verbal communication.
* Comfortable using project trackers, Monday.com, Teams, Excel, Google Drive, SharePoint, or similar tools.
* Ability to work with multiple departments and manage changing priorities.
* Restaurant, hospitality, construction, or operations experience preferred.
* Must be detail\-oriented, professional, and willing to learn.

**Ideal Candidate**


The ideal candidate is organized, reliable, and comfortable asking questions when something is unclear. This person should be strong with documentation, follow\-up, and communication. They should be able to work with Field managers and vendors while learning Kei’s project process, restaurant opening process, construction coordination, layout planning, Standard Operating Procedure rollout, and implementation structure.

**Work Schedule**


This is primarily an in\-office and Field\-support role based in Orange County, CA. The position requires regular in\-person collaboration with leadership, Field teams, vendors, and restaurant locations.


After training and based on business needs, performance, and project schedule, eligible team members may have the opportunity for limited work\-from\-home flexibility.

**Benefits \& Perks**


Kei Concepts offers a supportive and growth\-focused work environment with opportunities to be involved in new restaurant openings, brand development projects, and company\-wide initiatives.


Eligible team members will receive medical, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, employee dining discounts across Kei Concepts restaurants, and opportunities for career growth and internal promotion.


This role also provides hands\-on exposure to restaurant operations, construction coordination, project implementation, and cross\-department collaboration, with visibility to leadership and the opportunity to contribute to the growth of multiple restaurant brands.

**Grow Healthy**

If you are as passionate about helping those in need as you are about growing your career, consider AltaMed. At AltaMed, your passion for helping others isn’t just welcomed – it’s nurtured, celebrated, and promoted, allowing you to grow while making a meaningful difference. We don’t just serve our communities; we are an integral part of them. By raising the expectations of what a community clinic can deliver, we demonstrate our belief that quality care is for everyone. Our commitment to providing exceptional care, despite any challenges, goes beyond just a job; it’s a calling that drives us forward every day.


**Job Overview**

The Community Health Program Coordinator is responsible for identifying high\-risk patients with poor health outcomes. The role is responsible for program activities such as referral coordination, eligibility checks, and monitoring CHW caseloads. The role will also support data collection and analysis for overall program evaluation. Our organization offers an innovative, evidence\-based health care program that improves health outcomes for low\-income, high\-risk patients using Community Health Workers (CHWs). In this model, CHWs provide structured advocacy, social support, and navigation to high\-risk patients to help them reach their health goals.

**Job ID** REQ20173907 **Category** Administration
  
The University of Southern California (USC), founded in 1880, is located in the heart of downtown L.A. and is the largest private employer in the City of Los Angeles. As an employee of USC, you will be a part of a world\-class research university and a member of the “Trojan Family,” which is comprised of the faculty, students, and staff that make the university a great place to work.


The USC Dana and David Dornsife College of Letters, Arts and Sciences is seeking an **Academic Program Specialist** to work in Academic Innovation and Research Engagement (AIRE). The largest and oldest of the USC schools, USC Dornsife functions as the academic core of the university, offering courses and advancing knowledge across the humanities, social sciences, and natural sciences.


**Academic Innovation and Research Engagement (AIRE)** supports the operations of affiliated academic research centers and institutes across the humanities, social sciences, and life sciences. Through its innovative shared services model, AIRE provides comprehensive expertise in academic programming, financial administration, event planning, communications, business operations, and administrative services.


We are seeking an enthusiastic professional to join the AIRE team by providing administrative and operational support to AIRE's research centers and institutes. The Academic Program Specialist will partner with faculty, researchers, students, and staff to coordinate academic programming, research activities, events, communications, and the day\-to\-day operations of a portfolio of research centers and institutes. Through AIRE's collaborative service model, this position provides comprehensive administrative support to an assigned portfolio of research centers and institutes.

The Client Services \& Operations Coordinator plays an important role in creating an organized, responsive, and welcoming experience for both families and staff. The ideal candidate is highly organized, an excellent verbal and written communicator, comfortable working independently, and able to think creatively when helping families find scheduling solutions. This role works closely with approximately 15 part\-time instructors each day to communicate schedule changes, prepare the center for daily operations, and ensure instructors have the information and materials they need to successfully support students. The position will also provide administrative and onboarding support to the

their scheduled sessions.

Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.


For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.


Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.


We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet.

jobs.title: Clinical Implementation & Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Clinical Implementation \& Customer Success Manager**

About MedGEO

MedGEO is a healthcare technology company transforming how procedural care is documented, understood, and optimized at the point of care. Built by clinicians for clinicians, MedGEO combines intelligent automation, AI, and Smart Vision technology to reduce documentation burden, improve data accuracy, strengthen compliance, and provide healthcare organizations with greater visibility into the clinical, operational, and financial performance of procedural care.

Our technology works directly within operating rooms and procedural environments, helping nurses and clinicians spend less time on administrative tasks and more time focused on patients.

About the Role

MedGEO is seeking a highly motivated **Clinical Implementation \& Customer Success Manager** to lead customer onboarding, clinical implementation, training, go\-live support, adoption, and ongoing customer success for our healthcare technology platform.

This role requires a **nursing background**, with **operating room, perioperative, surgical services, or procedural\-care experience strongly preferred**. The ideal candidate understands the realities of surgical workflows, clinical documentation, supplies, implants, preference cards, physician and nursing workflows, and the operational demands placed on OR teams.

You will serve as a primary point of contact for customers, helping clinical teams successfully adopt MedGEO’s technology and ensuring customers achieve meaningful clinical, operational, and financial value. This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing role that requires strong communication, project management, technical aptitude, and the ability to work closely with hospital teams as well as MedGEO’s Product, Engineering, Sales, and leadership teams.

This role requires onsite travel for implementations and go\-lives, with expected travel ranging from approximately **20% to 50% of the time**, depending on customer growth, implementation schedules, go\-live activity, and business needs.

Because MedGEO is still in an early and formative stage of growth, this role also includes the opportunity to participate in the company’s long\-term upside through **early equity in the company**. We are looking for someone who wants to help build the customer success and implementation function, contribute meaningfully to the company’s growth, and share in the value they help create as MedGEO scales.

The right person will be comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment, rolling up their sleeves during implementations and go\-lives, and helping build the customer success function as MedGEO grows.

Key ResponsibilitiesClinical Implementation \& Go\-Live Support

* Lead end\-to\-end clinical implementation processes, including planning, workflow assessment, training, go\-live readiness, launch support, and post\-launch stabilization.
* Work directly with OR nurses, surgeons, perioperative leaders, hospital administrators, IT, supply chain, revenue cycle, and other customer stakeholders.
* Assess current clinical workflows and determine how MedGEO should be incorporated into existing surgical and procedural processes.
* Support implementation of MedGEO workflows related to surgical documentation, supplies, implants, preference cards, intraoperative resource utilization, Smart Vision, and related platform capabilities.
* Develop implementation plans, timelines, milestones, training schedules, and go\-live readiness criteria.
* Provide onsite and remote support during customer onboarding, training, go\-live, and optimization periods.
* Proactively identify implementation risks, workflow issues, adoption barriers, and customer concerns, and escalate as needed.

Customer Success \& Adoption

* Serve as a trusted clinical and operational partner for assigned customers.
* Build strong relationships with frontline clinicians, nurse managers, perioperative directors, surgeons, IT teams, supply chain, revenue cycle, and executive stakeholders.
* Monitor customer adoption, utilization, engagement, satisfaction, and workflow performance.
* Identify adoption gaps and work directly with customer teams to improve usage, training, and workflow alignment.
* Provide ongoing education and support to existing and new users.
* Communicate new MedGEO functionality, best practices, and workflow recommendations to customers.
* Help develop customer champions who can support adoption internally and serve as references for MedGEO externally.

Product Commercialization \& Voice of the Customer

* Serve as a bridge between customers and MedGEO’s Product, Engineering, Sales, and leadership teams.
* Translate frontline clinical feedback into clear product recommendations, workflow improvements, training needs, and commercialization priorities.
* Help Product and Engineering understand how MedGEO performs in real\-world OR and procedural environments.
* Identify recurring customer pain points, workflow challenges, usability issues, and opportunities for product improvement.
* Support rollout of new product capabilities, modules, Smart Vision enhancements, analytics features, and workflow tools.
* Contribute to customer\-facing materials, training resources, workflow guides, implementation playbooks, and product adoption best practices.
* Help determine whether new product features are ready for broader customer rollout based on usability, workflow fit, customer readiness, and measurable value.

Customer Value, Expansion \& Retention

* Help customers understand and measure the clinical, operational, and financial value generated by MedGEO.
* Track improvements in documentation efficiency, utilization capture, accuracy, compliance, workflow performance, and financial outcomes.
* Support customer business reviews, ROI discussions, executive updates, and account health reporting.
* Partner with Sales and leadership to identify opportunities for renewals, upsells, expansions, and additional deplo

**Office Manager / Practice Operations Coordinator**
====================================================

**Full\-Time \| Hybrid — Sherman Oaks, CA**  

**Occasional West Los Angeles**

**WHO WE ARE**
--------------

**Built by therapists. Led by therapists. Always.**


Zeeva Behavioral Health is a woman\-owned, therapist\-owned psychotherapy practice serving clients in Sherman Oaks, West Los Angeles, and online throughout California.


We believe therapy should be **deeply human and clinically extraordinary.**


And we believe the practice behind that therapy should be built the same way.


We care deeply about our therapists. Our clients. Our people. Our spaces. Our communication. Our systems. The way someone is welcomed. The way a problem is handled. Whether we follow through on what we said we would do.


Because the details matter.


Our values are **Heart\-Centered, Dedicated to Excellence, Inspired Learning, Brave Reflection, and The Power of We.**


And one principle runs through all of them:

**Clarity is kind.**


Zeeva began six years ago during the COVID\-19 pandemic. We have built something significant, and we are continuing to build the people, systems, and infrastructure that will support our future.

**THE ROLE**
------------


We are now hiring for an **Office Manager / Practice Operations Coordinator** who loves making things work.

* Keep our Sherman Oaks office organized, stocked, functional, and cared for
* Coordinate supplies, facilities, vendors, access, clinician setup, and routine technology needs
* Manage routine account setup, permissions, troubleshooting, and escalation to outside experts when needed
* Occasionally support operational needs at our West Los Angeles office

### **Marketing Coordination**

* Keep approved marketing, social media, website updates, directories, outreach, and other projects organized and moving
* Coordinate execution while leadership retains brand strategy, voice, and creative direction

### **Client Care Backup**

* Become cross\-trained in core Client Care workflows
* Provide backup support during absences or high\-volume periods as needed


Client Care is its own function and will not be the primary responsibility of this role.

**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR**
-------------------------


You might currently be an Office Manager, Operations Coordinator, Executive Assistant, People Operations Coordinator, Recruiting Coordinator, Administrative Coordinator, Operations Associate, or simply the person everyone relies on because you make things work.


Your current title matters much less to us than how you operate.


You may be great at this if you:

* Are exceptionally organized and strong with follow\-through
* Learn technology quickly
* Communicate warmly, clearly, and professionally
* Have good judgment and know when to solve something versus escalate
* Notice details without losing sight of the bigger picture
* Enjoy both people and systems
* Can create structure where structure does not yet exist
* Take feedback well and are willing to speak up when something is not working
* Care about how people experience an organization
* Want to understand how a business works
* Want the opportunity to take on greater responsibility over time


Healthcare or mental health experience is helpful, but **not required**.


We care much more about how you work than whether you have held this exact title before.

**WHAT OWNERSHIP LOOKS LIKE HERE**
----------------------------------


If someone says:

**“Our new therapist starts Monday. I'm not sure everything is ready.”**

You help get it across the finish line.


And if the same problem keeps happening, you help fix the process so we are not solving it from scratch every time.

**That is Practice Operations.**

jobs.description:
**Key Account Manager – Pet Specialty**  

**Location:** Torrance, CA (In\-Office)  

**Reports to:** Sr. Sales Manager  

**Category Focus:** Pet Specialty  

  

**About Inaba Foods (USA) Inc.**  

Inaba Foods is a manufacturer of premium pet food, treats, toppers, and complements, deeply rooted in a family tradition of excellence that spans generations. Since 1958, pet parents have trusted Inaba to deliver products that are human\-grade, nutrient\-rich, and designed to bring joy to pets.  

  

Today, Inaba is the most popular brand of premium cat and dog dinners and treats in Japan, with growing distribution throughout the United States and globally. Inaba Foods (USA) Inc. continues to expand its footprint, invest in talent, and build long\-term partnerships across the pet industry, supported by the stability and vision of our Japanese parent company.  

  

**Position Summary**  

Inaba Foods (USA) Inc. is seeking a Key Account Manager – Pet to develop and manage strategic relationships at the headquarters and regional level with national and regional retailers, as well as distributors, within the Pet Specialty channel. This role is responsible for driving growth, expanding distribution, and strengthening long\-term partnerships while collaborating closely with internal teams to execute sales strategies.  

  

This is a full\-time, in\-office position based in Torrance, CA, as required by company leadership.  

  

**What Success Looks Like in This Role**

* Grow distribution and sales volume within assigned Pet Specialty accounts
* Strengthen distributor relationships to expand market presence and execution
* Become a trusted partner to customers through strategic planning and consistent engagement
* Contribute to category growth through promotions, pricing strategies, and market insights
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to support forecasting, production planning, and account strategy

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers and distributors, nurturing existing business and driving incremental growth
* Analyze historical and current purchase order data to project sales, assess profitability, and identify growth opportunities
* Lead and participate in customer business reviews and market presentations
* Maintain regular engagement with accounts to ensure customer needs are met or exceeded
* Execute promotional strategies and programs to drive volume and brand visibility
* Provide sales forecasts and input for production and demand planning
* Collaborate with executive leadership on pricing, promotions, quotes, and account strategies
* Resolve customer issues related to product, service, or sales execution
* Monitor competitive activity, market trends, and merchandising techniques
* Manage expenses in alignment with budgeted guidelines
* Demonstrate a growth\-oriented, proactive sales approach focused on building and expanding strategic relationships
* Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and ethical standards while representing Inaba in a professional manner
* Perform additional duties as assigned

 **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, or a related field
* 3–7 years of experience in sales within Pet Specialty, Food \& Beverage, or adjacent CPG categories
* Experience calling on headquarters, regional offices, and/or managing distributor relationships
* Strong ability to analyze trends, data, and sales performance metrics
* Proficiency in creating compelling PowerPoint sales presentations
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and customer service skills
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities
* Experience working cross\-functionally with internal teams and external partners
* Ability to travel locally or regionally as needed, including time spent in the field
* Valid driver’s license with a safe driving record, in accordance with company policy
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite or related software

 **Why Join Inaba Foods**

* Growing U.S. business with expanding distribution and increasing market presence
* Long\-term stability and leadership from a well\-established Japanese parent company
* Opportunity to manage meaningful accounts and influence growth strategy
* Collaborative, professional environment with a strong brand reputation

  

Inaba Foods is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment laws, including California’s Fair Employment and Housing Act.

  

This employer participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Customer Success Manager**  

Daybreak Health \| 100% Remote \| Full\-time


**About the role**  

You'll own a portfolio of 50\+ school districts and make sure they launch fast, run smoothly, and keep referring students. Your people are counselors, social workers, and school admin. Your job is to get them equipped and excited to send kids to care. This is execution at scale: technical onboarding, staff training, troubleshooting, adoption campaigns, and data analysis, with AI and internal tools handling the repetitive parts so you spend your time with people instead of building workflows from scratch. When you do this well, more kids get help.



**About Daybreak Health**



Daybreak partners with school districts to make sure any student who needs mental health care can actually get it. The gap we're closing is real: the recommended ratio is one school psychologist per 500 students, and the national reality is closer to one per 1,200, which means families wait months while counselors carry impossible caseloads. We match every student to a clinician based on language, culture, identity, and what they're actually working through, usually starting care within a week or two of a referral and at no cost to the family. It works. 81% of students improve on standardized clinical measures, 92% of families report meaningful behavioral change at home, and 80% of school staff see better attendance, grades, and behavior. **We're backed by Union Square Ventures, Lux Capital, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Maven Ventures, and Y Combinator**, and we already serve districts representing more than a million students. That still leaves most of the country without an answer, which is exactly where this role comes in.



**What you'll do**


* Lead district onboarding, staff activation, and dashboard training
* Troubleshoot account access, referral submissions, and scope questions, with white\-glove support for strategic districts
* Run staff trainings and info sessions that get people genuinely bought in
* Build training capacity models across your cohort so you can flag capacity risk before it turns into a launch delay
* Set the support and engagement strategy per district, with real autonomy to choose the approach
* Execute adoption campaigns: campus visits, email outreach, webinars, data\-driven interventions
* Find creative ways to reach teachers and parents, not just counselors and admin
* Watch leading indicators like non\-contributor district rates and escalate a rising rate as a structural signal, not a seasonal dip
* Turn district data into action, and keep your portfolio documented in shared tools so your work compounds for the team
* Use AI to build personalized training decks, campaigns, and district talk tracks, then apply your own judgment on context and tone
* Use AI to review activation pacing and referral trend lines so you can spend more human time on the districts that need it
* Bring what you learn to weekly GTM meetings, where AI fluency is a shared practice rather than a personal hack


**Skills**


* District and campus onboarding and implementation
* Live training and facilitation for adult learners
* Adoption and engagement campaign execution
* Project management across many concurrent launches
* Data analysis and simple modeling (capacity, pacing, funnel)
* Independent technical troubleshooting
* Practical AI fluency for drafting, analysis, and pattern\-spotting
* Cross\-functional collaboration
* Strong written and verbal communication
* Documentation in shared tools (Notion, Google Docs and Slides)


**Who thrives here**


* Great communicator and idea generator
* Natural problem\-solver who figures things out without being handed the answer
* Connects dots across teams, products, and initiatives
* Knows when to jump in and help and when to hold people accountable
* Takes pride in support so fast and pleasant it creates champions
* Scrappy and adaptable, comfortable in constant startup change
* Sees AI as a way to do more of the job well, not a shortcut around the judgment parts

### **Qualifications**



Must\-haves


* Experience in EdTech, education, or healthcare partnerships, product support, and enablement
* K\-12 background
* Track record driving adoption at scale, think 100\+ customers and thousands of end users
* Strong project management across multiple launches at different phases
* Tech savvy: picks up new systems fast, troubleshoots independently, uses AI tools daily
* Exceptional organization across deadlines and deliverables
* Self\-starter who sees what needs to happen and makes it happen
* Strong written and verbal communication
* Comfortable turning data into insight, including building simple models


Nice\-to\-haves


* Experience with mental health or SEL products
* Previous work inside a K\-12 district or on a campus
* Salesforce or similar CRM experience

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Apprenticeship, February 2027 Start
jobs.description:
**The Digital Marketing Apprenticeship application will open on September 8, 2026\.** **Please complete your application before September 21, 2026\.**  

**Participation in the Apprenticeship program requires that you are located in the United States for the duration of the apprenticeship program.**  

This Apprenticeship is intended for individuals who want to learn and develop entry\-level technical and professional skills in digital marketing. If you are currently pursuing or hold a degree in digital marketing (or a related field), or bring more than a year of relevant experience, we encourage you to browse our University Graduate \& Internship opportunities instead.


To start the application process, you will need an updated CV or resume in English. Click on the “Apply” button on this page and provide the required material in the appropriate section(PDFs preferred):

* In the “Resume Section:” attach one single document that contains an updated resume


This role may also be located in our Playa Vista, CA campus.


Applicants in the County of Los Angeles: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Chicago, IL, USA; Los Angeles, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* High School Diploma, GED equivalent, or practical experience.
* Not currently enrolled in or completed a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree program in a digital marketing\-related field.
* Less than 1 year of relevant digital marketing experience.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience using Google Workspace or a similar suite of productivity tools.
* Ability to work independently and within a team framework.
* Ability to navigate multiple ambiguous tasks and competing priorities while finding suitable solutions and seeking help/advice where appropriate.
* Ability to be proactive and have a positive attitude.
* Excellent communication, organizational, and problem solving skills, customer service capabilities, and critical thinking abilities.
* Enthusiasm and passion for new technologies, demonstrated through personal projects and commitment to learning new skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


The Google Digital Marketing Apprenticeship is a Department of Labor Registered Apprenticeship Program and a structured learning and development opportunity. During the 18 month program, apprentices will participate in on\-the\-job training, related technical instruction, and career development workshops to develop professional and durable skills. Upon completion, apprentices receive a nationally\-recognized credential, certified by the U.S. Department of Labor.


As a Digital Marketing Apprentice at Google, you will develop the skills you need to pursue an entry\-level career in digital marketing.


You will help define, design, and execute digital marketing campaigns across channels for brands across the world. You will develop the skills to create strategy, content, and optimization, using AI tools where applicable to enhance creativity and efficiency. You will analyze market/campaign data, track key metrics, and present findings to drive objectives. You will engage clients, and gain exposure to consumer and business Google products.


Apprentices are paid hourly for their time split between on\-the\-job training and related technical instruction, and are required to dedicate 40 hours each week to the program. Apprenticeships begin with an immersive virtual onboarding experience to build a foundational understanding of the profession. Apprentices will then join a Google team to train on\-the\-job, while continuing to engage in track\-specific learnings and career workshops throughout the program. As part of the program, apprentices receive holistic career readiness support, and towards the end of the program will have the time and space to prepare for their next endeavor.  

  

Find more details about apprenticeships and a list of FAQs on goo.gle/apprenticeships.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Support digital strategy design and implementation, including go\-to\-market and multi\-channel campaigns.
* Optimize campaigns and digital assets for SEO, leveraging AI\-powered tools when applicable.
* Manage Search, Video, and Programmatic campaigns, track key metrics, and present comprehensive findings to clients and cross\-functional teams.
* Practice responsible, effective, and innovative use of AI.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. As part of the eCommerce Digital Marketing team, this is a hands\-on role, designing, executing and evaluating digital marketing campaigns on media networks owned by Amazon, Instacart and our CPG retail partners across all of our Wonderful Brands, FIJI water and JUSTIN Wines. **Business Development Representative – Roofing**

**Roofing Royalty LLC**  
Orange, CA  
**Compensation:** Commission Only \| Uncapped Earning Potential  
**Job Type:** Independent / Commission\-Based Sales

**About Roofing Royalty**

Roofing Royalty LLC is a relationship\-driven roofing company built by experienced industry professionals who believe there is a better way to do business.

Our focus is simple: **build lasting relationships, deliver quality work, provide competitive pricing, and treat every property like it’s our own.**

We are building a team of motivated professionals who take ownership of their role and want to grow alongside the company.

**The Opportunity**

Roofing Royalty is looking for a highly motivated **Business Development Representative** to help expand our presence throughout Orange County and surrounding markets.

This is not a traditional door\-to\-door roofing sales position.

The primary focus of this role is **networking, relationship building, and developing referral partnerships that generate residential and commercial roofing opportunities.**

You will represent Roofing Royalty in the community and build relationships with professionals and organizations that regularly encounter roofing needs.

Potential referral relationships may include:

* Property managers and management companies
* Real estate agents and brokerages
* General contractors and construction companies
* Insurance professionals
* HOAs and community managers
* Commercial property owners
* Solar companies and sales organizations
* Restoration companies
* Investors and real estate professionals
* Local businesses and professional networking groups

**What You’ll Do**

Develop and maintain referral relationships throughout Orange County and surrounding areas.

Attend networking events, industry events, business meetings, and community events representing Roofing Royalty.

Identify new residential and commercial roofing opportunities through your professional network and business development efforts.

Build long\-term partnerships rather than focusing solely on one\-time transactions.

Maintain communication with referral partners and prospective clients throughout the sales process.

Work alongside Roofing Royalty’s operations and leadership team to ensure customers and referral partners receive a high\-quality experience.

Help expand the Roofing Royalty brand and reputation within the local business community.

**Who We’re Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is:

* Highly motivated and self\-driven
* Comfortable networking and meeting new people
* Strong at developing and maintaining relationships
* Professional and dependable
* Confident communicating with business owners and decision\-makers
* Comfortable working independently
* Interested in performance\-based compensation with uncapped earning potential
* Experienced in roofing, construction, solar, real estate, property management, insurance, or B2B sales is a plus

Existing relationships within the Orange County business, real estate, construction, property management, or insurance communities are highly valuable.

**Compensation**

This is a **commission\-only position with uncapped earning potential.**

Compensation is directly tied to the roofing business you develop, allowing successful representatives to build a substantial income as their referral network grows.

Specific commission structure and earning opportunities will be discussed during the interview process.

**Why Roofing Royalty?**

We are building Roofing Royalty around **relationships, accountability, quality, and ownership.**

Our team brings extensive experience across roofing, construction, solar, sales, and operations, with dedicated people placed in positions where they can perform at their best.

We want our Business Development team to build a **book of relationships**, not simply chase individual jobs.

As Roofing Royalty grows, we want the people who help build the company to have opportunities to grow with it.

**Treating Every Home Like Royalty.**

Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Valar Atomics**



At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high\-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next\-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory\-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

  


**The Team**



As part of the Business organization, People and Talent attracts, develops, and supports the exceptional individuals who drive Valar's success. The team partners across the company to build a high\-performing organization through recruiting, employee development, engagement, and people operations.

  


**The Role**



We're seeking a Recruiting Coordinator to support our Talent team and own the logistics, coordination, and candidate experience across the hiring process. This role is critical to our ability to scale—ensuring candidates move quickly, interviews run seamlessly, and every interaction reflects the high bar we set for our team. We're looking for someone who's energized by ambiguity, excited to build from the ground up, and quick to take initiative. This is a fully on\-site role based at our Torrance, CA headquarters.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* Schedule phone, video, and onsite interviews across multiple teams and time zones with speed and accuracy.
* Deliver a high\-quality candidate experience through clear communication, attention to detail, and confident onsite hosting.
* Maintain accurate candidate records and workflows in our Applicant Tracking System (Greenhouse).
* Coordinate candidate travel (flights, hotels, transportation) and support expense reconciliation.
* Improve recruiting operations through process enhancements and special projects.
* Build strong, professional relationships with candidates and internal stakeholders.
* Partner closely with recruiters and hiring teams across the business to keep the hiring process moving.

  


**Basic Qualifications**


* Experience managing complex calendars and using tools such as Outlook and Microsoft Office.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer\-service mindset.
* High level of organization with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
* Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.
* Based in or willing to relocate to Torrance, CA.

  


**Preferred Skills and Experience**


* 2\+ years of experience in recruiting coordination, talent operations, or HR coordination.
* Experience using Greenhouse or a similar Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* Bachelor's degree.
* Experience improving or streamlining recruiting or operational processes.

  


**What We Offer**


* Competitive base salary
* Equity ownership in a rapidly growing advanced energy company
* Comprehensive medical benefits
* Unlimited PTO
* Free daily lunch and dinner provided onsite
* Generous PPE stipend
* High\-impact startup environment with significant ownership and autonomy
* Opportunities for rapid career growth and internal advancement
* Direct collaboration with experienced operators, engineers, and industry leaders
* The opportunity to help build and scale transformative energy technology from the ground up

  


**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**



Valar Atomics is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.



We are committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment and will provide reasonable accommodation as required by law.



Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States as a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident (green card holder).

jobs.title: Program Coordinator - Women's Center
jobs.description:
**About Glide**
GLIDE is a nationally recognized center for social justice, dedicated to fighting systemic injustices, creating pathways out of poverty and crisis, and transforming lives. Through its integrated comprehensive services, advocacy initiatives, and inclusive community, GLIDE empowers individuals, families, and children to achieve stability and to thrive. GLIDE is on the forefront of addressing some of society’s most pressing issues, including poverty, housing and homelessness, and racial and social justice. GLIDE’s mission is to create a radically inclusive, just, and loving community mobilized to alleviate suffering and break the cycles of poverty and marginalization **Position Summary**:
GLIDE’s Women’s Center is seeking a compassionate and organized Program Coordinator to support the delivery of services for individuals who identify as women who are in immediate need of housing, essential needs (e.g., food, clothes, hygiene supplies) health and mental health services, navigation, and case management support, group support, etc. due to homelessness, gender\-based violence, and trauma. The Women’s Center will assess client’s needs, provide information and support to overcome barriers, provide early intervention, and case management. The Women’s Center Program Coordinator will assist the Senior Director to plan, coordinate, and implement the Center’s programs and services, provide direct services, and support other general operations of the program, such as facilitate/co\-facilitate groups and plan Center events. This individual will collaborate with the director, staff, and community partners to ensure compliance with multiple\-funding sources and their requirements.
### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**


* Develop, coordinate, and maintain relationships and collaborations with GLIDE’s programs, established and new community partners to benefit participants and promote GLIDE’s Women’s Center.
* Be responsible for the coordination, creation, maintenance of service and/or staff schedules and business documentation (e.g. reports, flyers).
* Working in collaboration with case managers, develop and document Individualized Service Plans (ISPs) for clients, including data entry and reporting through CRM tools. Be responsible for organizing and managing Women’s Center events, which will involve coordinating all logistical aspects.
* Provide data coordination and quality assurance checks to ensure services meet predetermined standards and client satisfaction.
* Provide low\-threshold advocacy and case management, which includes referral, linkages, and assistance to health, health services, legal aid, and other human services and resources to support the client to reach their goals for improved safety, wellness, and quality of life.
* Conduct street and community outreach and attend community events to reach women and to promote the Women’s Center.
* Collaborate with Director to assign administrative tasks, referrals, cases, etc. to program staff. Ensure timely referral processing and allocation of new cases to other Women’s Center staff.
* Perform triage, intakes, needs assessments, service planning, service coordination, and follow up contacts in person, by email or phone with clients and other providers.
* Apply strength\-based services that are centered around motivational interviewing, cultural humility, and trauma\-informed care.
* Plan, organize, and oversee group sessions, activities, workshops, and individual support servies for clients Lead/co\-facilitate women educational and empowerment groups virtually and onsite.
* Maintain files and database records to track client progress. Prepare reports, success stories and challenges for internal review and reporting to external funders and stakeholders,; Ensure timely and accurate compliance with all reporting requirements.
* Adhere to professional boundaries and standards. Understand and follow basis ethics, values, and principles of regulatory practices. Adhere to all laws and requirements regarding HIPPA, confidentiality, child protective services, contractual agreements, etc.
* Meet professional obligations through efficient work habits such as collaborating with co\-workers, meeting deadlines, honoring schedules, attend and actively participating in staff and individual meeting, community meeting, supervision, case conferences, client conferences and in\-service trainings.
### **Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in relevant field (e.g., psychology, social work, sociology, criminal justice) preferred; or at least four years of experience providing services (e.g., case management, or coordination of services) to women experiencing homelessness, domestic violence, gender\-based violence, and/or have been incarcerated.
* Demonstrated understanding of the psycho\-social and economic issues that impact women.
* Group facilitation experience helpful.
* Facilitates collaboration among Women’s Center staff and other GLIDE departments.
* Ability to develop processes and operations to support the implantation of new ideas and approaches.

GLIDE is a nationally recognized center for social justice, dedicated to fighting systemic injustices, creating pathways out of poverty and crisis, and transforming lives. Through its integrated comprehensive services, advocacy initiatives, and inclusive community, GLIDE empowers individuals, families, and children to achieve stability and to thrive. GLIDE is on the forefront of addressing some of society’s most pressing issues, including poverty, housing and homelessness, and racial and social justice. GLIDE’s mission is to create a radically inclusive, just, and loving community mobilized to alleviate suffering and break the cycles of poverty and marginalization **Position Summary**:
The Volunteer Program Coordinator will support GLIDE’s volunteer department, administering individual volunteer programs and strategic initiatives. This position will conduct volunteer outreach and recruitment, volunteer scheduling, support with volunteer recognition initiatives and events, and contribute to the design and implementation of new programs and initiatives. This individual will help the department increase the number of volunteers at GLIDE, increase volunteer retention and repeat volunteerism, and support Community Service volunteers to acquire new skills and access pathways to employment. This position is expected to be onsite Monday through Friday 9 AM – 5:30 PM and work at major events and holidays such as Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, and Christmas Day. There will be occasional work needed on evenings, weekends, and early mornings.
### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**


* Greet and steward volunteers arriving and departing for their shifts.
* Schedule and conduct virtual and in\-person orientations, as well as debriefs, for individuals and groups.
* Conduct group presentations, administer workshops, and facilitate groups.
* Liaise with internal departments to add new volunteer opportunities.
* Support the recruitment, retention, and success of all volunteers at GLIDE across multiple programs.
* Support with the design, development and administration of GLIDE’s group Service\-Learning Programming; contribute to the creation of new materials, curriculum, workshop content, and marketing materials.
* Develop relationships with referring partners such as schools, city government departments, community\-based organizations, universities, and companies.
* Support with the development and implementation of volunteer appreciation and recognition initiatives and/or events.
* Conduct research on corporate giving programs and in\-kind donation programs.
* Participate in committees for special events, holiday activities, fundraisers, etc.
* Attend off\-site volunteer recruitment events, deliver off\-site presentations, represent GLIDE at external meetings, and conduct outreach such as tabling at events.
* Respond to incoming voicemail and email inquiries regarding volunteer opportunities.
* Coordinate and process in\-kind donations.
* Use Salesforce and volunteer CRM to track volunteer hours and create reports, support data entry/collection, review data for accuracy, and track programmatic impact via KPI’s and impact reports.
### **Minimum Qualifications**


* 2\+ years of experience working in a non\-profit, education, or social impact organization required.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills required.

* Proficiency using MS Office required, with experience using a CRM, preferably Salesforce, ideal.

* Sit or stand comfortably; and the ability to navigate throughout office spaces (via elevator or stairs).

This is a fulltime (40 hour/week), Non\-Exempt position.**Work Environment**
GLIDE’s buildings are located in the Tenderloin neighborhood. GLIDE maintains an "open door" policy to the community and its clients, who frequently enter and leave the building.

jobs.description:
**Executive Assistant to the CEO / Executive Operations Coordinator**
=====================================================================

**Position Summary**
--------------------


The Executive Assistant to the CEO / Executive Operations Coordinator provides high\-level administrative, organizational, and operational support to the CEO and Executive Team. This position helps keep executive priorities, meetings, projects, communications, and follow\-up activities organized and moving forward.


The role works closely with the CEO, Chief Clinical Officer (CCO), Vice President, Head of People, and Executive Clinical Team. The Executive Assistant serves as a central point of coordination across these leaders and helps ensure that information, decisions, assignments, and deadlines are communicated and followed through appropriately.


This is not a traditional administrative support position. The successful candidate must be comfortable working directly with senior leadership, managing competing priorities, coordinating cross\-functional work, identifying issues before they become problems, and operating independently with limited day\-to\-day direction.


The position requires a high level of discretion because it involves access to confidential executive, employee, financial, clinical, legal, operational, and organizational information.

* Support the CEO in tracking major organizational priorities, projects, deadlines, and commitments.
* Maintain project timelines, action\-item lists, and follow\-up trackers for initiatives assigned by executive leadership.
* Coordinate information and deliverables across Clinical, Operations, Finance, People/HR, Compliance, Training, and other departments as needed.
* Follow up with leaders and staff regarding assignments and deadlines established by the CEO or Executive Team.
* Identify delays, gaps, conflicting priorities, or other issues that could affect completion of an assignment and bring them to the appropriate leader's attention.
* Help move projects from planning through completion by coordinating people, information, deadlines, meetings, and deliverables.
* Prepare status updates, summaries, and reports for the CEO and Executive Team.

* Assist the CEO and Executive Team with quarterly and annual organizational planning.

* Assist with implementation and coordination of organizational initiatives as assigned by executive leadership.

### **CEO Communication and Relationship Management**

* Respond to and appropriately route communications directed to the CEO.
* Use sound judgment when determining the urgency and appropriate handling of requests.
* Maintain professional working relationships with individuals at all levels of the organization.
* Represent the CEO's office professionally and consistently with organizational expectations.

**POSITION SUMMARY**  

The Buck Institute is seeking an **Executive Assistant** to support the Chief Scientific Officer (CSO) and Executive Office. This role provides comprehensive administrative support for the CSO’s executive and laboratory activities, while also supporting the broader executive branch.  

  

This is an on\-site position with the possibility of working hybrid one day per week when on\-site activities are not required.  

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**  

***Support to CSO (approx. 80%/4 days per week on\-site)**** Manage the CSO’s calendar, appointments, meetings, events, and priorities; coordinate travel itineraries and reimbursements for the CSO and lab members.
* Provide comprehensive administrative support to the CSO, including drafting and managing correspondence, maintaining CSO and laboratory files and documents, responding to staff and external inquiries, ordering supplies, photocopying, and running errands.
* Support all activities of the Committee of Affiliations and Promotions, including drafting and sending letters of recommendation on behalf of the CSO and coordinating public and faculty seminars.
* Serve as administrative coordinator for the Office for Education and Training, supporting educational and training events, communications and advertising, appreciation weeks, on\-site retreats, and development of a new PhD graduate program.
* Coordinate the R13 NIA Summer Training Course, including annual applications and execution of the course when hosted at Buck every three years.
* Coordinate laboratory operations and recruiting activities, including schedules and meetings, room reservations, catering, setup/takedown, and applications and interviews for laboratory positions.
* Plan and coordinate recurring scientific, faculty, leadership, and educational meetings and events, including agendas, schedules, invitations, materials, minutes, catering, travel reimbursements, IT/AV support, and on\-site logistics. Programs include:
	+ Monthly faculty, leadership, and education meetings
	+ Bi\-weekly Internal Research Seminars, including bi\-annual scheduling
	+ Podium Pointers training sessions for mentors and trainees supporting the Internal Research Seminars, Bay Area Aging Meeting, Glenn\-Campisi Symposium, Buck Student Annual Symposium, and VITAL Symposium
	+ Scientific Advisory Board meetings held every 18 months, including lunch and dinner logistics

***Executive Team/BOT Support (approx. 20%/1 day per week on\-site)**** Provide administrative and executive support to the Executive Team as needed, including data processing, correspondence, and scheduling meetings.
* Process check requests, reimbursements, package mailing, and purchase orders; order and maintain office supplies for the Executive Team.
* Support and coordinate Executive Office in\-person meetings and on\-site events on scheduled onsite days.

***General**** Resolve scheduling conflicts by assessing competing needs and priorities
* Respond to urgent issues outside normal business hours.
* Backup Admin Lab Coordinators as needed.
* Demonstrate strong customer service skills in interactions with internal and external stakeholders.

**QUALIFICATIONS**  

**Education \& Experience*** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
* 5\+ years’ successful administrative experience in a non\-profit, research, or academic environment supporting multiple high\-level professionals.
* Supervisory experience preferred.
* Experience with NIH grant applications, PubMed, and eRA Commons preferred

**Specialized Skills*** Ability to work independently, take initiative, and demonstrate good judgment.
* Ability to professionally and courteously communicate with diverse individuals and personalities at all levels, including faculty, leadership staff, laboratory personnel, and the public.
* Excellent written, verbal, organizational, and administrative skills, with strict confidentiality always.
* Excellent organizational and multitasking skills with the ability to manage simultaneous projects of varying complexity and meet deadlines.
* Proven accuracy and attention to detail.
* Demonstrated supervisory and critical\-thinking skills.
* Highly proficient with Macintosh, MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, database and graphics programs.
* Strong proficiency with office management technologies and video conferencing software.
* Experience planning and scheduling meetings and seminars, including national and international travel and coordination of AV needs with IT
* A lifelong learner committed to the Buck’s mission.

**COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS*** Annual salary of $95,000 \- $115,000, commensurate with experience and skill set.
* Generous benefits including health insurance, paid parental leave, vacation/sick leave, a 401(k) with 5% employer match, and student loan repayment.
* Collaborative environment supporting both science and social activities.

**WHY WORK AT THE BUCK INSTITUTE?**  

Our success will ultimately change healthcare. The Buck Institute aims to end the threat of age\-related diseases for current and future generations by bringing together highly capable and passionate scientists from a broad range of disciplines to identify and impede the mechanisms of aging.  

  

Located in Marin County, California, the Buck is an independent nonprofit institution dedicated to increasing human healthspan—the healthy years of life. Globally recognized as a pioneer and leader in targeting aging, the number one risk factor for diseases including Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, cancer, macular degeneration, heart disease, and diabetes, the Buck seeks to help people live better, longer.  

  

The Buck Institute is an equal\-opportunity employer.  

  

**TO APPLY**  

Interested candidates should apply online and upload a CV and cover letter that includes contact information for three professional references.

jobs.description:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.


If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.

* Note: This position requires presence in our San Francisco, San Jose, or Bellevue office location 4 days per week; Lambda’s designated work from home day is currently Tuesday.

  

The Technical Account Manager owns the technical health of the post\-sales relationship for Lambda’s public cloud accounts, spanning AI\-native startups, Enterprises, and Fortune 500 companies. Where the Customer Success Manager owns the commercial health of an account, you own its technical health: the customer’s workloads run well, the architecture is right, the SLA story is defensible, and technical risk is found and retired before it threatens revenue. Solutions Engineering carries the account through pre\-sales and hypercare; at handoff, you take ownership of the technical relationship for the life of the contract.


This is a hands\-on role, not a coordination role. You will understand what customers are actually building (training runs, fine\-tuning pipelines, inference services) deeply enough to lead joint POC sessions, design and defend architectures, validate SLA events at the root\-cause level, and build the tooling that makes account health measurable. Build the customer user journey and convert it into value\-add opportunities across the platform, documentation, and escalation routing.
* Lead joint customer POC sessions. Define success criteria with the customer before a node is provisioned: acceptance thresholds, benchmarks, timelines. Own the execution plan, coordinate capacity and provisioning, run or oversee the tests, and drive the POC to a clear verdict: win the workload, close the gap through product, or qualify out.
* Lead customer architecture designs. Produce and defend reference architectures spanning compute, networking, storage, connectivity, and scheduler integration (Slurm, Kubernetes). Validate breach events at the technical level, down to the specific Ethernet or InfiniBand failure, and arm CSMs and leadership with defensible numbers. Partner with product to standardize SLA language and structure across 1CC, on\-demand, and reserved offerings.
* Build the tooling that makes accounts measurable. Own the technical data surfaces for customer health end to end: dashboards, telemetry and uptime history views, health scoring, and churn early\-warning signals. Scope, build, and drive adoption. Replace “escalate to engineering to answer a basic question” with self\-serve data for the whole GTM org.
* Direct technical escalations and incidents. Serve as the technical lead during high\-severity events on your accounts: drive root cause, hold the quality bar on RCAs, coordinate engineering, support, and vendors (NVIDIA, storage, networking), and give account teams a technically accurate narrative. Run proactive maintenance and known\-issue communication so customers hear about problems from Lambda first.
* Drive the technical voice of the customer. Run a structured feature\-request pipeline into product with committed triage timelines. Audit the platform hands\-on by provisioning as a customer and testing known friction points. Lead product\-led POCs (for example, NVIDIA NIM) that open new value for customers.
* Know the market technology landscape. Track GPU roadmaps, competing clouds and neoclouds, and the evolving training and inference stacks. Brief customers on what is coming and internal teams on where Lambda stands, and let that context shape architecture and expansion recommendations.

**You**

* 5\+ years in technical account management, solutions engineering or architecture, ML engineering, technical program or product management, or infrastructure engineering with significant customer\-facing scope, in cloud, HPC, or AI infrastructure.
* Hands\-on fluency with GPU infrastructure: able to provision, benchmark, and debug across compute, networking (InfiniBand, Ethernet), storage, and schedulers (Slurm, Kubernetes), and to read results critically.

Investing in your health and your future. We offer a competitive high\-deductible health plan, EAP programs and access to health and well\-being activities along with 401(k) program with employer matching to help you plan for your future.
  
  

Diversity and inclusion. We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. Wherever life has taken you, we welcome you to bring your whole self to work. Just be you – because that’s exactly who we’re looking for.
  
  

Apply today and let’s go to great places together!

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 40\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*
