jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager, Paid Social
jobs.description:
**About Decagon**


Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.


Our technology enables industry\-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.


We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world\-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.


We’re an in\-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.

**About the Role**


We're looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to scale Decagon's paid social programs internationally, with an initial focus on EMEA. This role owns paid social spend end\-to\-end—LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, emerging platforms—and is responsible for standing up and scaling an EMEA motion. You'll partner closely with EMEA sales leadership to make sure spend allocation tracks where the deals actually are, not just where measurement is easiest.


This is a channel\-owner role for someone who's spiked in paid social specifically and has managed large budgets where efficiency and allocation decisions really matter. While paid social is the core of the role, you'll also flex into adjacent demand gen work—ABM, landing pages, email—as EMEA\-specific needs come up.

 **In this role, you will**

* Own paid social end\-to\-end: Run LinkedIn, Meta, X, and emerging platforms from creative brief through launch, optimization, and reporting. You're accountable for efficiency and output across the full paid social budget, not just execution.
* Scale spend into EMEA: Stand up and grow a paid social motion in EMEA from its current early stage. Adapt targeting, creative, and budget pacing to local buying behavior, currencies, and compliance requirements (GDPR and beyond).
* Align spend to sales opportunity: Partner with EMEA sales leadership to make sure budget allocation tracks where the actual pipeline opportunity is by market and segment, not just where measurement is easiest.
* Build the attribution story: Own how paid social spend connects to pipeline and revenue by market and channel. Bring your own point of view on what's working, backed by data, not just activity metrics like CTR and CPL.
* Test and systematize: Run structured experiments across creative, audiences, and channels, and turn what works into repeatable playbooks the rest of the team can use.
* Flex into adjacent demand gen: Support EMEA\-specific ABM, landing pages, and email work as needs come up, in partnership with the broader demand gen team.

 **Your background looks something like this**

* 5\+ years in performance marketing with a clear specialization in paid social (LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, TikTok, or similar) rather than search.
* Managed paid social budgets at meaningful scale (six\-figure\+ monthly spend) and can speak to how you allocated across campaigns, audiences, and markets.
* Have run or scaled paid social programs in EMEA specifically—different currencies, buying behaviors, compliance considerations (GDPR, etc.), and local nuances in creative and targeting.
* Analytical and comfortable owning your own attribution story: connecting spend by market/channel to pipeline and revenue, not just CTR and CPL.
* Used to working cross\-functionally with regional sales teams to align spend with where the pipeline opportunity actually is.
* Can flex beyond paid social into adjacent demand gen work (ABM, landing pages, email) when EMEA\-specific needs call for it.
* Thrive in a fast\-paced startup environment, where you're expected to take ownership, move quickly, and learn as you go.

 **Even better if you have**

* Have experience with Clay or similar audience\-building tools and are comfortable building and iterating on paid audiences
* Have stood up a paid social program in a new region from scratch (rather than inheriting one already built).
* Speak a European language relevant to key EMEA markets (UK, DACH, France, Benelux, Nordics).
* Bring point of view on emerging paid social channels or formats worth testing in EMEA.

 **Benefits**


We proudly offer the following benefits for our full\-time employees:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family
* Life Insurance and Disability Benefits
* Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)
* Parental Leave
* Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot
* Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work\-life balance
* Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best
* Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave)

*These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.*


Compensation Range: $160K \- $210K

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Who we are**
--------------


Altimate AI provides an expert agentic data engineering harness to automate the work of data teams. These generate data pipelines, write data documentation/tests, and optimize data infrastructure autonomously. In particular they help to automatically reduce the total cost of ownership on Databricks and Snowflake.


Teams using Altimate.ai have seen 3x accelerated data development and up to 30% reduction in cloud data infrastructure costs. Altimate is used by hundreds of companies and thousands of weekly active users. Read more about us in this VentureBeat Article.


We are a Series A startup of 50\+ people, distributed across India (mainly Bangalore) and the US. Working here means short deadlines, juggling several things at once, adapting quickly, and making calls without complete information. If you have done marketing at a startup, you will recognize this.

**Role summary**
----------------


Reporting directly to the head of marketing, you will run the execution engine of our marketing team: the systems, the channels, the publishing cadence, and the reporting that tells us what is working.


This is a hands\-on role covering the full range of digital marketing mechanics: marketing automation, email, blog publishing, social, events, and reporting. Search/answer\-engine visibility, and email outreach/deliverability are two immediate priorities, and we will increase the scope of the role over time based on the skills and interests of the successful candidate along with company priorities.


We are a small team, so we would rather shape the role around what you are good at than hold you to a fixed spec. If you bring depth in something we have not listed (paid acquisition, lifecycle, partner marketing, ABM) we will make room for it if it fits our strategy, and fill the gap elsewhere with contract help or other people on the team.


As an AI\-native company, we expect you to work the way we build product: using agentic AI tools, skills, and scheduled automations to scale your own output, and not doing everything by hand.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

**Marketing systems and automation.** HubSpot is our system of record: segments, properties, workflows, forms, campaign tracking, and integrations with the rest of our stack. You will be the primary system owner.

**Search and answer\-engine visibility (AEO/SEO).** On\-site and off\-site work across altimate.ai and help.altimate.ai: technical SEO, on\-page optimization, structured data, site architecture and internal linking, backlinks and listings, and optimization for AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews). Build the measurement that shows whether it is working.

**Email and newsletter.** Manage the subscription list and opt\-in process. Build, schedule, and send a regular newsletter from material our engineering team and contract writer produce. Own hygiene, segmentation, and deliverability. Set KPIs and own the process for meeting them.

**Blog publishing and distribution.** Get engineering\- and writer\-authored articles live (Hashnode today, though we may change the publication flow), then build exposure for them: syndication, communities, newsletters, cross\-posting.

**Social channels.** Own our channels day to day. Turn existing long\-form content into posts, judge which channels are worth our effort, and grow reach. You are not writing the source material, but you need judgment about what will land where.

**Analytics and reporting.** Track numbers from GA4, PostHog, Google Search Console, HubSpot, OpenSEO and elsewhere and act on them.

**Digital events.** Webinars and online events end to end: platform, registration workflow, promotion, reminders, follow\-up, reporting.

**In\-person event logistics.** Coordinate our presence at conferences and meetups in North America and Europe — venue and vendor bookings, shipping, schedules, promotion, lead capture, follow\-up. We also expect to run occasional events in India (meetups, recruiting events) that you would help promote.

**Where this role goes long term**
----------------------------------


To start off, we are hiring an individual contributor. As the team scales, we expect this role to grow into leading a small team, and we are looking for someone with the ambition and judgment to step up when that happens. If your goal is to stay a pure IC indefinitely, this is not the right fit.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

* **Not a content writing role.** Our existing team produce the blog posts, newsletter articles, and SEO content. You help project manage and distribute that work; you do not author it.
* **Not a design role.** Visual creative is handled elsewhere.
* **Not a product\-technical role.** You do not need to understand data engineering our product internals to do this job well, but a demonstrated familiarity with software development and data engineering would be a big plus.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* **4\+ years in digital marketing, 6 preferred**, with meaningful time in startups or small multi\-channel marketing teams.
* **Hands\-on ownership of a marketing automation tools:** configuring it, not just working inside something someone else built.
* **Email marketing infrastructure experience**: selecting or implementing an ESP, migrating a contact database, building a compliant opt\-in flow, and diagnosing genuine deliverability problems. Just sending campaigns inside an already\-healthy system is not the same thing.
* **Technical SEO you have done yourself:** schema, site architecture, crawl and index health — plus a current, practical point of view on AEO.
* **Self\-sufficiency in the tools**: GA4, Google Search Console, HubSpot, Ahrefs/Semrush/OpenSEO or equivalent.
* **Practical fluency with agentic AI tools:** specific workflows and automations you have built and run, not general familiarity.
* **Operational reliability.** A large part of this job is rec

jobs.description:
Territory Sales Representative – Entry Level / Full Time
  
  

San Francisco CA
  
  

Break Into Pharmaceutical Sales with Pivya® at ImpactBio supporting Alembic Therapeutics
  
  

Do you have work experience that demonstrates drive, energy, and transferable skills that will lead to being a strong salesperson?
  
If you are looking to launch a career in pharmaceutical sales, this is your opportunity!
  
  

Alembic Therapeutics, in partnership with ImpactBio, is launching Pivya®, an FDA\-approved oral antibiotic for uncomplicated urinary tract infections (uUTIs). With over 40 years of success in Sweden, Pivya® is now entering the U.S. market—and we’re building a high\-performance sales team to support this launch.
  
  

As a Territory Sales Representative, you don’t need prior pharmaceutical sales experience—we’re looking for motivated, coachable individuals who are eager to learn, follow a proven sales model, and build a long\-term career in the industry. You’ll receive the training, tools, and mentorship needed to succeed while gaining real\-world experience calling on healthcare providers.
  
  

This full\-time role is with ImpactBio, a premier commercial partner in Life Sciences, with the potential to transition to Alembic Therapeutics based on strong performance.

jobs.title: Entry Level Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
ADP is hiring a **Sales Representative, Small Business Services.**


* *Are you ready to build a rewarding future? Uncapped commissions, lavish incentive trips, and career advancement are some of the ways.*
* *Do you want to join a Fortune 250 company with industry\-leading sales training and the latest sales technology to help you achieve success**?*
* *Are you looking to join a fast\-paced, inclusive environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?*

If so, this may be the opportunity you've been searching for. Read on and decide for yourself.


In this role, you will work within a defined geographic territory that targets clients and prospects with 1\-49 employees. You will identify and sign new clients for payroll, tax, human resources, benefits, and more and sell additional solutions to existing clients. Daily, you will cultivate relationships, set appointments, gather leads from established business partners, assess client or prospect needs to present the best ADP solutions, and spend your time in the field closing business. Don't worry if you have no prior sales experience; we are known for our high\-quality sales training and will teach you how to use the latest sales technology to set you up for success.


Integrity, resilience, positivity, and a refuse to lose attitude are must\-haves in this job. As with any role in sales, you will experience ebbs and flows. However, challenges should ignite your determination and invigorate you to thrive, not weigh you down. In return, you'll be rewarded with uncapped commissions, incentive trips, and opportunities to advance your career in a fun and friendly environment \- all while gaining serious credibility as part of an industry\-leading sales team in a stable and highly respected tech company.


Ready to \#MakeYourMark? **Apply now!**


**To learn more about Sales at ADP**, watch here: http://adp.careers/Sales\_Videos


**What you'll do:** *Responsibilities*


* **Grow Our Business While Growing Yours.** You will work independently and collaboratively as part of various teams within your assigned geography to close sales, win business, and reach sales goals.
* **Turn Prospects into Loyal Clients and Raving Fans.** You will implement a sales strategy targeted to decision\-makers and business owners to build a network and capture new business.
* **Deepen** **Relationships Across the ADP Family.** In addition to selling cloud\-based human resources solutions, you will strategically cultivate additional business within existing accounts. But it's not all business; you will make life\-long friendships here.
* **Collaborate** **Daily.** You will serve as a trusted advisor, partner, and ADP ambassador to your clients, internal partners, and overall network while demonstrating grace under pressure and the highest ethical standards.

**TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE****:** *Required Qualifications*


* **Positive Self\-Starter****.** You have an upbeat, persistent style and the ability to cold call without fear of rejection, manage your time well, and can present your ideas in a clear professional manner on paper, in\-person, and over the phone.
* **Agile Solution Seeker****.** You're a problem solver who can find an answer, or a solution, even in times of fast\-paced change.
* **Continuous Learner****.** You're always learning, growing, and questioning how things were done in the past to make them even better.

A college degree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills to do the job. Other acceptable experiences could include:
* One to two years of prior work experience or internships in Retail, Marketing, Business Development, Food Service, Insurance Sales, or another relevant industry, OR
* Military experience We recognize and appreciate the unique talents and experiences Veterans bring to the table. We value the discipline, commitment, and problem\-solving abilities you have developed and are excited to provide an environment where you can continue to make a meaningful impact.
**Bonus points for these:** *Preferred Qualifications*


* Prior quota\-carrying experience
* Ability to successfully build a network and effectively use social media for sales

**YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:**
* **Be yourself** in a culture that values equity, inclusion, and belonging and creates a safe space for diverse perspectives and insights.
* **Belong** by joining one of our Business Resource Groups where you can connect globally with networks and allies who share common interests and experiences.
* **Grow your career** in an agile, fast\-paced environment with plenty of opportunities to progress.
* **Continuously learn** through ongoing training, development, and mentorship opportunities.
* **Be your healthiest.** Best\-in\-class benefits start on Day 1 because healthy associates are happy ones.
* **Balance work and life.** Resources and flexibility to more easily integrate your work and your life.
* **Focus on your mental health and well\-being.** We're here to provide exceptional service to our clients, and none of that happens without each of us taking care of ourselves and being there for one another.
* **Join a company committed to giving back** and generating a lasting, positive impact upon the communities in which we work and live.
* **Get paid to pay it forward.** Company\-paid time off for volunteering for causes you care about.

What are you waiting for? **Apply today!**

Base salary offers for this position may vary based on factors such as location, skills, and relevant experience. Some positions may include additional compensation in the form of bonus, equity or commissions. We offer the following benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Matched Retirement Savings, Wellness Program, Short\-and Long\-Term Disability, Charitable Contribution Match, Holidays, Personal Days \& Vacation, Paid Volunteer Time Off, and more. The compensation for this role is USD $40,200\.00 \- USD $79,800\.00 / Year\*

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Sales Development Representative**
====================================

  

**Date:** Aug 31, 2026


**Location:** San Jose, California, United States


**Company:** Super Micro Computer


**Job Req ID: 30042**
---------------------


**About Supermicro:**
---------------------


Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. We are the \#5 fastest growing company among the Silicon Valley Top 50 technology firms. Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. We seek talented, passionate, and committed engineers, technologists, and business leaders to join us.  

  



**Job Summary:**
----------------


We are looking for a high energy, driven, Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join our team. This role is responsible for proactive outbound prospecting through cold calling, email, LinkedIn, and strategic multi\-channel outreach to book qualified meetings for the Sales Team. The SDR will research target accounts, identify key technical and executive stakeholders, and prioritize organizations based on infrastructure fit and growth signals. Success in this role requires strong communication skills, persistence, and the ability to engage senior decision makers in meaningful business conversations. While they don’t close the sale, the SDR will collaborate closely with business development and sales teams to break into strategic accounts and support pipeline growth. This role also requires maintaining accurate activity tracking and pipeline management within Salesforce and sales engagement tools. Candidates should be highly driven, coachable, and comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, performance\-focused environment.


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
------------------------------------------


**Includes the following essential duties and responsibilities (other duties may also be assigned):**


* Contact new prospects through cold calls and emails
* Identify client needs and suggest appropriate related products/services
* Build long\-term trusting relationships
* Qualify and contact potential net new customers
* Daily Metrics achieved (Calls, Emails, etc.)
**Qualifications:**
-------------------


* Hands\-on experience leveraging a multi\-threaded sales approach (Cold Email, LinkedIn, Cold Call, Social Media) Preferred
* Bachelors Degree in business administration, Communication, Marketing or related subjects
* 1 year of SDR experience selling to Enterprise Organizations Preferred
* Experience in using an Outbound Prospecting Strategy Preferred
* Track record of achieving sales quotas
* Experience with CRM software (e.g. Salesforce)
* Experience with cadence software (e.g. Outreach, SalesLoft)
* Familiarity with MS Excel (analyzing spreadsheets and charts)
* Understanding of sales performance metrics
* Aptitude for utilizing data, insights \& resources to develop a compelling selling story
* Strong communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills, both internally and externally. Ability to engage with a variety of technical and business leaders.
* Whatever it takes" attitude and motivation to deliver above\-quota performance
**Salary Range**
----------------

  

  

$31/hour \- $34/hour


The salary offered will depend on several factors, including your location, level, education, training, specific skills, years of experience, and comparison to other employees already in this role. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as participation in bonus and equity award programs.


**EEO Statement**
-----------------


Supermicro is an Equal Opportunity Employer and embraces diversity in our employee population. It is the policy of Supermicro to provide equal opportunity to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status or special disabled veteran, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Field Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Join our growing team of dedicated professionals at a dynamic, medium\-sized company experiencing continued expansion. We’re seeking an **industry experienced** **Field Sales Representative** to manage and grow our presence across **The Bay Area, California.**


In this critical, customer\-facing role, you’ll work directly with OEM and Contract Manufacturing customers, building strong relationships and delivering solution\-oriented sales support. The ideal candidate is highly motivated, thrives in the field, and enjoys partnering with customers to understand their needs and drive results.


We offer the opportunity to make a meaningful impact within a financially stable organization that values collaboration, accountability, and long\-term success. If you’re looking for a role where your contributions truly matter and your growth is supported, we’d love to hear from you.

**What You’ll Do**

* Build and nurture strong, long\-term relationships with customers, becoming their trusted business partner.
* Drive account growth by identifying opportunities to expand our product offerings within existing customer accounts.
* Analyze customer histories and future needs to offer tailored, best\-in\-class solutions.
* Collaborate with Power Sales Engineers to capture new business and secure design registrations, particularly in power, thermal, and battery solutions.
* Maintain close relationships with suppliers to ensure customer satisfaction and product availability.
* Work closely with the Inside Sales Team to ensure seamless service delivery and support for all customer needs.
**What You Bring**

* 1\-2 years of proven industry\-related experience in a technical, customer\-facing role, ideally working with engineering teams.
* Intermediate experience in Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including proper grammar and professional tone.
* Strong organizational, time management, and multitasking abilities.
* Exceptional analytical, interpersonal, and communication skills.
**Compensation**

* Annual Base Salary Range: $70,304 – 91,800
* Annual Total Compensation Range (Base \+ Incentive): $110,173 – 153,000

The typical compensation structure includes a base salary representing approximately 60% of the total target income and a monthly incentive opportunity representing about 40% of the total target income. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, experience, education, and skill level. Final details will be confirmed at the time of offer.

**Why Join Us?**


At Sager Electronics, we value our team members and strive to provide a comprehensive benefits package for full\-time employees. Here is what you can expect:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance to keep you and your family healthy.
* 401(k)/Roth plan with matching, ensuring your financial future is secure.
* Healthcare Savings Accounts for added flexibility in managing medical expenses.
* Educational Assistance (Tuition Reimbursement) to support your ongoing learning and development.
* Continuous training opportunities throughout your employment, empowering you to grow both personally and professionally.
* A strong commitment to giving back to our communities through philanthropic opportunities and volunteer hours.
* We understand the importance of work\-life balance, and our Paid Time Off is designed to support our employees' well\-being.


Sager Electronics, a TTI, Inc. Company, is a North American distributor of Interconnect, Power and Electromechanical components from leading manufacturers worldwide and a provider of custom value\-add solutions. Grounded in over 135 years of innovation and service, Sager Electronics provides customers and suppliers a unique combination of operational excellence and innovative business solutions through its Distributing Confidence® business model. Headquartered in Middleborough, MA, Sager operates a national network of field sales representatives and power systems sales engineers, ten strategically located service centers, and a value\-added Custom Solutions Center in Lewisville, TX. To learn more about us, visit www.sager.com


To perform the position, you must be a U.S. Person as defined by ITAR. ITAR defines a U.S. Person as a U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident (i.e., ‘Green Card Holder’), Political Asylee, or Refugee.

**About the Role:**


We are seeking a Client Success Manager to own the post\-sale client journey for assigned new business accounts\- from signed deal through launch, activation, early adoption, and handoff into ongoing account management. This role serves as the primary relationship owner and cross\-functional coordinator during the early post\-sale phase, working closely with Sales, Regional Sales Coordinators, Operations, Adoption, Engagement, Customer Care, and Account Management.


The goal is a seamless transition from signed account to active, engaged client\- reducing friction, accelerating time to value, surfacing risk early, and bringing in the right specialist resources at the right time.


The Client Success Manager is the primary post\-sale relationship owner and "quarterback" across the early client lifecycle, accountable for client readiness, launch coordination, onboarding progress, standard\-account adoption execution, early engagement, and risk management. The role doesn't personally own every specialist workstream, but ensures each one happens successfully.


This is not a quota\-carrying role. Success is measured by how effectively clients launch, activate, adopt key products and workflows, engage early, and transition cleanly into ongoing account management.


**You Will:**


***Own the post\-sale relationship and launch orchestration***


* Serve as the primary point of contact from signed deal through onboarding and early adoption.
* Lead the handoff from Sales, ensuring client goals, use cases, stakeholders, and launch priorities are clearly understood and documented.
* Build 60–90 day onboarding milestones and success plans so clients know what success looks like and can achieve early wins.
* Maintain proactive, coordinated communication with clients and internal stakeholders to keep launches on track.

* Loop in the Adoption Specialist for top\-tier, high\-risk, or complex accounts.

***Partner with the Adoption Specialist on strategy and high\-touch accounts***

***Partner with Engagement and Lifecycle teams to deepen usage***


* Work with Engagement Strategy \& Performance and Customer Lifecycle Marketing to ensure clients get the right communications, campaigns, and enablement programs.
* Use engagement reporting and health signals to prioritize interventions.
* Connect clients to the right in\-life programs as they move from onboarding into sustained engagement.

***Monitor account health and manage risk***


* Track usage, activation milestones, and health signals to catch stalled onboarding, weak adoption, or early churn risk.
* Escalate early and coordinate support across Adoption, Engagement, Customer Care, Operations, and Account Management.
* Ensure critical issues stay owned and teams stay aligned on actions and timing.

***Act as the voice of the client internally***


* Share feedback, adoption insights, and emerging needs with Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Care, and Client Success leadership.

***Support a clean handoff into ongoing account management***

* Time to onboarding completion and time to first value
* Activation and seat activation rate
* Adoption of priority products, workflows, and features
* Usage frequency, engagement depth, and health score movement
* Participation in training, webinars, and lifecycle programs
* Early identification and escalation of churn risk or stalled onboarding
* Quality of handoff into ongoing account management

**Cross\-Functional Partnerships**


* **Sales Account Executives** — post\-sale handoff and continuity from signed deal into launch
* **Regional Sales Coordinators** — order processing, account setup/changes, billing coordination
* **Operations and Fulfillment** — provisioning, entitlements, technical readiness, launch execution
* **Adoption Specialists** — onboarding strategy, playbooks, training, high\-touch support
* **Engagement Strategy \& Performance / Customer Lifecycle Marketing** — health monitoring, engagement plays, in\-life programs
* **Enterprise Customer Care \& Voice of Customer** — escalations, white\-glove service, feedback loops
* **Account Managers** — transition planning and ongoing relationship continuity

**You Have:**


* 5 years of experience in client success, onboarding, implementation, account coordination, or related post\-sale roles in B2B, Saa

jobs.title: People Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
As the People Operations Coordinator, you'll be the go\-to partner ensuring VTS runs smoothly and employees feel supported from day one. You'll own key people processes like onboarding, benefits support, and payroll coordination, while serving as a first point of contact for our team. This role is a great opportunity to grow your People Operations skills and make a direct impact on the employee experience.


**\*\* Please note that this opportunity is located in New York, NY, and requires this hire to work from our office four days a week. \*\***


**Here's what you can expect as a People Operations Coordinator:**


* You'll build relationships with our amazing team and support our fast\-paced business
* Partner with the People Operations team to coordinate and implement initiatives related to people processes, benefits and company\-wide projects.
* Lead the new hire People Operations and Benefits orientation sessions, making a great first impression for all new VTS team members
* Support ad\-hoc reporting and track progress on key People initiatives
* Coordinate and document core talent processes, including onboarding, offboarding, and new hire communications
* Manage monthly benefits billing reconciliation and act as the first point of contact for benefit\-related inquiries.
* Oversee administrative tasks for HRIS and benefits systems with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Collaborate with the Finance team on global payroll reviews
* Serve as a primary point of contact for employee questions on benefits and People processes


**To thrive in this role you should have:**


* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources or a related field
* Strong attention to detail, critical thinking abilities, and organizational skills.
* You are solutions driven and love solving problems
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* You have a receptiveness to learning and an inquisitive mindset
* Love working with details and find accuracy important to your work ethic
* Ability to multitask and be flexible in your day to day work
* Ability to maintain confidentiality at all times


**What VTS Values \& How We Show It:**


* **Strive for Excellence \-** We know your potential is unlimited. Take advantage of our executive coaches and our training and career development programs available to all employees!
* **Be Customer Obsessed** \- We're employee obsessed too! VTS offers competitive compensation, comprehensive health benefits (including dental and vision), pre\-tax commuter benefits, and a 401(k) plan. Not to mention the fun stuff \- monthly happy hours, wellness events, clubs, and team lunches! \\
* **Be Curious \-** Benefit from a culture that promotes new learning. VTS offers an education stipend to all employees! Move as One \- We work in an open floor plan to promote cross\-functional collaboration.
* **Take Ownership \-** Be an owner of the company you're building with our equity packages.
* **Appreciate the Difference** \- VTS embraces and celebrates diversity. We understand the importance of a strong work\-life balance. We offer a flexible PTO policy, generous family leave program, and more!

  


**About VTS:**



VTS is the commercial real estate industry's only technology company that unifies owners, operators, brokers, and tenants in a single platform to capitalize on opportunities revealed in every square foot of their properties. In 2013, VTS revolutionized the commercial real estate industry's leasing operations with what is now VTS Lease. Today, the VTS Platform is the largest first\-party data source in the industry, transforming how strategic decisions are made and executed by CRE professionals across the globe.

  


With the VTS Platform, consisting ofVTS Lease, VTS Market, VTS Activate, and VTS Data, every business stakeholder in commercial real estate is given real\-time market information and workflow tools to do their job with unparalleled speed and intelligence. VTS is the global leader, with more than 60% of Class A office space in the U.S., and 12 billion square feet of office, retail, and industrial space is managed through our platform worldwide. VTS' user base includes over 45,000 CRE professionals and industry\-leading customers such as Blackstone, Brookfield Properties, LaSalle Investment Management, Hines, BXP, Oxford Properties, JLL, and CBRE. To learn more about VTS, and to see our open roles, visit www.vts.com.

  


VTS maintains offices in New York City, London, Toronto, Chicago, and San Francisco.

  



To learn more about VTS and to see our open roles, visit us at vts.com or follow us on Instagram (@WeAreVTS), Twitter (@WeAreVTS), or LinkedIn.

  

**Pay Transparency**



At VTS, we pride ourselves on articulating a clear and transparent philosophy around equitable, impartial compensation that will allow us to recruit and retain an exceptional team. The base salary is market\-driven at the time of offer and is based on tier 1 market data. The salary for this role will range between $60,000 and $70,000 and is determined by several factors, including your skills, prior relevant experience, quality of interviews, leveling, and geography.

  

**EEO Guidelines**



VTS embraces diversity and equal opportunity in a serious way. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be.



All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. For more information about what we collect and how we use it, please refer to the Candidate Privacy Statement.

**Please Note: This is a temporary, full\-time position.**  


**Position Summary:** New York City Public Schools (NYCPS ) is dedicated to creating and supporting partnerships among schools, families, and the community. As a central resource for family engagement, the Office of Family and Community Empowerment (FACE) strives to involve and inform parent leaders as essential partners in helping students achieve college and career readiness. FACE will develop and implement new strategies to strengthen the NYCPS’s efforts to engage and support public school parents and families throughout New York City.  



The CCEC Election Outreach Coordinators will play a critical role in engaging with community members and building networks to promote the 2027 Community and Citywide Education Council (CCEC) Elections. We are seeking passionate, driven, and organized individuals to conduct direct outreach to families in local communities across the city. They will encourage people to run and vote through direct outreach and advocacy and help eliminate disparities in the elections by engaging communities that have typically participated less in elections. Each coordinator will collect outreach and engagement data to be used for metrics. Performs related work.  


**Reports to:** CCEC Election Campaign Manager  


**Key Relationships:** Family\-facing staff at school, district and central level including but not limited to Superintendents, Family Leadership Coordinators, Family Support Coordinators, Parent Coordinators, parent leaders and FACE staff.  


**Responsibilities**  


* Community Engagement: Build and maintain relationships with district staff and leadership, school staff and families.
* Grassroots Mobilization: Participate in school and other events where large numbers of families are in attendance to inform and inspire active participation.
* Outreach and Communication: Coordinate, execute and track strategies for outreach, including canvassing, phone banking, and digital campaigns.
* Data Management: Track community engagement efforts, monitor progress, and report on outcomes.
* Public Relations: Represent the campaign in community settings.

  


**Qualifications**  

Minimum

High school graduation or equivalent and one (1\) year of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties described above.  


**Preferred**
* Familiarity with the New York City public school system.
* Experience with community organization and the ability to work with diverse populations.
* Strong interpersonal, communication and audience engagement skills (verbal and written).
* Experience with data entry and management.
* Strong Microsoft Office skills in Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.

  



Work Schedule: Typically, 1:00 PM–8:00 PM in\-office or the field; may occasionally be asked to begin work earlier in the day or later in the day to cover an event that is scheduled to run later.

(Internal candidates who are selected for this position and who currently hold comparable or less senior positions within the DOE will not earn less than their current salary.)

**NOTE: The filling of all positions is subject to budget availability and/or grant funding.**

**We encourage all applicants from the New York City tri\-state area to apply.**

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job ID: 1165656\_RR00123632


Facility: NYU Grossman School of Medicine


Position Type: Full\-Time/Regular


Shift: Day


Schedule: Monday – Friday, 9am – 5pm


Department: Research, NYU Grossman School of Medicine, Perlmutter CancerCtr (S580\),


  
**Position Summary:**


We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Clinical Research Coordinator. The Oncology Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) is an active participant in the coordination of oncology clinical trials from research planning and throughout the conduct of clinical trials. The Oncology CRC performs study coordination tasks under the direction of the principal investigator/treating investigator, under the supervision of the CTO management/leadership and works closely with the Oncology Clinical Research Nurses (CRNs), Oncology Clinical Research Coordinators (CRCs), Data Coordinator Unit (DCU) staff and other CTO and PCC staff to ensure patient safety, overall compliance in the conduct of the study, and adherence to the approved study protocol and quality clinical trial data collection.


**Job Responsibilities:**


* Competent in all recruitment and pre\-screening activities identifying diverse patients who may be eligible for clinical trials. Promptly follows up pre\-screening requests and iConnect requests within 24 business hours. Supports the training and mentorship of aCRCs in learning these tasks.
* Collaborates with investigators, CTO staff and NYU/PCC staff to ensure a safe, compliant screening process by supporting seamless navigation of patients onto study from pre\-screening, through the consenting process, through the screening period and to eligibility. Supports thorough, efficient and safe screening research visit(s) in collaboration with other departmental staff and under the direct supervision of the PI/investigator. Supports a safe and compliant eligibility process, following internal and external SOPs/policies and ensuring a timely, accurate and complete eligibility packet for the PI/Sib\-I review and sign\-off.
* Supports the informed consent discussion with the subject under the direct supervision of the PI/treating investigator and/or in collaboration with the departmental staff including but not limited to: the study schedule of events, event reporting requirements, the use of the IRB, study related reimbursement etc. (Assessment and medical/nursing education must be performed by a licensed clinician). Supports the training of aCRCs in these tasks.
* Follows institutional and department policies and standard operating procedures such as relevant NYU, OSR, IRB and CTO policies, procedures and standard operating procedures to ensure safe, compliant and quality research conduct.
* Demonstrates understanding of protocol elements and requirements. Collaborates with department staff to develop tracking forms for all active trials, maintain tracking forms throughout the life cycle of the protocol and support a double check of tracking forms for patient safety and quality data acquisition. Performs study specific procedures and tasks under the supervision of the Principal Investigator/treating investigator and CTO management/leadership and in collaboration with the team.
* Provides timely and complete updates to study team members regarding changes to workflow or patient\-related specific needs according to protocol modifications.
* Communicates effectively with patients and investigators about non\-clinical study related concerns such as the schedule of events, trial related reimbursement or transportation.
* Schedules study participants according to the approved protocol; coordinates with ancillary service providers to ensure patients remain adherent to the protocol; coordinate subjects tests and procedures in compliance with the particular protocol and with the appropriate department, and collaborates with other NYU and PCC departments to seamlessly navigate a patient to a trial and through screening, treatment and follow up/end of treatment. Coordinates with ancillary service providers to ensure patients remain adherent to the protocol.
* Prepares for study visits: research bio\-specimen collection order preparation/placement, laboratory and EKG order placement, scheduling of biopsies and scans, facilitating RECIST form completion from the investigator, AE and ConMed form completion in conjunction with a licensed professional (CRN/APP/MD) and other tasks as needed to support the administrative conduct of clinical trials. Supports the training and support of the aCRC in the team for these tasks.
* Maintains a working knowledge of active and pipeline clinical trials within the DMG and regularly updates the DMG schemas. Oversees that the DMG schema is maintained up\-to\-date on a monthly basis and trains aCRCs for this task.
* Understands adverse event reporting per protocol and per institutional and FDA guidelines including AE, SAE, ECI, UADE, SUSAR and RNI.
* Maintains trackers to ensure patients remain compliant with study specific requirements and tasks.
* Follows CTO processes and policies for treatment clearance and supports effective, clear communication.
* Acts as primary point of contact for all bio\-specimen collections. Utilizes EPIC and LabVantage to complete research biospecimen orders in a timely manner.
* Compiles and submits weekly patient treatment lists to investigational pharmacy and RBMU and other departments as needed.
* Monitors infusion chair assignments; ensures patient assignments are aligned with protocol requirements; make necessary requests for changes on as\-needed basis.
* May perform EKGs with documented training. Ensures that all study specific EKG machines are tracked and maintained within the DMG safely and securely. Takes initiative to address any sponsor EKG machines issues in a timely manner.
* Performs concomitant medication review including reconciliation of the medication list, verification of drug/dose taken and diary review if applicable, appropriate documenta

**ORGANIZATION DESCRIPTION**




Founded in 1965, the Chinese\-American Planning Council (CPC) is a social services organization advancing the social and economic well\-being of immigrant and low\-income New Yorkers through holistic services and community\-led impact. CPC is the nation’s largest Asian American social services organization and serves as a trusted community anchor to over 80,000 community members who are served by CPC annually through 50\+ high\-quality programs and services across 35 sites in New York City. (For more information, please visit: https://www.cpc\-nyc.org).


**JOB SUMMARY**




The Development Coordinator provides essential operational and fundraising support to CPC’s Development team. Under the supervision of the Donor Database Manager, the Coordinator assists with the day\-to\-day execution of established systems, workflows, and administrative processes, including gift and pledge processing, donor acknowledgements, Salesforce data maintenance, reconciliation, reporting, and department coordination. Working closely with the Donor Database Manager and other Development team members, the Coordinator helps ensure accurate records, timely donor recognition, and efficient fundraising operations.


**ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Donor Engagement**

* Draft acknowledgment of letters and tax receipts for all gifts in accordance with established gift processing procedures to ensure timely, accurate, and meaningful donor recognition.
* Conduct prospect and donor research as needed to support fundraising efforts and maintain accurate donor information.

**Data Management:**

* Support the Donor Database Manager with Salesforce data entry and data hygiene, including donor information, donor relationships, pledges, donations, workplace giving, and matching gifts across multiple platforms.
* Assist with reconciling gift records with the Finance team monthly and annually.
* Assist with preparing reports for internal and external stakeholders to track fundraising progress and evaluate fundraising efforts.

**Development Operations:**

* Contribute to the creation and implementation of the fundraising plan; conduct periodic check\-ins and assessments throughout the year.
* Prepare check requests, credit card expense reports, and invoices.
* Schedule meetings, maintain calendar, organize notes and documentation, and send reminders for the team.

**Other:**

* Provide administrative and logistical support for major fundraising events.
* Support Development team initiatives and perform special projects and other duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**




**Education and Experience:**

* Associate degree or higher and at least 2 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in nonprofit fundraising, development operations, database administration, or a related field.
* Relevant or transferable experience in required responsibilities; familiarity with the AAPI, immigrant, and low\-income communities.

**Skills and Competencies:**

* Proficient in Salesforce and Microsoft Office Suite; technologically proficient and quick to learn new systems. Experience with Concur, PaperSave, Robin, Canva, or similar systems preferred.
* Exhibit a high level of discretion, professionalism, and an ethical approach to fundraising.
* Ability to work independently on assigned responsibilities with limited supervision while collaborating effectively as part of a team.
* Exceptional attention to detail, critical thinking, organizational skills, project management skills, and commitment to data accuracy.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, dependable, and solutions\-oriented, with the judgment to troubleshoot routine issues and escalate when appropriate.
* Flexibility in varied job assignments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and reliability.
* Willing to contribute across Development team priorities as needed.

**COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS OVERVIEW**




* $30\.00 \- $36\.00 per hour; 35 hours per week with occasional evenings and weekends
* CPC offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package, including but not limited to generous paid time off (holiday, sick and vacation time), Medical, Dental, Vision, Basic Life Insurance Coverage, Commuter Benefits, and a 403(b) Retirement Plan

Interested individuals should submit their resume, along with a cover letter addressed to Chloe Wong, when applying online via CPC’s website: https://www.cpc\-nyc.org/jobs or selected online job boards. jobs.title: Event Operations Manager
jobs.description:
As a Zuma Event Operations Manager, you are responsible for the seamless operational execution of private events and special functions at Zuma, overseeing each event from pre\-event preparation through on\-site execution and post\-event follow\-up. Working closely with Events Sales, restaurant management, culinary teams, and other departments, this role ensures the highest standards of service for a discerning, often high\-profile clientele while supporting daily restaurant operations as a Floor Manager when event volume permits.

  

Zuma is a contemporary Japanese restaurant collection, inspired by the dynamic Izakaya dining style. Our global collection includes four venues across North America's most iconic cities: Miami, New York, Las Vegas, and Boston. Our venues are icons in each of their hospitality landscapes, demonstrating our commitment to excellence and to elevating our guest experiences. Zuma in proud to be part of the Azumi collection.

 **Life at Zuma**


At Zuma, we're more than a restaurant – we're a vibrant community fuelled by the energy that flows from our Robata grills, guided by our core values:

**Honor the Mastery** \- we celebrate every detail, always striving for perfection – putting pride in everything we do

**Do Unto Others** \- we support each other to be at our best, treating every team member and guest with warmth and openness

**Embrace the Energy** \- we bring passion and positivity to everything we do

 **Main Duties**


Your key responsibilities will include:

* Lead the operational execution of private events, buyouts, and special functions from setup through breakdown, ensuring all details meet client expectations and Zuma standards
* Review BEOs, floor plans, menus, timelines, guest profiles, and special requests in advance to ensure operational readiness
* Partner closely with the Events Sales team to transition confirmed events from planning into seamless operational execution
* Coordinate with FOH, Culinary, Bar, Sommelier, Facilities, and other departments to align staffing, setup, service requirements, and event timelines
* Lead pre\-event briefings and provide direction to service teams, ensuring clear understanding of event details, VIPs, service expectations, timing, and individual responsibilities
* Oversee event setup, including room configuration, table arrangements, service stations, equipment, and other operational requirements
* Manage event service in real time, monitoring timing, service flow, food and beverage execution, and overall presentation while proactively resolving operational challenges
* Responsible to accurately ring in all event sales in accordance to event contract into the POS and ensure proper financial SOPs are upheld
* Serve as the primary operational point of contact during events, coordinating with event hosts and internal teams to accommodate requests and changes as needed
* Manage high\-profile and VIP events with professionalism, discretion, and careful attention to guest preferences and special requirements
* Conduct post\-event reviews and identify opportunities to improve event procedures, service standards, training, and overall execution
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of the restaurant’s private dining spaces, capacities, layouts, menus, and operational capabilities
* Support daily restaurant operations as a Floor Manager when event volume permits, including overseeing service, supporting the FOH team, and addressing guest needs

 **What We Look For**


Our ideal candidate embodies our values and the following:

* 3\+ years of progressive restaurant or event operations management experience, preferably within high\-volume, luxury or premium dining, hotels, or event\-driven hospitality environments
* Strong understanding of luxury restaurant operations, elevated service standards, and event execution
* Proven ability to interpret BEOs, floor plans, event timelines, and detailed operational requirements
* Strong leadership and communication skills with the ability to effectively coordinate teams across multiple departments and interact professionally with guests
* Exceptional organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple events and competing priorities simultaneously
* Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to anticipate challenges and make effective decisions in high\-pressure environments
* Ability to manage multiple events and competing priorities simultaneously
* Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as required

 **Benefits**


We offer incredible career growth, international opportunities, and the chance to contribute to a world\-renowned brand, where every detail from the finest ingredients to our unrivalled atmosphere is crafted to perfection.


As part of our team, you’ll enjoy:

* **World\-Class training,** designed to inspire and educate
* **Global opportunities**, experience hospitality around the globe with our five incredible brands
* **Health Benefits:** Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance to ensure your well\-being
* **Bonus Opportunity**, eligible roles may participate in our annual bonus program, rewarding individual and business performance
* **401(k) Retirement Plan,** supporting your long\-term financial well\-being and future goals
* **Family Meals** are shared daily
* **Rewards \& Recognition,** we value our team and celebrate your contributions to our success with meaningful rewards and recognition
* **Staff discount,** enjoy exclusive discounts across the Azumi group, worldwide!

 **Our Commitment to Inclusivity**


We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome all applicants. If you require any assistance to make the recruitment process more accessible, please let one of our Talent Acquisition team know.

 **Ready to create some magic?** Join us and bring your talent to a team that’s elevating contemporary dining on a global stage.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
New York
Product
In office
Full\-time
**What is Bilt?**
Bilt is the membership for where you live.  

  

What started as a way to reward people on their largest expense has turned into an ecosystem connecting our members, property managers and local merchants.
Travel, dining, fitness, everyday spend. We are building systems across payments, credit, loyalty, and commerce all at once.  

  

We run lean and move quickly. Every person here has a real impact on what gets built and how fast it happens.  

  

This role comes with real ownership and high expectations. If you prefer clearly defined lanes and structure, this will feel uncomfortable. If you want to build quickly, have a real say in what gets built, and work on products used by millions, you will likely do your best work here.
**What’s the role?**
As a Technical Account Manager, you'll own the technical relationship for a portfolio of our enterprise and retail partners, making sure the product we build actually fits how they operate — both for their initial launch and for everything we build after. You'll be the connective tissue between what partners need and what our product and engineering teams ship, translating real\-world partner requirements into roadmap input while also owning the technical integration work that gets them live. While this person must have strong technical acumen and relationship management skills, they must also demonstrate a self\-starter attitude and creative problem\-solving. This is an exciting opportunity to join at the ground floor of a new product line at Bilt: a retail platform that orchestrates a seamless, personalized user experience across every merchant in the neighborhood. Experience in the payments space is strongly preferred. Experience supporting enterprise partners, along with retail \& POS integrations, is a plus.  

  

**In this role, you will…**
* Partner with product and engineering during pre\-launch to make sure new integrations and capabilities are scoped to fit the actual needs of enterprise and retail partners, not just the technical spec.
* Own the end\-to\-end launch process for your assigned partners, ensuring our API\-driven platform fits seamlessly into each partner's ecosystem from day one.
* Act as the voice of the partner internally, surfacing recurring needs, gaps, and feedback to product and engineering to influence what we build next.
* Be an expert on our integrations and capabilities, able to present these concepts concisely to client management, executive leadership, and the partner itself.
* Own and manage a book of assigned partners post\-launch, troubleshooting recurring technical issues, driving escalations to resolution, and documenting bugs with a focus on completion.
* Run technical calls spanning our retail partners, payment device team, and payment processors, aligning all parties on a single path to launch
* Serve as the technical escalation point for your portfolio, working in a rapid\-pace environment to analyze urgency and collaborate across internal teams.
* Collaborate with product and engineering on ticket documentation, test plans, end\-to\-end validation in test environments, and monitoring data after deployments.
* Identify new capabilities, technology partners, and integration opportunities that expand what we can offer partners.
* Facilitate knowledge sharing across teams by creating internal and external training material, such as configuration setup guides, FAQ documents, and flow diagrams.
* Have a base knowledge of SQL and Postman to quickly validate information and resolve integration issues.
  

  

**In terms of qualifications, we’re seeking:**
* 5\+ years in a technical account management, solutions engineering, implementation, or partner engineering role
* Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, webhooks, and how to read/write API specifications
* Working knowledge of SQL and Postman to independently investigate and validate issues
* Experience in payments (processing, card networks, or payment operations) — strongly preferred
* Familiarity with loyalty/rewards programs and POS/retail hardware — a plus
* Track record of owning technical relationships with external partners, including scoping, launch, and post\-launch support
* Comfort operating across ambiguity — this is a new product line, and priorities will shift as we learn
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to flex between engineering\-level detail and executive\-level summary
* Experience troubleshooting production issues under time pressure, including coordinating across multiple internal and external teams
  

  

**Benefits:**
* **Compensation** \- We offer a competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity and our performance bonus program
* **Health insurance for you (\& your loved ones) from day one** \- Enjoy a One Medical Membership, wellness stipends, family programs and more, on us. We’ve got you and your family covered from day one.
* **401k plan with a match** \- Retirement may feel more like a pipe dream than a reality but we’re here to help you get there.
* **Commuter FSAs** \- We believe the best ideas come from being together in one place. We just don’t think getting there should be so expensive.
* **UNLIMITED PTO** \- Because we believe that working hard shouldn’t mean always working. Take time for you as often as you need it.
* **Exclusive Employee only Bilt Points** \- We give our employees unique opportunities to earn points throughout their time at Bilt.
* **Team Events** \- We believe in human connection so we hold events to help our employees break from the monotony of the typical work week.
  

  

At Bilt Rewards, we believe in transparency and we do our best to make sure the company and our candidates are on the same page as it relates to compensation. In addition to posting salary ranges for our open roles, candidates should expect to be asked about compensation expectations and requirements early on in their int

Your next great move.

* Experience managing a major brand sponsorship from planning through execution
* Familiarity with NFL rights, intellectual\-property guidelines, approvals, and seasonal milestones
* Experience supporting integrated programs across content, media, social, experiential, hospitality, and retail
* Experience managing agency partners, production vendors, and event teams
* Experience developing asset trackers, activation calendars, budgets, and proof\-of\-performance reports
* Interest in sports, consumer brands, pets, or lifestyle marketing

* All contracted assets and deliverables are clearly tracked, communicated, and executed on time
* The client has a reliable day\-to\-day partner who understands both the details and the broader business objectives
* Internal and external stakeholders remain aligned on responsibilities, deadlines, and next steps
* Meetings are organized, decisions are documented, and follow\-ups are consistently closed
* Programs move efficiently from planning and approvals through execution and reporting
* Potential risks, delays, or missed opportunities are identified and addressed early
* Client materials are clear, accurate, polished, and ready for senior\-level audiences
* The account operates with a high level of responsiveness, organization, accountability, and attention to detail

  

**Job Requirements**
* Essential duties are performed onsite in the New York, NY office with some nights weekends and/or travel for client programs and events

jobs.title: Associate Account Manager
jobs.description:
### **Who We Are**



VML is a leading creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce, creating connected brands to drive growth. VML is celebrated for its innovative and award\-winning human\-first work for clients including AstraZeneca, Colgate\-Palmolive, Dell, Ford, Microsoft, Nestlé, The Coca\-Cola Company, and Wendy's. In 2026, VML was named *Campaign's* Global Network of the Year and ranked \#2 Creative Network of the Year at Cannes Lions. VML's global network spans 55\+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.



VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.



For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn \#WeAreVML.

**Who we are looking for:**



VML is seeking an Associate Account Manager to support the day\-to\-day activities and creative execution of integrated campaigns over a notable global consumer packaged goods brand. You will be a client liaison overseeing delivery of work for a global new product launch, ensuring client approvals are secured, client objectives are achieved, and timelines and budgets are met. You will play a role in communicating externally with the clients while supporting our internal teams to keep all apprised of project status, updates and changes.


**What you'll do:**


* **Client Support \|** Build rapport and credibility with client based on trust, sound counsel, responsiveness to client needs and flawless execution. Develop and update both client and project documents including: creative briefs, estimates, project timelines, media plans, status reports, conference reports and other supporting materials.
* **Team \|** Collaborate with creative, project management, production, and/or media teams to develop marketing programs and solutions for client. Keep agency team informed of client requests and changes, anticipate potential problems, and proactively develop solutions.
* **Process \|** Review all documents and creative work prior to submitting to client for review. Organize client presentations, meetings and conference calls, and prepare relevant documents, including agendas, meeting materials and conference reports. Capture and interpret program results, summarize findings, and work with senior team members to recommend program enhancements and/or changes to improve going forward


**What you'll need:**


* 0\-1 years of advertising agency experience or equivalent internship experience
* Knowledge and interest in CPG marketing and 360 integrated campaigns
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
* An ability to build relationships and collaborate across teams, departments, vendors and clients to successfully accomplish work
* Strong attention to detail, organization, and professionalism
* Ability to effectively managing multiple projects, timelines, and deliverables simultaneously


**What we offer:**


* **Passionate, driven people** \| We champion a culture of people that do extraordinary work.
* **Consciously cultivated culture** \| We aim to embody the behaviors to build an inclusive community that is in it together, bringing both positivity and active listening into the workplace as we simultaneously strive to empower creative bravery.
* **Competitive benefits** \| What we offer full time hires ranges from the full spectrum of group health coverage options (medical, dental, vision) to a generous 401k match (100% dollar\-for\-dollar match, up to 5% of salary contribution), and a variety of paid time off offerings that reflect our investment in all aspects of your overall life balance and wellness.
* **Growth\-minded opportunities** \| We aim to nurture a culture of real\-time feedback, growth\-oriented mindset, and plenty of training opportunities through VML and WPP, so you can continue to grow personally and professionally.


We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.



WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

jobs.title: Etsy Account Manager
jobs.description:
Etsy Account Manager — Fine Jewelry (Full\-Time, On\-Site)

**About the role**

We're a fine jewelry company selling lab grown diamond engagement rings and jewelry online. We're looking for someone to manage and grow our Etsy shop. This is a hands\-on role for someone who already knows Shop Manager inside and out and wants full responsibility for a growing catalog.

**What you'll do**

* Create and maintain and update listings
* Keep pricing, variations, and inventory accurate across hundreds of listings
* Write and optimize titles, tags, and descriptions for Etsy search
* Respond to buyer messages and custom order inquiries within Etsy's response window
* Manage orders, shipping labels, tracking, and post\-sale follow\-up
* Run and monitor Etsy Ads, and report monthly on revenue, fees, ad spend, and conversion
* Handle returns, refunds, and cases while protecting shop metrics

**Requirements**

* 3\+ years managing an Etsy shop through Shop Manager, not just selling on Etsy
* Experience with listings that use multiple variation sets and large option matrices
* Working knowledge of Etsy SEO: titles, 13 tags, categories, attributes, and shop sections
* Comfortable in Excel or Google Sheets, including bulk upload and edit files
* Strong written English for buyer messages and product descriptions
* Detail\-oriented with SKUs, pricing, and inventory data.
* Able to follow a set process exactly, including naming conventions, character limits, and draft\-before\-publish rules

**Preferred**

* Fine jewelry or diamond industry background, or familiarity with carat, center stone shapes, 14K, lab grown, halo, pavé, solitaire
* Experience running Etsy Ads and reading the stats and traffic dashboards
* Basic photo work: cropping, resizing, reordering images, white background cleanup
* Familiarity with Star Seller metrics and case handling

**To apply**

Send your resume and a link to at least one Etsy shop you've personally managed.

Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

* Working with leadership across the company to set direction for the Enterprise team, and Plaid as a whole

* 10\+ years of professional experience, 5\+ years managing a revenue\-driving team
* Proven track record of success driving revenue results at a technology company; strong preference towards those with prior experience in finances services or with banking and wealth management firms as clients
* Consultative sales approach with a product\-centric mindset
* Strong ability to articulate complex technical solutions and financial value prop \- internally for cross\-functional collaboration and externally to customers, including an executive audience
* Strong analytical skills to understand customer trends at scale

* Ability to create strategic relationships with internal and external stakeholders
* Outstanding communication skills to drive internal alignment and results

jobs.description:
**Who are IDHL?**


IDHL is a leading digital agency helping ambitious brands find and unlock opportunities for growth.


Our services span strategy, brand, technology, and marketing, with specialists working across disciplines to solve complex challenges and deliver measurable results.


Continued investment in AI shapes how we work, from building knowledge and exploring new possibilities to putting them into practice across our business and client work.


IDHL is also home to Fostr, Vervaunt, and The MTM Agency, each with their own areas of focus across the digital landscape.


At the heart of it all is a focus on what matters: doing work we're proud of, making an impact for our clients, and supporting our people to do their best work.

**Hybrid working policy:** employees are commutable to New York City two days per week.

**Account Manager**

**Role Overview**


IDHL is one of Europe’s leading digital agencies \- and we’re at the start of an incredible journey in the US. This is a brand\-new growth phase, and with it comes huge opportunity for ambitious people who want to help shape something from the ground up.


As an Account Manager, you’ll be right at the centre of that momentum. You’ll build strong client relationships, identify new business opportunities, as we deliver performance\-led marketing strategies that drive measurable results. It’s a role for someone commercially minded, proactive, and ready to make a real impact in a fast\-moving, high\-growth environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop strong client relationships to support retention and uncover new revenue opportunities
* Lead generation, upselling, and renewal strategy across performance marketing services
* Contribute to client strategies and collaborate with internal teams to deliver results
* Compile monthly SEO performance reports and attend client meetings
* Identify growth opportunities and steer accounts toward long\-term success
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure client goals are met and exceeded

**Person Specification**

**Key Qualifications and Attributes:**

* Proven experience in a commercial sales or account management role
* Understanding of digital marketing solutions (performance marketing experience is a plus, but not essential)
* Track record of exceeding targets and driving revenue
* Excellent communication and relationship\-building skills
* Highly organised and able to manage documentation and reporting
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment
* Strong initiative and problem\-solving ability
* Commercially minded with a focus on outcomes
* Experience in a digital agency or client\-facing sales environment preferred
* Legal right to work in the United States

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Lucrative commission structure, 401(k) \+ healthcare
* Flexible \& hybrid working; we believe the best work happens when balance does too. Enjoy a hybrid setup that gives you the flexibility to do your best work.
* Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) \+ Public Holidays
* Enhanced Parental Leave
* “Time4You” Wellness Days; two extra days dedicated to you \- take time to pause, focus on your wellbeing, and come back feeling your best
