jobs.description:
**Are you looking to Optimize your life? Start your exciting path to a rewarding career today!**

  

We are Optimum, a leader in the fast\-paced world of connectivity, and we're seeking driven and enthusiastic professionals to join our team, empower lives, fuel businesses, and drive innovation. Connectivity is now longer a luxury, but a necessity. A career at Optimum means you'll be enabling progress and enhancing lives by providing reliable, high\-speed connectivity solutions that keep the world connected. Our successes, now and in the future, are powered by our amazing product, a commitment to our people and culture, and the connections we make in our communities.

  

If you are resourceful, collaborative, and passionate about delivering consistent excellence, Optimum is for you!


**Job Summary**
---------------



As a Community Account Manager, you will be assigned a portfolio of muti\-dwelling unit properties. The primary responsibility as CAM, is to grow and maintain market share by selling new movers, win\-back customers, and upgrade existing customers to maximize monthly recurring revenue. Additionally, our CAM, will develop and manage the onsite relationship with the leasing staff, to ensure we are maximizing the terms of our marketing agreement, driving growth through educating staff and residents about the value of our products and reliability of our service, while positioning Optimum favorably against competitors and for contract renewals. In this role, you will be assigned new properties ensuring we maximize MDU new build customer penetration by working with onsite sales personnel and internal field operations to be “first to the door”.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Consistent achievement of monthly sales, revenue quotas and key performance indicators.
* Coordinate marketing events and cultivate relationships with sales, leasing staff and HOA's representing our brand, products while providing service excellence.
* Conduct site and virtual visits with property staff, updating and replenishing sales collateral, and educating leasing staff about new and existing product offers and the value of the optimum brand.
* Schedule quarterly/semi\-annual reviews with property staff to “walk” the property, understand business trends and share property performance against established targets.
* Act as a liaison between property management and our internal Technical Operations, Construction Department and Sales Support to address service issues that impacts our ability to deliver on\-time and exceptional service.
* Timely tracking and reporting of all sales, events, visits, and property escalations.
* Act as a point of contact with Bulk Property management staff, coordinating new customer onboarding and de\-bulk events.
* All other duties assigned by your supervisor.
**Qualifications**
------------------


* 5\+ years related experience.
* Ability to travel up to 75%
* Strong communication skills are a must.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Office Suite programs is required.
* Business Development experience with emphasis on new customer acquisition and relationship management.
* Must be self\-motivated and able to work independently.
* Computer skills, including Windows\-based applications, and the ability to work within Salesforce and sales order entry and CRM platforms.
* Strong people and relationship management skills.
* Must possess and maintain a valid driver’s license in good standing within the state of current residence.


At Optimum, every action and interaction we take part in, is driven by our three Guiding Principles: Do What’s Right, Drive One Optimum, and Make It Happen. These aren’t just words, they help us build trust, create real community, and embrace new ways of thinking. Our employees are empowered to do the right thing for our customers and co\-workers and to recognize and reward these behaviors when we see them. It’s all part of the bigger picture of “Be The Difference” where each employee knows they have the power to enact real change, share new ideas, and understand that learning never stops.

  

If you have the drive to succeed and are ready to embark on a thrilling career, seize this opportunity today, and join our winning team. Together, we'll shape the future of connectivity.

jobs.title: Account Manager | Growth
jobs.description:
**About Ramp**
==============


Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.


The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving.


We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.


The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.


If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the Role**
==================


As a member of the Growth Account Management team, you will deliver value to our customers and revenue for our business by owning expansion and retention of a scaled portfolio of current Ramp customers. You will help identify growth opportunities within your portfolio and operate a set of scaled touch\-points to engage with these customers. As an early member of the team, you will have the opportunity to help build and refine Ramp’s scaled account management motion.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Identify expansion opportunities within a scaled portfolio of Ramp customers and own the entire sales process through close
* Develop and execute upsell/cross\-sell strategies and maintain a robust expansion pipeline
* Develop a deep understanding of Ramp customer personas and act as a trusted advisor and consultant to help them achieve their goals with Ramp
* Leverage sales methodologies to uncover customer needs and pain points
* Gather and provide customer feedback to directly inform Ramp’s product roadmap \& customer communication strategy
* Collaborate with cross\-functional partners to continuously improve operational efficiencies while also advocating for your customers

**What You Need**
-----------------

* Minimum 2 years of customer\-facing or direct sales experience
* Proven track record of achievement in a high velocity business environment
* Prior CRM experience (preferably Salesforce)
* Experience with outbound prospecting and conducting product demonstrations, with a high level of comfort with sales tools \& processes
* Consultative sales approach and comfortable leveraging analytical \& quantitative skills, with a deep interest in understanding business challenges
* Ability to discuss Ramp's value proposition with C\-level executives, finance teams, and decision makers
* Consistent track record of hitting or exceeding sales targets in a fast\-paced and metrics\-driven environment
* Dedication to tracking and improving performance and efficiency on a daily basis
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to deliver compelling sales pitches and presentations
* Organizational, project management, and time management skills
* Sense of entrepreneurship: a self\-starter with a high sense of urgency and ability to work within undefined processes

**Nice\-to\-Haves**
-------------------

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university
* Experience with financial services sales
* Experience at a high\-growth startup

**Benefits available to all full\-time Ramp employees (Global)**
----------------------------------------------------------------

* Flexible PTO
* Centralized home\-office equipment ordering
* Health and wellness stipend
* Budget for intra\-office travel
* Weekly coffee stipend

**United States**
-----------------

* 100% medical, dental \& vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents
* One Medical annual membership
* 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp
* Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay
* Pet insurance
* In\-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more
* Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

**Canada**
----------

* Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life
* Life, AD\&D, and disability coverage
* Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)
* Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP \+ DPSP)
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay
* Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

**United Kingdom**
------------------

* Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite
* Virtual GP and at\-home care via eMed x Livi
* Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

**Referral Instructions**
-------------------------


If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

  

**Other notices**
-----------------


Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Client Services Onsite Support Engineer
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

The Client Services Onsite Support Engineer is a full\-time position placed onsite at one of our client locations. Working as an embedded member of the client’s team, you serve as the primary frontline resource for users who need prompt, courteous, and effective technical support. In this role, you will respond to requests for assistance in person, by phone, and through support channels, while troubleshooting hardware, software, and basic system issues. The ideal candidate combines strong customer service skills with sound technical judgment, maintains accurate documentation, and delivers reliable support that helps end users remain productive. This position also plays an important role in escalating complex issues appropriately, following standard operating procedures, and contributing to a positive client support experience. This is a full\-time, onsite placement at a single client site and is not a remote position.  

  

The work schedule for this position will be 12:00PM \- 9:00PM ET Monday \- Friday.  


  

The ideal candidate will bring 2–5 years of experience in a helpdesk, desktop support, or technical support environment, with a demonstrated ability to troubleshoot common hardware, software, and user\-access issues effectively. This individual should be comfortable working directly with end users as an embedded member of a client’s team, managing multiple requests, and maintaining a service\-oriented approach in a fast\-paced setting. Basic industry certifications are a plus and may include credentials such as CompTIA A\+, CompTIA Network\+, Microsoft fundamentals, or similar entry\-level technical certifications.  


  

On a typical day, this role involves working onsite at the assigned client location, monitoring incoming support requests and assisting users with a wide range of technical needs. You will communicate with end users to gather relevant details, troubleshoot problems methodically, document actions taken, and ensure each issue is followed through to completion or properly escalated. Success in this role requires balancing responsiveness with accuracy, maintaining a professional and helpful demeanor, and contributing to a dependable support experience that reflects the standards of the Client Services team.  

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the first point of contact for the client’s end users and IT staff seeking technical assistance.

  

* Develop working familiarity with the client’s environment, systems, users, and standard operating procedures.

  

* Coordinate with the LISS Technologies Client Services team on escalations, documentation, and reporting.

  

* Respond to inbound incidents and service requests through phone, email, ticketing systems, and in\-person support.

  

* Troubleshoot and resolve basic to intermediate hardware, software, connectivity, and account access issues in a timely manner.

  

* Maintain end\-to\-end ownership of support requests, ensuring timely follow\-up, clear communication, and appropriate resolution.

  

* Document incidents, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and user interactions accurately within the designated support system.

  

* Escalate unresolved or high\-impact issues to the appropriate LISS Technologies support teams in accordance with established procedures.

  

* Provide users with clear, easy\-to\-understand guidance and updates throughout the support process.

  

* Assist with setup, configuration, and basic maintenance of workstations, peripherals, and standard business applications.

  

* Monitor support queues and address tickets based on SOP

  

* Participate in and adhere to all standard operating procedures, service standards, and departmental policies.

  

* Identify recurring issues and share feedback or improvement opportunities with the broader support team.

  

* Support a professional, service\-oriented environment by demonstrating patience, accountability, and responsiveness in all client interactions.

### **Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise**

* Strong customer service, interpersonal, and communication skills.

  

* Ability to diagnose and resolve common technical issues efficiently and accurately.

  

* Working knowledge of desktop operating systems, business applications, printers, mobile devices, and basic networking concepts.

  

* Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical users.

  

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail in documenting incidents and resolutions.

  

* Ability to prioritize multiple requests and work effectively in a fast\-paced support environment.

  

* Commitment to following procedures, maintaining professionalism, and delivering a high\-quality support experience.

### **About Liss Technologies**


LISS Technologies provides the expert IT support your business needs to solve the technology challenges of today and provide a clear roadmap for the future.  

Your business is like no other. As your trusted IT provider, we function as an extension of your business by taking your goals and culture into account and working tirelessly to provide the technology you need to get the job done. The basis of a true IT partnership is trust. Trust that we have the knowledge and experience to guide your technology decisions. Trust in our processes to be refined and customized to your needs. And, most importantly, trust that we always have your goals and interests in mind.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Customer Success Manager**  

Daybreak Health \| 100% Remote \| Full\-time


**About the role**  

You'll own a portfolio of 50\+ school districts and make sure they launch fast, run smoothly, and keep referring students. Your people are counselors, social workers, and school admin. Your job is to get them equipped and excited to send kids to care. This is execution at scale: technical onboarding, staff training, troubleshooting, adoption campaigns, and data analysis, with AI and internal tools handling the repetitive parts so you spend your time with people instead of building workflows from scratch. When you do this well, more kids get help.



**About Daybreak Health**



Daybreak partners with school districts to make sure any student who needs mental health care can actually get it. The gap we're closing is real: the recommended ratio is one school psychologist per 500 students, and the national reality is closer to one per 1,200, which means families wait months while counselors carry impossible caseloads. We match every student to a clinician based on language, culture, identity, and what they're actually working through, usually starting care within a week or two of a referral and at no cost to the family. It works. 81% of students improve on standardized clinical measures, 92% of families report meaningful behavioral change at home, and 80% of school staff see better attendance, grades, and behavior. **We're backed by Union Square Ventures, Lux Capital, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Maven Ventures, and Y Combinator**, and we already serve districts representing more than a million students. That still leaves most of the country without an answer, which is exactly where this role comes in.



**What you'll do**


* Lead district onboarding, staff activation, and dashboard training
* Troubleshoot account access, referral submissions, and scope questions, with white\-glove support for strategic districts
* Run staff trainings and info sessions that get people genuinely bought in
* Build training capacity models across your cohort so you can flag capacity risk before it turns into a launch delay
* Set the support and engagement strategy per district, with real autonomy to choose the approach
* Execute adoption campaigns: campus visits, email outreach, webinars, data\-driven interventions
* Find creative ways to reach teachers and parents, not just counselors and admin
* Watch leading indicators like non\-contributor district rates and escalate a rising rate as a structural signal, not a seasonal dip
* Turn district data into action, and keep your portfolio documented in shared tools so your work compounds for the team
* Use AI to build personalized training decks, campaigns, and district talk tracks, then apply your own judgment on context and tone
* Use AI to review activation pacing and referral trend lines so you can spend more human time on the districts that need it
* Bring what you learn to weekly GTM meetings, where AI fluency is a shared practice rather than a personal hack


**Skills**


* District and campus onboarding and implementation
* Live training and facilitation for adult learners
* Adoption and engagement campaign execution
* Project management across many concurrent launches
* Data analysis and simple modeling (capacity, pacing, funnel)
* Independent technical troubleshooting
* Practical AI fluency for drafting, analysis, and pattern\-spotting
* Cross\-functional collaboration
* Strong written and verbal communication
* Documentation in shared tools (Notion, Google Docs and Slides)


**Who thrives here**


* Great communicator and idea generator
* Natural problem\-solver who figures things out without being handed the answer
* Connects dots across teams, products, and initiatives
* Knows when to jump in and help and when to hold people accountable
* Takes pride in support so fast and pleasant it creates champions
* Scrappy and adaptable, comfortable in constant startup change
* Sees AI as a way to do more of the job well, not a shortcut around the judgment parts

### **Qualifications**



Must\-haves


* Experience in EdTech, education, or healthcare partnerships, product support, and enablement
* K\-12 background
* Track record driving adoption at scale, think 100\+ customers and thousands of end users
* Strong project management across multiple launches at different phases
* Tech savvy: picks up new systems fast, troubleshoots independently, uses AI tools daily
* Exceptional organization across deadlines and deliverables
* Self\-starter who sees what needs to happen and makes it happen
* Strong written and verbal communication
* Comfortable turning data into insight, including building simple models


Nice\-to\-haves


* Experience with mental health or SEL products
* Previous work inside a K\-12 district or on a campus
* Salesforce or similar CRM experience

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (AAE), New York City
jobs.description:
### **Who We Are**



Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy\-sensitive AI\-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.



We've got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100\+ of the Fortune 500\), a $5\.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.



You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform's impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI\-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that's alerted to a threat in real\-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We're rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170\+ countries.

### **About the Role**



Verkada is excited to announce our Account Executive Development Program, "Verkademy"! As an Associate Account Executive, you'll be a part of the fastest growing company in Silicon Valley/SF with a short promotion path into a closing role! Ideal candidates should be passionate, high energy and a self\-starter with the ability to adapt in a fast\-paced sales organization.



\*\*\*We currently only have start dates from **January 2027 onwards** due to our headcount being at maximum capacity for 2026\. **Please only apply if you're able and willing to start in 2027!**


### **About Verkademy**


Verkademy was created to fast track Sales Associates into world class Mid\-Market Account Executives. In this program, the foundation of Tech Sales are broken up into smaller modules that outline the fundamental skills to become a successful, top\-tier Account Executive. Skills covered range from Prospecting, Discovery, Demo, Best Practice Call, Gaining the Technical Win, etc. Graduates from this program will transition into Mid\-Market Account Executives \- fully equipped with every aspect of the sales motion, industry and company knowledge.

Those who have succeeded in Verkademy typically have been leaders, overachievers, and thrive under challenging and fast paced environments. If you are looking for a place that fully invests in the success of your career and will challenge you, this is the program for you. **About the job**
-----------------


The Google Digital Marketing Apprenticeship is a Department of Labor Registered Apprenticeship Program and a structured learning and development opportunity. During the 18 month program, apprentices will participate in on\-the\-job training, related technical instruction, and career development workshops to develop professional and durable skills. Upon completion, apprentices receive a nationally\-recognized credential, certified by the U.S. Department of Labor.


As a Digital Marketing Apprentice at Google, you will develop the skills you need to pursue an entry\-level career in digital marketing.


You will help define, design, and execute digital marketing campaigns across channels for brands across the world. You will develop the skills to create strategy, content, and optimization, using AI tools where applicable to enhance creativity and efficiency. You will analyze market/campaign data, track key metrics, and present findings to drive objectives. You will engage clients, and gain exposure to consumer and business Google products.


Apprentices are paid hourly for their time split between on\-the\-job training and related technical instruction, and are required to dedicate 40 hours each week to the program. Apprenticeships begin with an immersive virtual onboarding experience to build a foundational understanding of the profession. Apprentices will then join a Google team to train on\-the\-job, while continuing to engage in track\-specific learnings and career workshops throughout the program. As part of the program, apprentices receive holistic career readiness support, and towards the end of the program will have the time and space to prepare for their next endeavor.

**Company**  

“A perfume is a world you can return to over and over again–a keyhole into far off places–material and imaginary.”  

D.S. \& Durga is a Brooklyn fragrance house on a quest to create thrilling perfumes inspired by music, myth, and the mundane. Founded in 2009 by David (D.S.) and Kavi (Durga) Moltz, the brand is known for its uniquely distinguished perfumes, candles, and aromatic products. All fragrances and design worlds are original compositions, rooted in specificity, surrealism, and clarity.  

With distribution across 600 doors globally and five freestanding stores in NYC and LA, the brand is entering a new phase of growth following Manzanita Capital’s majority investment in 2024\.  

  

**Role Overview**  

D.S. \& Durga is looking for a Social Media Manager to take full ownership of our social strategy — someone who can answer the real question behind this job: how do you make someone smell something through a screen? This isn't a content calendar or a posting schedule; it's the challenge of translating a fragrance into a feeling someone experiences through a rectangle of glass in their hand.  

You'll work directly with our founders, our Art Director, and our fractional CMO to build a social presence as specific and distinct as the brand itself — not a playbook borrowed from every other beauty account, but one that's genuinely ours. You'll also partner closely with our Influencer \& GTM and Commercial teams, since social is only one part of a larger discovery engine: it doesn't stay on the app, it walks into a store, gets sprayed on a wrist at a dinner party, and becomes the reason a stranger asks what you're wearing. Your content should compound moment to moment, not reset the algorithm every Monday.  

This role requires both a rigorous, analytical understanding of how platforms actually work — mechanics, not vibes — and the creative eye and hands to turn that understanding into something beautiful. You'll translate performance data into direction for the rest of the team.  

**Your creative toolkit — Music, Myth \& the Mundane:*** **Music** — "Perfume Is Music" is a working method, not a tagline. You'll build the character of a scent the way you'd build a track: notes, a family, a mood, using playlists, rhythm, and tone.
* **Myth** — Every bottle is a character with a world around it — what they wear, drink, listen to, believe. You'll know how to build that world and translate it into a nine\-second video.
* **The Mundane** — A fork's shadow on white linen, a glass of water, a cassette mid\-play. You'll know how to find the charge in an ordinary object and make it feel like the moment before something happens.

**Priorities, in sequence:*** **Instagram, now** — Reframe our existing assets into content that works on the platform, with sharper editing and sharper instincts for what stops the scroll.
* **TikTok, rebooted** — Restart the experiment. Test, fail fast, iterate, and find a voice that's ours rather than a version of what's already working for everyone else.
* **What's next** — YouTube, emerging platforms, and whatever's coming. You'll help us figure out what's worth chasing and what's noise.

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

  

**Strategy \& Vision*** Full ownership of D.S. \& Durga's social strategy — not just execution, the vision itself.
* Build a strategy that meets our customer where they actually are, in partnership with founders, Art Director and fractional CMO.
* Sequence and build step by step — know what comes first, and why.
* Synthesize the brand's essence into a social context that feels native to each platform, not translated onto it.

**Content, Built from Our Own Pillars*** Character — give every fume its own persona, its own vibe, its own moment.
* Fume — the notes, the family, the samples, told the D.S. \& Durga way.
* Playlist — build the world beyond the bottle; play in formats other brands can't touch.
* World Building — educate on the olfactive range without ever sounding like a brochure.
* Fan Mail — go beyond the algorithm; build the culture club with our most committed fans.
* Merchandise — make the b(r)and visible, collectible, IYKYK.
* Be plugged into content producers and creators, and be willing to start from zero — shooting, editing, briefing, whatever the moment needs.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration*** Partner with Influencer \& GTM and Commercial to build content that compounds momentum instead of resetting it.
* Design for the online\-to\-offline journey — how discovery on a screen turns into a moment IRL.
* Keep storytelling consistent with Creative, Retail and PR — one world, every channel.

**Data \& Platform Mastery*** Understand how the algorithm actually works, on each platform, and use that to shape format — not just timing.
* Bring an analytical brain: track performance, find the signal, feed it back to the team as direction.
* Test, learn, refine — every post is a small experiment inside a much bigger one.

**How We Sound (and How You Should Too)**
=========================================


Our words matter as much as our fumes. A few house rules you'll need to live inside:* Sniff, never smell. Fumes, not scents. Wax, not candle.
* Fancy, not precious. Grand, with a wink. Cheeky and original. Anti\-corporate by instinct.
* We reference music, not beauty — remixes and mixtapes, not flankers.
* If it sounds like advertising, we don't say it — unless we're poking fun at advertising.
* No “discover this.” No “captivate your senses.” No phony indulgence. If it's too polished, too earnest or too corporate, it's wrong.

**Reports to:** VP of Business Development  
**Location:** Field based with travel to HQ in El Segundo, CA

**About Us:** JAANUU is a physician\-founded, design\-led medical apparel brand built for the people who care for others every day. We believe healthcare professionals deserve uniforms that are not only functional and performance\-driven, but also thoughtfully designed, modern, and expressive of who they are.

We operate at the intersection of fashion, function, and community—bringing elevated design standards to an industry that’s long been overlooked creatively. From product innovation to brand storytelling, everything we do is rooted in respect for the healthcare community and a commitment to making their everyday work feel better.

At JAANUU, you’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing brand from the inside, collaborate with a tight\-knit, ambitious creative team, and see your work come to life across campaigns, products, and real\-world moments. If you’re excited about building meaningful work, pushing creative craft, and designing with purpose, you’ll feel at home here.

*\*The Base Compensation for this role is $85,000 \- $100,000 (determined based on industry experience). This role will also be eligible for a Goal Based Commission Program in addition to Base Compensation.*

**Summary/Impact:** The Outside Sales Representative will own new account acquisition and territory growth across four priority channels: Universities \& Education (nursing, medical, dental, allied health programs and campus retail), Dental practices and DSOs, Dermatology and aesthetic/med\-spa groups, and the ASI/Decorator/Promotional Products channel. This is a field\-first, relationship\-driven sales role built for someone who is comfortable in the car, in the clinic, and on the phone — someone with strong communication skills, real hunting instincts, and a genuine passion for product, service, and growth.

**Responsibilities:**

*Territory \& Pipeline Development (field\-first)*

*Sales Execution*

* Own the full cycle: discovery → solution design → samples/fittings → business case (sell\-through/WOS/margin) → proposal → negotiation → close → launch
* Design attach plays: program bundles, decoration, partnership sites/portals, sampling kits, and group/practice uniform programs
* Lead on\-site fittings, in\-service demos, and pre\-season line reviews
* Establish and manage replenishment cadence and reorder triggers across accounts
* Develop the ASI/Decorator channel: recruit and enable distributor partners, train their reps on the JAANUU line, support end\-client pitches, and manage co\-sell opportunities
* Collaborate with Marketing on segment narratives, collateral, events, and follow\-up

*Licensing, Channel Ops \& Compliance*

* Navigate licensing; manage artwork submissions, brand guidelines, NIL permissions, and approval timelines
* Ensure retail plumbing: EDI readiness (850/852/846/810\), ticketing/UPC/ASN, routing\-guide compliance, chargeback prevention
* Enforce MAP/UMP, label\-law compliance, distributor terms, and program\-specific requirements
* Partner with Customer Service and Operations to protect the post\-sale experience: onboarding, portal setup, order accuracy, and issue escalation

*Forecasting \& Reporting*

* Deliver weekly activity dashboards including in\-person meeting volume and territory coverage
* Provide monthly forecast by channel with risks/upsides and variance analysis
* Maintain auditable CRM records (call notes, visit recaps, approvals, artwork IDs, attachments) and licensing audit trails

**Success Metrics:**

* Net New Accounts Added (by channel)
* Archived / Dead Accounts – Rekindled / Engaged
* Current Account – Average Order Volume Increase
* Program Adoption Percentage
* Net New Gross Revenue
* In\-Person Meetings and Territory Coverage
* ASI/Decorator Partner Activation and Partner\-Sourced Revenue

**Requirements/Skills:**

* 2–7 years outside/field B2B sales with multi\-stakeholder cycles; experience in at least a couple of the following channels: university/education, medical/dental practices, or apparel/uniforms strongly preferred
* Proven cold\-calling and cold\-walking discipline; pipeline creation from scratch
* Working knowledge of college retail and campus program structures
* Familiarity with dental/DSO and dermatology/aesthetics practice buying behavior
* Familiarity with the ASI/promotional products and decorator ecosystem (distributors, suppliers, end\-buyers)
* Familiarity with retailer needs and solutions
* Familiarity with systems like HubSpot CRM (or similar), Google Suite, Microsoft Suite, Tableau BI (or similar)
* Comfortable leading live fittings/demos; can translate product feature into sell\-through math and margin outcomes
* Travel\-ready 40–50% for territory coverage, fittings, showcases, launches, conferences and events
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation; ability to travel domestically witho

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative Manager
jobs.description:
**Who we are**:
Nitra's mission is to build a more efficient healthcare system and the technology that makes it possible. Our goal is to provide an ecosystem of fintech and software solutions that help doctors better manage their practices, so they can have time back to focus on what matters to them most.

We operate with urgency, intensity, and ambition. The bar is high because the opportunity is massive. We expect excellence, ownership, and intellectual rigor from every team member. We move fast, make bold decisions, and hold ourselves accountable to results. At the same time, we believe great companies are built on trust and respect. Every voice matters. Every contribution counts. When we win, we win together.

We are scaling rapidly and on a clear trajectory toward becoming a unicorn this year — and beyond. Our growth is not accidental; it’s the result of disciplined execution, relentless focus, and a team that refuses to settle. We are building a category\-defining company, and we’re looking for people who want to do the most meaningful work of their careers.

If you want comfort, this isn’t the place.
If you want impact, ownership, and the chance to help build a generational fintech company, welcome.

Nitra was created by unicorn founders who have successfully scaled to thousands of customers and exited $1B\+ public offerings. They are joined by an ambitious and experienced team from American Express, Citi, PayPal, Capsule, Plaid, Bloomberg, Meta, Facebook, and Mastercard. The team is backed by some of the world’s leading VCs (Andreessen Horowitz, NEA, etc.) and is supported by an expert group of advisors including the cofounders of Square and Xendit, executives from Intuit, former Governors, White House senior staffers, and a co\-founder of CityMD.
### **We're looking for:**

* We are seeking a BDR Manager located in the NY area. This individual will lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing team of Business Development Representatives responsible for generating pipeline through extensive outbound prospecting and cold calling.
* The ideal candidate is a hands\-on, experienced sales leader who can immediately step in and lead a BDR organization. You should have a proven track record of managing high\-volume outbound teams, coaching reps to success, and building a culture of accountability and performance.

### **Your responsibilities will include:**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of BDRs to consistently achieve and exceed pipeline and activity targets.
* Build and manage a high\-volume outbound motion centered around cold calling, prospecting, and qualified meeting generation.
* Conduct regular 1:1s, call reviews, and coaching sessions to improve rep performance, messaging, objection handling, and conversion.
* Recruit, onboard, train, and develop BDRs as the team grows.
* Partner closely with Account Executives and Sales leadership to ensure BDRs are targeting the right prospects and generating high\-quality opportunities.
* Own team performance metrics, identify areas for improvement, and implement strategies to increase productivity and conversion.
* Develop and refine outbound messaging, call scripts, prospecting strategies, and sales processes.
* Attend conferences and industry events to support lead generation and prospect engagement.

### **You have:**

* 2\+ years of experience directly managing BDR/SDR teams in a high\-volume outbound sales environment.
* Proven track record of building and managing successful outbound teams with a strong emphasis on cold calling.
* Demonstrated ability to coach reps on the phone, improve performance, and consistently deliver against pipeline and activity targets.
* Experience recruiting, onboarding, training, and developing BDR talent.
* Strong understanding of BDR metrics, sales processes, and pipeline generation.
* Strong leadership and communication skills with the ability to motivate a team while maintaining a high standard of accountability.
* Highly competitive, driven, and results\-oriented with a passion for sales and developing people.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, 100% in\-person environment and willing to be hands\-on with the team.
* Experience selling into healthcare is a plus.

* Health Care \- Your health comes first. We offer comprehensive health, vision, and dental insurance options.
* Retirement Benefits \- Your financial stability matters to us so we provide a generous employer 401K match

Nitra values diversity. We are committed to equal opportunities and creating an inclusive environment for all our employees. We welcome applicants regardless of ethnicity, national origin or ancestry, gender, race, religious beliefs, disability, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, genetic information, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law. The compensation for this full\-time position is $115k \- $125k OTE \+ equity \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. PLEASE INCLUDE YOUR EMPLOYEE IDENTIFICATION NUMBER (EIN) WHEN APPLYING AND INDICATE IN YOUR COVER LETTER IF YOU ARE A PERMANENT PRINCIPAL ADMINISTRATIVE ASSOCIATE OR IN A COMPARABLE TITLE.  

  

THE AGENCY  

The Department of City Planning (DCP) plans for the future of New York City, working to create thriving and dynamic neighborhoods with access to housing and jobs, resilient infrastructure, and a vibrant public realm. The Department engages communities to develop inclusive plans, expands housing access and economic opportunity, and plans for long\-term sustainability.  

  

DCP supports the City Planning Commission in its annual review of hundreds of land use applications. The Department also advises on citywide strategic and capital planning, analyzes data, conducts policy analysis, and creates open data and civic engagement tools.  

  

The Department of City Planning offers staff meaningful opportunities to help shape the future of New York City and address some of its most pressing challenges. The Department values public service, collaboration, and creativity, and supports professional development. Learn more about DCP and view current job openings at www.nyc.gov/planning.

The Executive team coordinates the policy direction and management of the Department of City Planning. The team consists of the Office of the Director, Office of the Executive Director, Office of the Chief Operating Officer, the General Counsel and Communications and Intergovernmental functions. The team is responsible for setting the vision of the Department and directing resources to accomplish our goals.  

  

This motivated team works closely together and across all planning and support divisions to support a diverse set of activities that advance our mission to plan for the City of New York.

The Executive Assistant will support the executive team by performing senior administrative work and other related general office duties, with latitude for independent judgment, including but not limited to the following:

* Perform administrative duties for Employee Engagement Program.

Authorization to work in the United States is required for this position. The NYC Department of City Planning does not offer sponsorship, of any kind, for any type of employment opportunity. Applicants are responsible for ensuring that they meet all minimum qualifying requirements for this position at the time of application.  

  

Only applicants under consideration will be contacted. Appointments are subject to Office of Management and Budget (OMB) approval.  

  

NOTE: If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation during your visit or have questions regarding the accessibility of our facilities, please reach out to accessibilityinfo@planning.nyc.gov or call 212\-720\-3508 at least three business days prior to your arrival.

A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and three years of satisfactory full\-time progressively responsible clerical/administrative experience, one year of which must have been in an administrative capacity or supervising staff performing clerical/administrative work of more than moderate difficulty; or

A four\-year high school diploma or its educational equivalent approved by a State's department of education or a recognized accrediting organization and five years of satisfactory full\-time progressively responsible clerical/administrative experience including one year of the administrative supervisory experience as described in "1" above;

jobs.title: MEP Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
Batska Consulting Group is a dynamic team of skilled engineers, architects, and construction management professionals with vast experience in project management, design, commissioning, and construction across diverse fields such as Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, Fire Protection, Fire Alarm, and Architecture. Our team serves prestigious Healthcare, Higher Education, and public institutions throughout the tristate area.

  

We are currently seeking a dedicated and skilled MEP Assistant Project Manager to join our team. The MEP Assistant Project Manager will support the Project Manager in the coordination and management of MEP systems throughout all phases of a project. This role requires a solid understanding of MEP construction, project management processes, and the ability to effectively coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal project teams.

  

Duties and Responsibilities:

* Demonstrate a clear understanding of MEP construction drawings, specifications, and project documentation.
* Assist in reviewing and interpreting Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, Fire Protection, and Fire Alarm drawings, specifications, and submission requirements.
* Support the Project Manager in identifying potential coordination issues, scope gaps, constructability concerns, and conflicts between MEP systems and architectural or structural components.
* Assist with coordination between MEP design consultants, contractors, subcontractors, vendors, and field installation teams.
* Support the management of RFIs, submittals, equipment schedules, material lead times, change orders, and other MEP project documentation.
* Assist with project forecasting, budgets, schedules, and scope tracking through project management software.
* Participate in MEP coordination meetings, prepare meeting minutes, track action items, and follow up on outstanding issues and resolutions.
* Assist with the development of MEP bid packages and procurement of proposals in accordance with client policies and procurement requirements.
* Support client and stakeholder communication throughout the project, including progress updates and coordination related to MEP systems.
* Assist in identifying potential project risks, including system outages, shutdowns, sequencing issues, and existing\-condition conflicts, and contribute to mitigation strategies.
* Assist in developing and maintaining project schedules, including phased MEP implementation plans that accommodate active building operations and minimize disruptions.
* Conduct site visits and assist with field verification of existing MEP conditions, installation progress, and coordination requirements.
* Maintain accurate project records and documentation and ensure timely distribution of project information to relevant stakeholders.
* Support the Project Manager with overall project coordination, administration, and successful execution of MEP\-related scopes.

  

Essential Skills and Abilities:

  

* Strong understanding of MEP systems and the ability to review and comprehend MEP construction drawings and reports.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with clients, consultants, contractors, and subcontractors.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities concurrently.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proactive and solutions\-oriented work ethic.
* Ability to identify coordination issues and contribute to practical solutions related to MEP systems and project implementation.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Project or Primavera P6, Microsoft Office Suite, and Bluebeam.
* Familiarity with MEP coordination software such as Navisworks or Revit is a plus.
* Ability to understand the integration of MEP systems with architectural and structural components, with a focus on constructability, sequencing, and coordination.
* Ability to work effectively in active and occupied facilities where project phasing and coordination are critical.

  

Required Education \& Experience:

  

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Construction Management.
* 3–5 years of relevant construction industry experience with exposure to MEP systems and project coordination.
* Preferably experienced in healthcare, higher education, institutional, or infrastructure construction projects.
* Experience working in active or occupied facilities and coordinating MEP upgrades or renovations is a plus.

  

At Batska Consulting Group, we prioritize your health, financial security, and professional growth. Join our team and enjoy benefits such as comprehensive health insurance, a 401(k)\-retirement plan, generous paid time off, professional development assistance, and more.

  

Salary: $70,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year

We are seeking a **full\-time Project Coordinator** to support our project and proposal teams with the administrative and technical coordination of industrial construction projects.

jobs.title: Clinical Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Some careers are just jobs. This one is different. At **Georgia HOPE**, the work you do every day creates meaningful change for children, families, and individuals who need it most.  

We're a Georgia\-based behavioral health provider on a mission to instill hope, empower lives, and strengthen communities. Our team specializes in supporting individuals facing emotional and behavioral challenges—often those who have experienced trauma, instability, or significant life stressors. We deliver services directly in the homes, schools, and communities where our clients live and grow, because real progress happens when care is personalized, strengths\-focused, and meets people where they are.  

As part of the **Health Connect America** family—a COA\-accredited organization serving children, families, and adults across nine states—you'll have the resources, support, and professional development of a larger organization, paired with the close\-knit, mission\-focused culture that defines our work. **If you’re looking for a career where your impact is visible, your growth is supported, and your work truly matters, you’ll find it here.** **Health Connect America Family of Brands**

**If you're someone who believes exceptional behavioral health care is built through strong clinical leadership, operational excellence, and supporting both clients and colleagues, this role was built for you.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


As a **C**linical Program Coordinator at Georgia HOPE, you'll play a vital role in ensuring the delivery of high\-quality behavioral health services by supporting clinical operations, mentoring team members, and helping programs run smoothly. Working alongside clinical and operational leaders, you'll strengthen service delivery while promoting best practices, accountability, and exceptional client care.**What You'll Do**
------------------


As a Clinical Program Coordinator, you'll provide clinical, operational, and administrative support that helps both clients and staff succeed. Your work will be collaborative, leadership\-focused, and centered on maintaining quality, compliance, and positive outcomes. Day to day, you can expect to:* Support the day\-to\-day clinical and operational functions of the program, including care coordination, admissions, staff scheduling, documentation compliance, billing support, and communication with referral sources, clients, and community partners.

* Review clinical documentation for quality, accuracy, and compliance while ensuring services meet organizational standards, payer requirements, and accreditation expectations.
* Assist with program growth and operational initiatives, including recruitment, marketing, strategic planning, budgeting support, meeting facilitation, and performance improvement activities.
* Provide direct clinical services to assigned clients, when requested by the Program Director, while maintaining timely documentation and adherence to all clinical, state, and payer requirements.
* Foster a culture of professionalism, collaboration, quality improvement, and culturally responsive care while supporting the organization's mission and ensuring compliance with all applicable policies and regulations.

**What to Expect**

This is a leadership role that combines clinical expertise with operational coordination. jobs.title: Outreach Coordinator
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced, well\-connected **Outreach Coordinator** to join our growing outpatient behavioral health and substance abuse treatment program in **Chamblee, Georgia**.

This is **not a traditional entry\-level marketing position**. We are looking for someone who already knows the local healthcare, behavioral health, and substance abuse treatment community and has **established professional relationships and referral connections throughout the Atlanta area**.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of developing referral relationships and will be comfortable getting out into the community, meeting with referral sources, and creating new opportunities for our program.

What You'll Do

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective referral sources throughout the Atlanta metropolitan area
* Leverage established professional relationships within the behavioral health, substance abuse, healthcare, and community services sectors
* Conduct regular in\-person visits with referral sources and community partners
* Build relationships with hospitals, detox and residential treatment programs, therapists, psychiatrists, physicians, private practices, case managers, social workers, EAPs, attorneys, community organizations, and other appropriate referral partners
* Introduce referral sources to our outpatient programs, services, admission process, and treatment philosophy
* Identify and pursue new referral opportunities
* Represent our organization at networking events, professional meetings, conferences, community events, and other outreach opportunities
* Maintain consistent communication and follow\-up with referral partners
* Collaborate closely with Admissions and Clinical leadership to ensure a smooth referral experience
* Track outreach activity, referral relationships, and results
* Monitor the local behavioral health market and identify opportunities for growth
* Provide leadership with feedback regarding referral trends, community needs, competitors, and potential partnerships

What We're Looking For

**We are specifically looking for someone who already has relationships in the Atlanta behavioral health and substance abuse community.**

The ideal candidate will:

* Have established professional connections throughout the Atlanta behavioral health and/or healthcare community
* Be familiar with treatment providers and referral networks in the **Chamblee, Brookhaven, Dunwoody, Sandy Springs, Buckhead, Atlanta, and surrounding areas**
* Understand how behavioral health and substance abuse referrals move through the local healthcare system
* Have a proven history of successful community outreach, business development, or referral development
* Be comfortable making face\-to\-face visits and developing relationships with referral sources
* Be outgoing, confident, professional, and highly self\-motivated
* Have excellent communication and relationship\-building skills
* Be able to work independently while maintaining strong communication with the internal team
* Understand the importance of confidentiality, HIPAA, and ethical referral practices

Qualifications

* Minimum of **2 years of experience in behavioral health, substance abuse treatment, healthcare outreach, business development, admissions, or a related field**
* **Established Atlanta\-area referral relationships strongly preferred**
* Existing relationships with hospitals, treatment providers, therapists, physicians, mental health professionals, or other behavioral health referral sources highly desirable
* Bachelor's degree preferred but not required with relevant experience
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation required
* Ability to travel throughout the Atlanta metropolitan area on a regular basis
* Strong organizational and follow\-through skills
* Experience using CRM or referral\-tracking systems preferred

This Position Is For You If...

You already know the Atlanta behavioral health landscape.

You know who the major treatment providers are. You know the therapists, hospitals, discharge planners, social workers, case managers, and other professionals who make referrals. You know how to get a meeting, how to maintain a relationship, and how to turn a professional connection into a trusted referral partnership.

If you have an established network and enjoy being the person who knows **who to call, where to go, and how to get the conversation started**, we'd like to meet you.

Why Join Us?

You'll have the opportunity to help grow a new and expanding outpatient behavioral health program while making a meaningful impact in the community.

We are looking for someone who can **hit the ground running** and bring both experience and relationships to the role.

**If you already have a strong Atlanta\-area behavioral health network, we want to hear from you.**

**Apply today!**

jobs.title: Visual Merchandise Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Your Work Matters**


The Visual Merchandise Coordinator is responsible for the day\-to\-day project workflow within the NSVM Design Team scope of work for new stores, existing store refreshes, existing store remodels, and other related special projects. Typical duties include project planning and executing approved NSVM Design projects within the defined workflow. Collaborates with NSVM Design team to verify specifications, internal store management teams, and external suppliers and installers to ensure completion meets time and budget expectations.

**You’ll Be Successful With**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or related field (relevant experience can be substituted for the required education on the basis of one calendar year of experience for one academic year of education)
* Two years of relevant experience required or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to perform the essential functions of the job, as determined by the company
* Prior experience working in a retail environment and department merchandising strongly preferred
* Proven problem\-solving and team building skills
* Excellent communication skills (verbal and written)
* Strong computer skills including Microsoft Office Suite
* Must be detail\-oriented and highly organized
* Must possess excellent customer service skills and work well under pressure
* Ability to multi\-task, meet deadlines, and work in a fast\-paced environment

**Your Day Consists Of**


Design Center Installation \& Maintenance

* Responsible for Design Center installation activities for new stores, existing store refreshes, existing store remodels, and special projects, ensuring on\-site installers complete projects to Design Catalog specs and Floor \& Decor installation standards.
* Responsible for communicating project status to local store teams at defined timing, as well as leadership teams as needed.
* Manage installer schedules within the NSVM Design team to ensure coverage and timing aligns with installer resources and the annual installation schedule.
* Ensure project dates and milestones are recorded and tracked on the Project Tracker tool.
* Daily problem solving with local store teams, installers, and other key contacts to prevent timeline and budget disruptions.
* Work with local store team to verify project completion before releasing the installer to move on to the next project.


Finance \& Accounting

* Ensure project spend is recorded and tracked on the Project Tracker tool.
* Alert Project Manager of projects trending over/under budget to ensure visibility.


Administration

* Execute timelines to complete Design Center projects and communicate status to the Project Manager.
* Order and track all materials shipping to the store locations for each project, including internal inventory transfers and external purchases. Follow up with relevant contacts to problem\-solve missing or late shipments prior to install.
* Manage supplier scorecards to ensure accurate bi\-annual review.

**Working Conditions (travel \& environment)**

* Occasional travel required including air and car travel (0\-15% travel)
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to a warehouse environment and moving vehicles. The noise level in the work environment is typically moderate to noisy.

Medium Work – Ability to exert 20\-50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or 10\-25 pounds of force frequently, and/or greater than negligible up to 10 pounds of force constantly to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects. The employee is often required to use their hands and fingers, to handle or feel. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, reach with arms and hands, climb or balance, and to stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.

Bonus opportunities \& career advancement opportunities at every level


Programs that help you reach your financial goals: 401k with company match, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, and Referral Bonus Program


Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and other Insurance Plans (subject to eligibility criteria)


Work\-life balance, including:


* Paid vacation and sick time for eligible associates
* Paid holidays plus a personal holiday
* Paid Volunteer Time Off that starts on Day 1

jobs.description:
**Are you passionate about delivering exceptional service and building professional relationships with law enforcement agencies?**

**Would you enjoy a role where your attention to detail and commitment to accuracy help insurance customers receive critical accident\-related media efficiently and securely?**

**About the Business**

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Insurance vertical, we provide customers with solutions and decision tools that combine public and industry specific content with advanced technology and analytics to assist them in evaluating and predicting risk and enhancing operational efficiency. Our insurance risk solutions help drive better data\-driven decisions across the insurance policy lifecycle, all while reducing risk. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at https://risk.lexisnexis.com/insurance


**About the Role**

This position is part of the Photo team responsible for supporting insurance company customers by researching and coordinating with law enforcement agencies to obtain accident\-related media. You will play an important role in processing, securing, and distributing digital evidence while ensuring service levels, accuracy, and compliance requirements are met. This role is well suited to someone who is organized, detail\-oriented, and comfortable working with sensitive content in a production\-focused environment.


This role will begin as 5 days in\-office (Duluth, GA) and eventually move into a hybrid work environment, with manager approval.


**Responsibilities**

* Contact and research law enforcement agencies to facilitate the retrieval of accident\-related media.
* Establish and maintain communication with police departments regarding media requests and order statuses.
* Process, verify, and distribute media associated with police reports to insurance company customers.
* Review and manage digital evidence, including potentially graphic images related to motor vehicle accidents.
* Accurately document request activity and maintain production standards and service level expectations.
* Support media fulfillment operations through secure handling, encryption, and distribution of digital files.
* Prepare digital media for customer delivery, including copying files to encrypted USB devices.
* Generate shipping labels and coordinate outbound deliveries through UPS.
* Assist with incoming mail processing and other operational support functions as needed.
* Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and data handling requirements when working with sensitive law enforcement materials.

Preferred Skills \& Competencies


* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to build professional relationships with law enforcement personnel.
* Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Attention to detail and accuracy in a production environment.
* Comfort working with sensitive and occasionally graphic content.
* Ability to meet productivity, quality, and turnaround time goals.

**Requirements**

* Required: Minimum Education: High School Diploma or GED
* Required: Able to work Monday\-Friday
* Required: Able to meet production metrics.
* Highly organized and works well in team environment.
* Experience in criminal justice, insurance claims, call center and/or police departments a plus.

U.S. National Base Pay Range: $33,500 \- $55,700\. Geographic differentials may apply in some locations to better reflect local market rates.

jobs.description:
**WHAT IS THE BRAND?**


Mashburn is an Atlanta\-based apparel and lifestyle brand founded in 2007\. The company designs, manufactures, and markets a nationally recognized collection of menswear (Sid Mashburn) and womenswear (Ann Mashburn), and other high\-quality, iconic brands. Mashburn aims to be the best in American style and service... a brand that offers luxury\-quality product at accessible prices, delivered with a memorable customer experience, and driven by a deeply personal brand voice that expresses the passion and inspiration of our founders.

**WHAT IS THE JOB?**


The **Photo Studio Operations Coordinator** is an entry level role that supports the day\-to\-day product logistics that keep photo studio and e\-commerce shoots running smoothly. This role is responsible for receiving, preparing, moving, and routing product throughout the studio lifecycle, from intake through post\-shoot processing. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys hands\-on operational work, thrives in a fast\-moving environment, and takes pride in keeping product and studio spaces organized, accurate, and efficient.

**WHAT ARE THE RESPONSIBILITIES?**

* Check incoming product into the studio from internal teams and partners
* Track counts and maintain visibility of physical product in the studio
* Organize product by shoot type, queue, and timing
* Unfold, steam, hang, and prep garments to studio standards
* Remove tags, pins, chalk marks, and complete additional sample prep as needed
* Execute rack setup, physical movement, and maintenance throughout shoots
* Move product between the studio, warehouse, HQ, design, and other required locations
* Coordinate alterations drop\-off and pickup
* Route product into the correct queues for on\-figure, flat lay, tailored, and other studio needs
* Pack and prepare shipments for fittings, catalog shoots, and other off\-site needs
* Support packing logistics for local, domestic, and international shoots
* Collect, sort, and route product after shoots to the appropriate next location
* Reconcile product after shoots and flag missing or damaged items
* Take garments to cleaners or flag items for further review when needed
* Maintain organization across racks, prep areas, storage zones, and studio workspaces
* Support seasonal studio resets, sample cleanup, and inventory turnover

**WHAT ARE THE ESSENTIAL SKILLS?**

* 1–3 years of experience in studio operations, fashion production, sample coordination, warehouse support, or related field.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage physical product accurately
* Comfortable with hands\-on garment prep and movement throughout the day
* Able to prioritize tasks and stay organized in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong communication and follow\-through
* Detail\-oriented with a commitment to accuracy and consistency
* Must have reliable personal transportation; this role requires some travel between studio, HQ, warehouse, and off\-site locations
* Ability to lift and carry up to 30 lbs. (bins, packed suitcases, garment bags, and boxed product)
* Experience working with apparel samples, studio workflows, or product logistics is a plus
* Reflects our core values of Hopeful, Helpful, Hardworking, Humble, Hospitable, Nimble, and Honest

============================================

**Location:** Atlanta, GA  

**Job Type:** Full\-Time

**About Primary Vascular Care**
-------------------------------


Primary Vascular Care is a specialized vascular group dedicated exclusively to serving the long\-term care community. We bring a clinic\-like experience directly into skilled nursing and long\-term care facilities, providing comprehensive vascular care at the patient's bedside.


By delivering personalized, high\-quality care in a familiar environment, we reduce the need for unnecessary transportation while ensuring patients receive timely evaluations, treatments, and advanced vascular procedures. Our mission is to improve patient outcomes through exceptional clinical care and strong partnerships with the facilities we serve.

**Position Summary**
--------------------


Primary Vascular Care is seeking an experienced, driven, and relationship\-focused **Account Executive / Sales Representative** to support the continued growth of our services throughout the Atlanta market.


This is a dual\-role position that combines business development with account management and operational coordination. The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying and developing new facility partnerships while ensuring existing accounts receive exceptional support and operational oversight.


Success in this role requires someone who is proactive, highly organized, and comfortable building relationships with nursing home administrators, Directors of Nursing, Social Workers, Case Managers, and other healthcare professionals. The ideal candidate understands that growing an account goes beyond making the sale—it also means helping ensure our services are implemented successfully and that ongoing operations run smoothly between our clinical team and partner facilities.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Identify, prospect, and develop new long\-term care facility partnerships within the assigned territory.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with facility administrators, Directors of Nursing, Social Workers, Case Managers, and other key decision\-makers.
* Present Primary Vascular Care's services and educate facilities on the benefits of bedside vascular care.
* Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting through contract execution and successful onboarding.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, ensuring a high level of client satisfaction.
* Coordinate with internal clinical and operational teams to ensure seamless scheduling, communication, and service delivery.
* Monitor account performance, proactively resolve issues, and identify opportunities to strengthen facility relationships.
* Assist with operational initiatives to support efficient clinic workflows and successful implementation of services.
* Maintain accurate documentation of sales activities, account interactions, and business development efforts.
* Represent Primary Vascular Care professionally at networking events, facility meetings, and industry functions.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in sales, business development, account management, healthcare operations, or a related client\-facing role.
* Experience working with healthcare providers, long\-term care facilities, home health, hospice, physician groups, or medical sales is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to generate new business while maintaining long\-term client relationships.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Self\-motivated, results\-driven, and comfortable working independently.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and CRM systems.
* **Valid driver's license, reliable personal vehicle, and willingness to travel throughout the assigned territory are required.**

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base salary with performance\-based bonus incentives.
* 401(k) retirement plan.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Comprehensive onboarding and ongoing training.
* Supportive, collaborative, and mission\-driven team environment.
* The opportunity to make a meaningful impact by improving access to specialized vascular care for patients in long\-term care facilities.


If you are passionate about building relationships, driving business growth, and ensuring operational excellence while making a difference in healthcare, we encourage you to apply and join the Primary Vascular Care team.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Customer Success Manager**  

Daybreak Health \| 100% Remote \| Full\-time


**About the role**  

You'll own a portfolio of 50\+ school districts and make sure they launch fast, run smoothly, and keep referring students. Your people are counselors, social workers, and school admin. Your job is to get them equipped and excited to send kids to care. This is execution at scale: technical onboarding, staff training, troubleshooting, adoption campaigns, and data analysis, with AI and internal tools handling the repetitive parts so you spend your time with people instead of building workflows from scratch. When you do this well, more kids get help.



**About Daybreak Health**



Daybreak partners with school districts to make sure any student who needs mental health care can actually get it. The gap we're closing is real: the recommended ratio is one school psychologist per 500 students, and the national reality is closer to one per 1,200, which means families wait months while counselors carry impossible caseloads. We match every student to a clinician based on language, culture, identity, and what they're actually working through, usually starting care within a week or two of a referral and at no cost to the family. It works. 81% of students improve on standardized clinical measures, 92% of families report meaningful behavioral change at home, and 80% of school staff see better attendance, grades, and behavior. **We're backed by Union Square Ventures, Lux Capital, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Maven Ventures, and Y Combinator**, and we already serve districts representing more than a million students. That still leaves most of the country without an answer, which is exactly where this role comes in.



**What you'll do**


* Lead district onboarding, staff activation, and dashboard training
* Troubleshoot account access, referral submissions, and scope questions, with white\-glove support for strategic districts
* Run staff trainings and info sessions that get people genuinely bought in
* Build training capacity models across your cohort so you can flag capacity risk before it turns into a launch delay
* Set the support and engagement strategy per district, with real autonomy to choose the approach
* Execute adoption campaigns: campus visits, email outreach, webinars, data\-driven interventions
* Find creative ways to reach teachers and parents, not just counselors and admin
* Watch leading indicators like non\-contributor district rates and escalate a rising rate as a structural signal, not a seasonal dip
* Turn district data into action, and keep your portfolio documented in shared tools so your work compounds for the team
* Use AI to build personalized training decks, campaigns, and district talk tracks, then apply your own judgment on context and tone
* Use AI to review activation pacing and referral trend lines so you can spend more human time on the districts that need it
* Bring what you learn to weekly GTM meetings, where AI fluency is a shared practice rather than a personal hack


**Skills**


* District and campus onboarding and implementation
* Live training and facilitation for adult learners
* Adoption and engagement campaign execution
* Project management across many concurrent launches
* Data analysis and simple modeling (capacity, pacing, funnel)
* Independent technical troubleshooting
* Practical AI fluency for drafting, analysis, and pattern\-spotting
* Cross\-functional collaboration
* Strong written and verbal communication
* Documentation in shared tools (Notion, Google Docs and Slides)


**Who thrives here**


* Great communicator and idea generator
* Natural problem\-solver who figures things out without being handed the answer
* Connects dots across teams, products, and initiatives
* Knows when to jump in and help and when to hold people accountable
* Takes pride in support so fast and pleasant it creates champions
* Scrappy and adaptable, comfortable in constant startup change
* Sees AI as a way to do more of the job well, not a shortcut around the judgment parts

### **Qualifications**



Must\-haves


* Experience in EdTech, education, or healthcare partnerships, product support, and enablement
* K\-12 background
* Track record driving adoption at scale, think 100\+ customers and thousands of end users
* Strong project management across multiple launches at different phases
* Tech savvy: picks up new systems fast, troubleshoots independently, uses AI tools daily
* Exceptional organization across deadlines and deliverables
* Self\-starter who sees what needs to happen and makes it happen
* Strong written and verbal communication
* Comfortable turning data into insight, including building simple models


Nice\-to\-haves


* Experience with mental health or SEL products
* Previous work inside a K\-12 district or on a campus
* Salesforce or similar CRM experience

jobs.description:

Join our mission to build the largest suite of credit card processing and merchant services. It’s one simple payment platform backed by the most diverse payment companies. North, and our family of companies, are committed to helping entrepreneurs grow their businesses. * Medical, Dental, \& Vision Coverage
