jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
At Bessemer, the Executive Assistant will provide seamless administrative support to the Client Advisory (CA) Team which consists of an Associate Client Advisor (ACA), Client Advisor (CA), and Senior Client Advisor (SCA). The specific duties include:





* Point person with respect to client cash transactions and bill payment requests (i.e., wires, ACHs, internal account journals); requires frequent client communication via email and phone, transaction processing via internal banking systems, and coordination of inter\-departmental approvals
* Optimum screening of incoming communications and routing for timely action and follow\-up.
* Professional communication with both internal and external contacts, including significant prospect and client relationships.
* Compose well\-proofed written and email correspondence, which may require the use of financial vocabulary and broad knowledge of the firm's operations, systems, and employees.
* When appropriate collaborate with the ACAs to create presentation books for clients and prospects.
* Comprehensive organization of meetings and luncheons as needed; coordinate scheduling for internal attendees and manage calendar invitations for the CA team.
* Establish effective working relationships with colleagues and external contacts; may be required to provide flexible support to other CA Teams as directed.
* Provide direct and pro\-active administrative support to all members of the CA Team; primary support for Associate Client Advisors with respect to all cash management and bill payment functions.
* Update all contact information, send mass mailings, create ticklers, log calls, and create activities in Salesforce.
* Responsible for maintaining current Salesforce client records for the CA Team and managing external client mail merges, event invitations, and Salesforce reports.
* Bookkeeping/accounting work for various transactions with clients, as directed by the CA team.
* Process expense reports and book travel for all members of the CA Team.
* Compile information and organize CA Team's responses to Compliance and Audit\-related requests.

**Client Service Responsibilities (as directed by the CA Team):**


* Handle routine communication with clients and their advisors via telephone, email and fax.
* Document written and verbal communication with clients and their advisors in Salesforce.
* Assist the client advisory team with preparing charts and materials for client and prospect meeting presentations using Excel, Word, PowerPoint and internal applications as needed.
* Pull basic information from Bessemer systems (ATLAS) to update spreadsheets for clients.
* File correspondence and other documents in internal databases.
* Create documentation of client correspondence for tracking purposes.


**Account Administration Responsibilities (as directed by the CA Team):**


* Work with Client Administration Support (CAS) to open accounts and coordinate with outside agents the transfer of assets to Bessemer.
* Perform cash management functions using Workflow and Atlas in accordance with established account procedures and applicable fiduciary laws and policies.
* Process client remittances.
* Work with the client's CPA to assist in gathering tax information and cutting tax checks when applicable.
* Anticipate when an overdraft can occur and prevent it by bringing the information to the team's attention.
* Supervise and pay client bill payments.


**Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's Degree Required.
* 3\-5 years of experience as an administrative assistant, preferably within a bank supporting a team.
* Ability to work well in a team environment.
  


The base salary range for this position is $85,000\- $100,000 per year. This range reflects the minimum and maximum base salary we reasonably expect to pay for this role. In addition, this position may be eligible to participate in the relevant business unit's incentive compensation plan, and other compensation programs as applicable. Eligible employees may participate in a 401(k) program with a generous profit\-sharing contribution, medical, prescription dental, and vision coverage; life insurance; disability coverage; paid holidays; vacation; and sick time, subject to plan terms and Company policies.





**About Bessemer Trust:**


* Bessemer Trust is a family office, overseeing $250 billion in assets for 3,000 individuals and families of substantial wealth. Its more than 1,300 employees are singularly focused on private wealth management — disciplined investment management, sophisticated wealth planning, comprehensive family office services, and highly personalized client service.
* Established in 1907 as the family office for Annie and Henry Phipps, Bessemer Trust is in its seventh generation of ownership by the Phipps family. As a self\-made entrepreneur, Henry Phipps was a founding partner and chief financial officer of Carnegie Steel.
* Bessemer Trust retains its original focus as a privately owned and independent wealth manager deeply committed to its mission of providing peace of mind to its clients. Bessemer's adherence to putting clients' interests first, fiduciary mindset, and highly collaborative culture are at the heart of everything the firm does.


**Key Facts:**


* For more than 119 years, Bessemer Trust has operated continuously in a single line of business, independently owned by one family.
* Headquartered in New York's Rockefeller Center, Bessemer Trust has 22 offices in total. Woodbridge, NJ, is one of the firm's largest offices, which hosts a wide range of technology and operations professionals. In addition to its sizable presence in New York and Woodbridge, the firm provides client service through offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Delaware, Denver, Garden City, Grand Cayman, Greenwich, Houston, Los Angeles, Miami, Naples, Nevada, Palm Beach, San Diego, San Francisco, Seattle, Stuart, and Washington, D.C.

jobs.title: Multifamily Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

The Assistant Project Manager (APM) supports the Project Manager and Superintendent in the successful planning, coordination, execution, and closeout of ground\-up multifamily construction projects. This position is responsible for helping manage project documentation, subcontractor coordination, procurement, cost control, scheduling, change management, and communication between the field, ownership, design team, and subcontractors.

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, technically capable, and interested in developing into a Project Manager role within the multifamily construction industry.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Management \& Coordination**

* Assist the Project Manager with the day\-to\-day management of multifamily construction projects from preconstruction through closeout.
* Coordinate with the Superintendent, subcontractors, architects, engineers, consultants, vendors, and ownership representatives.
* Participate in owner, architect, contractor (OAC) meetings and subcontractor coordination meetings.
* Prepare meeting agendas, minutes, action\-item lists, and follow\-up documentation.
* Help identify project risks, delays, scope gaps, and coordination issues before they impact the schedule or budget.

**Submittals \& RFIs**

* Manage and maintain project submittal logs.
* Review subcontractor submittals for completeness prior to forwarding them to the design team.
* Track submittal approvals and ensure materials are released in accordance with the project schedule.
* Prepare, issue, and track Requests for Information (RFIs).
* Coordinate RFI responses with the field team and affected subcontractors.
* Maintain current construction drawings, specifications, ASIs, RFIs, and other project documents.

**Procurement \& Subcontractor Management**

* Assist with subcontractor bidding, bid leveling, scope review, and contract preparation.
* Help confirm subcontractor scopes are complete and consistent with project plans and specifications.
* Track subcontract agreements, purchase orders, insurance requirements, and required documentation.
* Maintain procurement logs for long\-lead materials and equipment.
* Coordinate material releases and delivery requirements with the project schedule.

**Cost Management**

* Assist with maintaining project budgets, commitments, and cost reports.
* Review subcontractor change\-order requests and supporting documentation.
* Prepare potential change orders and owner change\-order documentation.
* Track project contingency, allowances, and pending cost exposures.
* Assist with subcontractor pay applications and monthly owner billing.
* Verify that subcontractor billing corresponds with actual work completed in the field.

**Scheduling**

* Work with the Project Manager and Superintendent to maintain the overall construction schedule.
* Assist with preparation and distribution of two\-week and three\-week look\-ahead schedules.
* Monitor procurement activities and subcontractor commitments against schedule requirements.
* Identify activities that could affect critical\-path construction.
* Help coordinate building turnover, inspections, punch\-list activities, and unit delivery schedules.

**Field Coordination**

* Maintain a regular presence in the field and work closely with the Superintendent and Assistant Superintendent.
* Review construction progress against plans, specifications, and project requirements.
* Participate in quality\-control inspections and punch walks.
* Assist with resolving field coordination issues involving multiple trades.
* Track completion of corrective work and outstanding punch\-list items.
* Help coordinate municipal inspections, third\-party inspections, testing, and owner inspections.

**Project Documentation**

* Maintain organized and accurate electronic project files.
* Track RFIs, submittals, change orders, procurement, inspections, meeting minutes, and other project correspondence.
* Help maintain current drawing sets and ensure field personnel have access to the latest documents.
* Assist in maintaining daily and weekly reporting as required.
* Document significant project issues and decisions through written correspondence.

**Project Closeout**

* Coordinate collection of warranties, attic stock, spare materials, operation and maintenance manuals, and closeout documentation.
* Track subcontractor punch\-list completion.
* Assist with obtaining final inspections, Certificates of Occupancy, and other required approvals.
* Coordinate turnover documentation with ownership and property management.
* Assist with subcontractor final payments, lien releases, and project financial closeout.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Building Construction, Engineering, Architecture, or related field preferred.
* 3–5 years of commercial or multifamily construction experience preferred.
* Experience with ground\-up multifamily, wood\-frame, podium, garden\-style, wrap, or similar residential construction is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of construction drawings, specifications, contracts, submittals, RFIs, and change orders.
* Strong understanding of construction sequencing and subcontractor coordination.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and construction management software.
* Experience with Procore, Bluebeam, BuildingConnected, or similar platforms is preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to organize and prioritize multiple responsibilities in a fast\-paced construction environment.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to recognize potential scope, cost, and schedule issues.
* Ability to work collaboratively with office and field personnel.

**Preferred Multifamily Experience**

Experience with some or all of the following is preferred:

* Wood\-frame multifamily construction
* Unit turnover and phased building delivery
* Building envelope and waterproofing
* MEP coordination
* Elevators
* Fire

We have an exciting opportunity for a **Project Coordinator** at UL Research Institutes and UL Standards \& Engagement, based in our Evanston, IL office.


The Project Coordinator will be responsible for supporting the planning and execution of complex and high\-level projects for the Real Estate \& Facilities and Health, Safety \& Environment (HSE) teams. **UL Research Institutes and UL Standards \& Engagement**


At UL Research Institutes (ULRI) and UL Standards \& Engagement (ULSE), we expand the boundaries of safety science to create a more secure and sustainable world. For more than a century, we have studied the unintended consequences of innovation, designed solutions to mitigate risk, created new safety standards and shared our findings with academia, scientists, manufacturers, and policymakers across industries. We identify critical safety and sustainability issues, asking the tough questions because we believe a safer world begins with knowledge.

jobs.title: Client Experience Coordinator
jobs.description:
Let's be honest: families don't remember the name of a scheduling system. They remember the person who made their week easier.



At North Shore Pediatric Therapy, that person is the Family Child Advocate (FCA) — the calm in the chaos, the voice of reassurance, the behind\-the\-scenes orchestrator ensuring every child gets the care they deserve and every clinician walks into a day that runs smoothly.



Here, FCAs are trusted partners to families, real\-time problem solvers, and key players in providing the exceptional experience NSPT is known for. When a parent is overwhelmed, a child needs an urgent reschedule, or a clinic is juggling 30 moving pieces at once… **you're the one who turns stress into solutions.**



This is a **full\-time, in\-center position** with a **schedule of 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM,** with **one day each week requiring a 9:30 AM – 6:00 PM schedule.** You'll primarily work from our Deerfield, IL location. Approximately 50% of your time will be spent in the community building relationships. Compensation ranges from $21\-25 per hour, based on experience and qualifications.


**Why This Role Matters**
-------------------------



Every hour of therapy counts — for a child learning to eat independently, say their sibling's name, or build the confidence they've never had before. You make those moments possible by keeping schedules full, communication clear, and families supported.



Across our centers, our therapists, Clinical Directors, and families will tell you the same thing: "I don't know what we'd do without our FCA."


**Who Thrives in This Role**
----------------------------


* A natural helper who finds joy in making someone's day smoother.
* A multitasker who can juggle 10 moving pieces without losing the warmth in their voice.
* A communicator who knows how to spin chaos into clarity.
* A schedules\-and\-systems thinker who loves finding the fastest path to a solution.
* A relationship\-builder who wants families to feel seen, supported, and appreciated.


If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply!


**What** **You'll** **Do**
--------------------------


**Family Experience \& Operations**


* Be the go\-to support for families (schedule changes, questions, updates)
* Turn cancellations into makeups and keep schedules running smoothly
* Make real\-time adjustments as things shift
* Partner with Clinical Directors and therapists
* Keep the clinic organized, stocked, and running efficiently


**Marketing \& Growth (****50%)**


* Support local outreach efforts (schools, events, community partners)
* Help coordinate and host tours for prospective families
* Assist with center events and family engagement initiatives
* Drive online reputation (reviews, testimonials, family follow\-ups)
* Partner with leadership on simple, high\-impact marketing efforts
* Be the face of the center in the community

**Why** **You'll** **Love Working Here**
----------------------------------------



You're not just managing logistics — you're shaping a family's entire experience of therapy. You'll join a supportive team, build real relationships with families, and play a vital part in helping kids access the care they need.



If you're looking for a role where every day is meaningful and every detail matters, we'd love to talk.

With plentiful opportunities for growth (as we prefer to promote from within), the CEC will manage incoming orders from our Fortune 500 clients and ensure that all customer expectations are met. While the majority of our processes are automated, the CEC role is critical in managing changes, status updates, etc. to ensure a pleasant buying experience. This position also requires a strong understanding of our eStores, our clients’ brands, and our suppliers’ capabilities (all of which will be covered during the training process). Lastly, the CEC should be able to comfortably guide buyers through the entire buying process, which includes the management of customer expectations, providing customer service throughout the entire post\-order process and management of off\-site supplier teams (that produce the products for our clients).

Training will be conducted at our new Headquarters at 500 W. Madison (the Ogilvie train station building) “in\-person” three days per week, with the remainder conducted remotely. Once training is complete, the position will work in our office approximately two days per week.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Customer service and communication – ability to walk a buyer through our eStores, help them place an order, provide live order status details, etc.
* Manage buyer expectations

* Customer support \- first point of contact for customers, liaison between the supplier and the customer, educate and support customer shipping questions/issues, order program item samples for customers as requested
* Multitasking skills \- manage multiple service in\-boxes and 1\-800 phone lines, manage database cues throughout the day
* eStore quality control/site maintenance
* Project management skills \- track and follow all orders/projects and step in when necessary to ensure a positive buyer experience.
* Issue Resolution \- creatively troubleshoot problems and think on their feet to identify the best resolution

jobs.description:
**Company Description** Plift is a high\-growth beverage startup offering delicious hemp\-infused drinks that are high on taste and low on calories. Designed for social gatherings, solo moments, and everything in between, Plift focuses on creating enjoyable, approachable products for a wide range of occasions. The brand emphasizes quality ingredients, refreshing flavor profiles, and a relaxed, inclusive experience. Team members join a growing company in a dynamic consumer packaged goods space with opportunities to contribute to brand expansion and market presence.

**Role Description** The Sales Operations Coordinator is a full\-time, remote role for our Chicago\-based company. We will be prioritizing candidates who are local to Chicago and who can join for weekly in\-person meetings and co\-working days. This role supports the sales team with daily operational tasks, including maintaining sales records, updating customer and account information, and preparing reports and dashboards to track performance. The coordinator will assist with order processing, inventory coordination, and communication between sales, customer service, and distribution partners to ensure smooth execution of sales activities. Responsibilities also include responding to internal and external inquiries, supporting the onboarding of new accounts, and helping streamline processes and tools to improve overall sales efficiency. This position works closely with sales and operations leadership teams to ensure consistent and accurate data entry and data management for decision\-making.

**Year\-one deliverables**

* Take full ownership of the full wholesale order processing cycle from receiving purchase orders to sending invoices, to entering order data into 3PL system, as well as initiating and managing freight.
* Support in the selection and implementation of an ERP by end of Q1 next year.
* Build lot code traceability into every B2B and distributor shipment.
* Cut the time from PO received to invoice issued to under 4 business hours, measured weekly.Cut DSO (days sales outstanding) by 15 days through systematic AR follow\-up.
* Reduce freight cost as a percent of revenue by 1–2 points through carrier negotiation and lane consolidation across all carriers and freight brokers.
* Build a distributor onboarding playbook so the next 10 distributors do not require co\-founder time to get live.

**Day\-to\-day responsibilities**

* Own the full order\-to\-cash lifecycle: PO receipt → invoice → freight booking → BOL → delivery confirmation → payment.
* Coordinate freight with C.H. Robinson and distributor\-managed carriers. Own freight quotes, lane decisions, and freight\-add\-to\-invoice decisions.
* Manage the relationship with 3PLs on warehouse SLAs. Hold them accountable to ship windows and lot code accuracy.
* Reconcile shortages, damages, and mis\-shipments. Issue credit memos through Belay Financial without assistance from Director of Ops or COO.
* Run a weekly ops review with Director of Ops: aging AR, open POs, OOS risk, freight spend, exceptions.
* Be the escalation point for distributor billing disputes

**Required experience**

* 5–8 years in sales operations, supply chain, or order management at a CPG, beverage, or distributed consumer goods company.
* Has personally led at least one ERP implementation or major migration. NetSuite, Fishbowl,

Encompass, or beverage\-specific platform preferred.

* Hands\-on with three\-tier alcohol or hemp beverage distribution. If not, then deep DSD or

wholesale\-broker experience that translates.

* Strong QuickBooks Online familiarity.
* Has owned freight relationships, not just submitted tickets to a 3PL.
* Comfortable in spreadsheets at a power\-user level (pivot tables, lookups, basic SQL or Looker a plus).

**Nice to have﻿**

* Experience with hemp, cannabis, or alcohol regulatory compliance (state\-by\-state license tracking, METRC, MN OCM, etc.).
* Has worked with Belay Financial or another fractional accounting firm.
* Has been the first ops hire at a sub\-$10M revenue company before.

Pay: $95,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chicago, IL 60647

**Make a Difference Every Day**


Ray Graham Association (RGA) is a leader in supporting people with intellectual and developmental disabilities to live meaningful, self\-directed lives. We are seeking a compassionate, organized, and customer\-focused **Service Intake and Outreach Coordinator** to serve as the first point of contact for individuals, families, referral sources, and community partners seeking services.

* Serve as the primary contact for inquiries regarding RGA services and supports.

* Conduct intake screenings and collect necessary documentation.
* Guide individuals and families through the admissions and enrollment process.
* Maintain accurate records of referrals, vacancies, and intake activities in organizational databases.
* Coordinate communication among internal departments to facilitate service placements.
* Assist individuals and families in navigating the Illinois intellectual and developmental disabilities (I/DD) service system, including available programs and resources.

* Prepare reports and monitor referral and intake data to support organizational planning and service delivery.
* Participate in outreach, advocacy, and community engagement activities to increase awareness of RGA services.
* Ensure all interactions are person\-centered, respectful, and aligned with RGA's mission and values.


**Benefits:**

* Benefits include medical, dental, vision, paid time off (PTO), retirement plan, mileage reimbursement, and professional development opportunities.


Requirements:
**Required Qualifications**

* High school diploma or GED required.
* Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.
* Minimum of two years of experience in intake, customer service, case management, healthcare, human services, or a related field.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational, documentation, and time\-management skills.
* Ability to handle multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and computerized database systems.
* Ability to work collaboratively with diverse individuals, families, and community partners.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Services, Social Work, Healthcare Administration, Psychology, Special Education, or a related field.
* Experience working with individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities.
* Knowledge of the Illinois DHS Division of Developmental Disabilities system, PUNS, Medicaid Waiver programs, and Independent Service Coordination (ISC) processes.

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

  

  

All full\-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

  

  

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

**About the Role:**



As a Dedicated Service Advisor, you will act as the single point of contact for all support inquiries, enhancing their user experience and serving as a subject matter expert for Gusto's core products. You will guide customers through our newest product features, provide proactive customer education and support, partner cross\-functionally, move quickly to strategize and creatively solve problems, act as their advocate internally to influence our product decisions and roadmap, and holistically support the customer/Gusto partnership. You'll address and solve real problems and deliver an exceptional customer experience to some of our most valued companies to build trust and loyalty to Gusto for the book of business.



This role requires leveraging AI\-assisted tools to accelerate research and communication by demonstrating fluency in delegating repetitive work, crafting structured prompts, and critically reviewing outputs for accuracy, tone, and empathy, all while consistently applying compliance and data\-privacy guardrails, delivering measurable efficiency gains, and exercising sound judgment on when to avoid AI or escalate edge cases.


**About the Team:**



The Dedicated Service team is a segment of our Care team dedicated to building and expanding relationships with our high\-value customers. The team manages an assigned book of customer accounts, serving as product experts, and providing trusted and efficient service.


**Here's what you'll do day\-to\-day:**


* Own the customer journey by building trust, rapport, and partnership with your book of business through **inbound and outbound phone, email, and Google Meet interactions.**

* Think creatively, pivot quickly, live in ambiguity, and collaborate strategically. You will be required to expand your critical thinking skills and creatively problem\-solve across all areas of the business, with an understanding of a variety of stakeholders and needs.
* Display strong product knowledge, including a deep understanding of the competitive landscape to protect against customer churn.
* Leverage AI‑assisted tools to accelerate research and communication while upholding accuracy, compliance, and Gusto's voice.


**Here's what we're looking for:**


* 6\+ years of customer experience with 1\+ years of full\-time experience in Payroll, **and** 2\+ years of account management.
* Proven ability to proactively and reactively support customers, driving their success, happiness, and loyalty through expert guidance and creative problem\-solving.
* Ability to synthesize and communicate complex subjects clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing, with customers and internal partners.
* Experience with Salesforce, Zoom/Google Meets, Google Suite, Google Calendar, Gmail, and scheduling tools.
* Excels in balancing inbound calls, scheduled meetings, and email inquiries while managing and prioritizing multiple high\-priority resolutions effectively.
* Strength in providing effective, expert, and creative resolutions for customers with minimal support, demonstrating agility and critical thinking.
* Ownership in churn identification and mitigation with confidence in navigating retention\-focused discussions with customers.
* Deep payroll knowledge, pride, and awareness to act as an advocate for the solution you provide, understanding customer needs and promoting satisfaction.
* Exceeds expectations with goals, deadlines, and commitments set by both yourself and the organization.
* Eager to think creatively, pivot quickly, and work strategically in ambiguous situations to deliver customer\-centric solutions.

jobs.description:
**Customer Success Manager**  

Daybreak Health \| 100% Remote \| Full\-time


**About the role**  

You'll own a portfolio of 50\+ school districts and make sure they launch fast, run smoothly, and keep referring students. Your people are counselors, social workers, and school admin. Your job is to get them equipped and excited to send kids to care. This is execution at scale: technical onboarding, staff training, troubleshooting, adoption campaigns, and data analysis, with AI and internal tools handling the repetitive parts so you spend your time with people instead of building workflows from scratch. When you do this well, more kids get help.



**About Daybreak Health**



Daybreak partners with school districts to make sure any student who needs mental health care can actually get it. The gap we're closing is real: the recommended ratio is one school psychologist per 500 students, and the national reality is closer to one per 1,200, which means families wait months while counselors carry impossible caseloads. We match every student to a clinician based on language, culture, identity, and what they're actually working through, usually starting care within a week or two of a referral and at no cost to the family. It works. 81% of students improve on standardized clinical measures, 92% of families report meaningful behavioral change at home, and 80% of school staff see better attendance, grades, and behavior. **We're backed by Union Square Ventures, Lux Capital, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Maven Ventures, and Y Combinator**, and we already serve districts representing more than a million students. That still leaves most of the country without an answer, which is exactly where this role comes in.



**What you'll do**


* Lead district onboarding, staff activation, and dashboard training
* Troubleshoot account access, referral submissions, and scope questions, with white\-glove support for strategic districts
* Run staff trainings and info sessions that get people genuinely bought in
* Build training capacity models across your cohort so you can flag capacity risk before it turns into a launch delay
* Set the support and engagement strategy per district, with real autonomy to choose the approach
* Execute adoption campaigns: campus visits, email outreach, webinars, data\-driven interventions
* Find creative ways to reach teachers and parents, not just counselors and admin
* Watch leading indicators like non\-contributor district rates and escalate a rising rate as a structural signal, not a seasonal dip
* Turn district data into action, and keep your portfolio documented in shared tools so your work compounds for the team
* Use AI to build personalized training decks, campaigns, and district talk tracks, then apply your own judgment on context and tone
* Use AI to review activation pacing and referral trend lines so you can spend more human time on the districts that need it
* Bring what you learn to weekly GTM meetings, where AI fluency is a shared practice rather than a personal hack


**Skills**


* District and campus onboarding and implementation
* Live training and facilitation for adult learners
* Adoption and engagement campaign execution
* Project management across many concurrent launches
* Data analysis and simple modeling (capacity, pacing, funnel)
* Independent technical troubleshooting
* Practical AI fluency for drafting, analysis, and pattern\-spotting
* Cross\-functional collaboration
* Strong written and verbal communication
* Documentation in shared tools (Notion, Google Docs and Slides)


**Who thrives here**


* Great communicator and idea generator
* Natural problem\-solver who figures things out without being handed the answer
* Connects dots across teams, products, and initiatives
* Knows when to jump in and help and when to hold people accountable
* Takes pride in support so fast and pleasant it creates champions
* Scrappy and adaptable, comfortable in constant startup change
* Sees AI as a way to do more of the job well, not a shortcut around the judgment parts

### **Qualifications**



Must\-haves


* Experience in EdTech, education, or healthcare partnerships, product support, and enablement
* K\-12 background
* Track record driving adoption at scale, think 100\+ customers and thousands of end users
* Strong project management across multiple launches at different phases
* Tech savvy: picks up new systems fast, troubleshoots independently, uses AI tools daily
* Exceptional organization across deadlines and deliverables
* Self\-starter who sees what needs to happen and makes it happen
* Strong written and verbal communication
* Comfortable turning data into insight, including building simple models


Nice\-to\-haves


* Experience with mental health or SEL products
* Previous work inside a K\-12 district or on a campus
* Salesforce or similar CRM experience

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About CodeHS**
----------------


CodeHS is a comprehensive platform helping K\-12 schools teach computer science. We provide curriculum, professional development, and a full software platform. CodeHS is used by millions of students and thousands of schools and districts around the US and the world.

**Mission**
-----------

**The mission of CodeHS is to empower all students to meaningfully impact the future.** We believe that in the 21st century, coding is a foundational skill, just like reading and writing. That’s why we say: **Read, Write, Code.** Coding and computer science are essential skills for students to learn and schools to teach.

  

CodeHS is looking for a Sales Development Representative (SDR) to generate new sales leads by prospecting potential district customers and conducting outbound outreach via email and phone to connect with district administrators. Your primary focus will be setting up appointments with district administrators for our Account Executives.

**Job Description**
-------------------

 **Responsibilities**

* Generate leads for the Account Executive team by reaching out to stakeholders over multiple channels (phone, email, LinkedIn, etc).
* Call Curriculum and CTE administrators from school districts in a set territory and schedule meetings for AEs to pitch CodeHS
* Create and send email sequences to district and school administrators to schedule discovery calls and educate stakeholders about CodeHS Pro
* Call active free teachers to learn more about what their district is doing for CS and try to get names/introductions to district administration
* Cultivate interest in upgrading among teachers using our free version
* Create and send outbound email campaigns to district administrators (Directors, Superintendents) with the goal of scheduling a meeting for Account Executives
* Contact teachers/administrators from recently won deals to ask if they can recommend other stakeholders to contact at neighboring schools/districts that could use CodeHS

**Requirements**

* Minimum of a bachelor’s degree
* 1\-2 years sales or related experience with an interest in growing your career in sales
* Highly organized and efficient
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Able to work independently in a fast paced environment
* No experience coding is required, but you should have an interest in learning

**Preferred**

* Previous experience as a B2B software sales SDR
* Experience working with Salesforce and sales engagement platforms like MixMax or Outreach

 **This is an in\-office position, which would require 5 days a week in the CodeHS Chicago office at 747 N LaSalle in River North.**


Must be authorized to work in the US.

 **Compensation**

* Base Salary: $57,000
* Incentive Compensation: $18,000
* On Track Earnings: $75,000


Incentive compensation is based on the number of attended meetings.

 **Benefits:**

* Health, dental, vision
* Equity
* 401k plan with 4% match
* Paid Parental leave
* Strong vacation policy (22 days off \+ 16 company holidays)
* Short term and long term disability
* $400 annual professional development stipend

**Company Values**
------------------

### **Encourage Teaching and Learning**


CodeHS is about providing excellent teaching and learning opportunities in computer science for students all over the world. We value creating fun, accessible and creative learning experiences for teachers, for students, and for team members at CodeHS. We believe that education\-and specifically coding\-within the formal K\-12 system, the higher\-education system, and beyond has the power to allow everyone to unlock their full potential.

### **Create a Direct Positive Impact**


At CodeHS we value creating a direct positive social impact with our work. We work directly with students, teachers, schools and districts to implement computer science classes. Through building great curriculum, tools and resources to allow high schools to teach computer science, we can create a direct educational benefit to students to help explore the limitless world of computing. We believe that expanding access to computer science education will empower students to take an active role in creating the future.

### **Make It Fun and Creative**


Bringing fun and creativity to every aspect of our work is a main focus for us at CodeHS. It starts with a fun, friendly and accessible curriculum, that allows students the opportunity to build creatively and engage in thoughtful problem solving. We also focus on developing a creative and fun environment to work in, and think that this allows us to bring novel approaches to challenging problems. Computing is about logic\-but it’s also about creativity\-and we hope to share that excitement with teachers and students through CodeHS.

**Our Operating Practices**

**Get the job done**


We figure out the real problem to be solved and take ownership over seeing it to completion. We help move things across the finish line.

**Bring context and big picture awareness**


We consider the projects we work on in their context and see how our projects impact the team, company, and the customer.

**Adaptable**


We adapt to changing needs across customers and the team, and make good plans but know that they can change as we get new information.

**Growth Mindset**


We're always looking to learn and improve, and we share that mindset with teachers and students. We’re working to improve individually and as a team.

**Team player**


We help out our teammates and we’re team players. We make decisions with a team first approach and strive to act in the best interest of the company as a whole.

**Constructive and solution oriented**


When approached with problems and roadblocks, we're constructive and solution oriented. We think through problems and tradeoffs, proactively finding solutions.

**Good vibes**


We bring positive energy whether in person or virtually to help contribute to making a positive work environment for everyone.

At Syngenta Seeds Field Crops, we're shaping the future of agriculture and empowering farmers to meet the ever\-growing demand for food and fuel. We’re a global Ag Tech powerhouse, headquartered in the United States, with passionate, local experts collaborating with farmers to deliver solutions that create market opportunities. We unite precision breeding, advanced biotechnology trait choice, and digital platforms for unmatched in\-field performance. Our seeds help mitigate risks such as disease, insect, weed, and extreme weather pressures, all while promoting sustainable farming practices that protect and enhance our planet. Join our mission of revolutionizing food security and transforming agriculture.

 **Job Description**  

At Syngenta, our goal is to build the most collaborative and trustworthy team in agriculture, providing top\-quality seeds and innovative crop protection solutions that improve farmers' success. We invite you to help shape the future of agriculture and play a role in safely feeding the world while caring for our planet.


Syngenta's Sales Team is seeking a Seeds Agronomy Developmental Sales Representative. This internship role will be part of a high\-performing Sales Team and participate in a curriculum\-based, integrated learning opportunity preparing you to be a successful territory sales leader in the agriculture industry. You’ll receive competitive wages and ongoing career development resources.


As part of Syngenta's Emerging Talent Program, you will gain hands\-on experience, exposure to day\-to\-day business operations, and opportunities to apply your academic knowledge to real\-world challenges while developing your professional skills.

**Location:** Flexible locations within the United States (**Colorado, Illinois, Iowa, Kansas, Minnesota, Wisconsin, Oklahoma, Nebraska, Missouri, Indiana, Ohio, Michigan, North Dakota, South Dakota**)

**Accountabilities:**

* Complete a well\-defined, customized training and development plan with direction and assistance from your manager and experienced colleagues.
* Develop effective product and technical expertise, such as product placement, scouting, agronomic principles, building strong farmer relationships, understanding the sales process, and gaining product commitment.
* Gain experience and build leadership capabilities, consultative selling competence, communication and presentation skills, business acumen, and territory management while creating a professional network to further your career.
* Implement strategy to achieve sales objectives in the assigned territory.
* Identify and analyze customer needs, market intelligence, and territory opportunities to share with Sales Management and Marketing.
* Develop effective ways of working to strengthen teamwork within the sales team.
* Manage, support, and build the customer base in a defined geography.
* Advise channel partners on the presentation of products and promotional materials.
* Manage within territory budget guidance, accurately report expenses and sales, operate and maintain a company vehicle in compliance with policy, track customer interactions, and submit weekly activity reports.

  

**Qualifications** **Required Qualifications:**

* BA/BS degree completed between August 2026 and May 2027, preferably in Agricultural Science or a related field.
* A valid driver’s license and an acceptable moving violations record.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience with previous agricultural internships.
* First\-hand knowledge of farming is a definite asset.
* Knowledge of agronomics, general cropping practices, agricultural technology and trends, and requirements for pest control.
* Demonstrated professional and personal capabilities, such as:
	+ Strong customer focus
	+ Business acumen and results\-driven mindset
	+ Resilience and interpersonal savvy
	+ Ability to lead, be self\-directed, and work as part of a team
	+ Integrity and trust
	+ Effective writing, presentation, and negotiation skills
* Ability to be mobile within the Midwestern region of the U.S.

  

**Additional Information**  

Salary for this position ranges between $70,000 \- $75,000 annually.

**What We Offer:**

* A culture that celebrates belonging and collaboration, promotes professional development and strives for a work\-life balance that supports the team members.
* ⁠Competitive wages
* Ongoing career development resources
* The opportunity to work on meaningful, innovative projects that solve problems


Syngenta is committed to creating a culture that celebrates belonging and collaboration, promotes professional development, and strives for a work\-life balance that supports the team members

jobs.description:
If you’re looking for an entry\-level sales position that provides hands\-on training, performance\-based earning potential, and opportunities to develop professional sales skills, this may be a great fit.

We are currently recruiting for a **full\-time, W\-2 Entry\-Level Client Sales Representative** supporting **AT\&T's telecommunications products and services** within established retail locations in the Oak Brook, IL area.

This is a **face\-to\-face retail sales position**. Representatives work directly with customers inside retail stores, introduce available AT\&T products and services, explain current promotions, and assist customers through the sales and enrollment process.

Prior sales experience is not required. Paid training is provided.

What You'll Do

As an Entry\-Level Client Sales Representative, your day\-to\-day responsibilities will include:

* Work **face\-to\-face with customers inside established retail locations**
* Approach and engage customers to identify their telecommunications needs
* Promote and sell **AT\&T telecommunications products and services**
* Explain available service options, features, pricing, and current promotions
* Assist interested customers with **new customer sales and service enrollments**
* Answer customer questions and provide accurate product and service information
* Deliver sales presentations using provided product knowledge and sales training
* Maintain professional and positive customer interactions throughout the sales process
* Track individual sales activity and performance
* Work toward established daily and weekly sales goals
* Participate in ongoing sales, product, and customer\-service training
* Collaborate with team members and management to improve sales performance

**This position is performed in person inside retail locations and is not a remote, office\-based, or door\-to\-door sales position.**

Compensation

* **W\-2 employee position — not 1099 or independent contractor**
* **Guaranteed weekly base pay \+ uncapped commission**
* Average total earnings, including commissions: **$850–$1,200 per week**
* Commission earnings are based on individual sales performance and are not guaranteed
* Paid, hands\-on training provided
* Paid weekly

Schedule

* Full\-time
* Approximately **40–42 hours per week**
* Daytime and retail operating hours
* Weekend availability is required
* No overnight shifts

Qualifications

We're looking for candidates who:

* Are comfortable approaching and speaking with customers face\-to\-face
* Have strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Are interested in developing sales and customer\-service experience
* Are motivated by individual goals and performance\-based compensation
* Are coachable and comfortable learning sales presentations and product information
* Can work effectively in a fast\-paced retail environment
* Are comfortable working on their feet throughout the workday
* Can maintain a professional attitude when representing telecommunications products and services
* Are available to work a full\-time retail schedule, including weekends

Previous experience in retail, hospitality, customer service, sales, telecommunications, promotions, or other customer\-facing positions can be helpful but is **not required**.

Training \& Development

New representatives receive hands\-on training covering:

* AT\&T telecommunications products and services
* Current promotions and service options
* Customer needs assessment
* Face\-to\-face sales presentations
* Customer acquisition and enrollment
* Retail sales techniques
* Communication and customer service
* Sales performance and goal tracking

This is an **entry\-level sales position** designed for individuals interested in building practical experience in retail sales, telecommunications, customer acquisition, and business development.

Pay: $900\.00 \- $1,500\.00 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Flexible schedule

jobs.description:
**Description**


Join Syneos Health in partnership with a large Biopharmaceutical company as a Pharmaceutical Sales Representative (PSR). Become a part of a fast\-paced and challenging environment where our compassion and dedication drive us to meet the unique needs and goals of our customers. The PSR role is responsible for building relationships with recognized experts, healthcare providers (HCPs) and prioritized stakeholders.

 **The successful PSR will:**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing, and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key accounts with the goal of maximizing sales
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action
* Deliver clinical brand specific presentations of product(s) to physicians and other appropriate health care professionals
* Develop a complete understanding of the health care delivery system within each assigned customer, including the physician hierarchy, key pharmacy personnel, clinical nursing staff, etc.
* Develop deep product and competitor knowledge and understanding of local and regional market trends
* Analyze local trends, identifying long and short\-term goals to craft a strong product business plan
* Collaborate and partner with peers in the sales organization, brand team and other support partners to deliver an extraordinary customer experience
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner
* Execute the company brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area
* Participation in training and development programs
* Maintain adherence and compliance with all corporate, industry policies and procedures

 **Essential Requirements:**

* BA/BS degree required, Life Sciences preferred
* Business to business sales experience or internship experience and/or sales degree or 2\+ years of pharmaceutical experience
* Ability to identify key decision makers, develop positive relationships and strong customer dedication and influence prescribing habits
* Ability to learn, apply, and communicate products and disease states
* Proven track record of success in exceeding results
* Team player who can also work independently, highly collaborative and motivated to succeed
* Strong communication, business analytics and account management skills

 **Desired Requirements:**

* Respiratory Experience

  

The annual base salary for this position is **$60,000 – $90,000**. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include a company car or car allowance and eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and/or individual performance.


At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Here, the work is challenging, and the pace is exhilarating. By joining one of our commercial teams, you’re empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy that you need. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Syneos Health has launched more sales teams in the last 5 years across all major therapeutic areas than the top 25 pharma companies combined. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients. Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.


Work Here Matters Everywhere \| How are you inspired to change lives?

jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------



If you enjoy working outdoors in a professional and safe environment, consider a career with Bartlett Tree Experts! At Bartlett, we value a strong culture of excellence in safety, scientific research, lifelong learning, and career development.  

Bartlett Tree Experts is currently seeking a full\-time Arborist Representative to join our growing team. This is a unique opportunity to combine your passion for arboriculture and enthusiasm for sharing knowledge to establish positive client relationships. As an Arborist Representative, you will play an integral role in helping grow our business by developing and maintaining long\-term client relationships. You will be responsible for visiting client properties, assessing their tree and shrub care needs, and providing scientific tree and shrub care recommendations.
**Benefits**
------------



We offer:
* $50,000\-$120,000 annual draw plus commission
* A safety\-first culture and professional workplace
* Base salary (draw) plus commission
* Advancement opportunities \- we promote from within
* Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
* 401k retirement plan
* Paid time off and holidays
* Company provided vehicle, laptop, and cell phone
* Access to training, continuing education programs, and a variety of resources provided by the Bartlett Tree Experts Research Laboratories Charlotte, NC

To find out more about what life is like at Bartlett, check us out on Instagram @LifeatBartlett.
**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Responsible for all areas of sales within a defined territory, including selling, marketing, customer service, administration, production, and training
  

	+ Meet with existing and potential residential and commercial clients daily to evaluate their tree and shrub care needs
	+ Establish, develop, and maintain positive business and client relationships within the defined territory

	+ Set up personal sales expectations with immediate supervisor and prepare to meet sales goals
* Responsible for implementing and enforcing all safety, transportation, and pesticide compliance programs

------------------


* 1\-3 years of related experience in the tree care industry or prior sales experience

* Ability to learn to identify trees and shrubs common to the region, diagnose pests and diseases, and recommend corrective action or proactive management plans

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills
* Degree in Arboriculture, Forestry, Horticulture, Turfgrass, Environmental Science, Plant Science, Outdoor Recreation, Agriculture or a related field is preferred but not required

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**Executive Assistant**
=======================


**Job Details**
---------------


**Job Title:** Executive Assistant


**Location:** Chicago, IL \| Hybrid \| **Must be able to commute to the Chicago Office**


**Compensation:** $75,000\-$95,000 annually, commensurate with experience


**Bonus:** Performance bonus eligibility


**Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid time off and company holidays; and more!


**About the Company**
---------------------



Alta HR is hiring on behalf of a growing Chicago\-based company operating in the health optimization space. The organization also has an affiliated nonprofit focused on advancing education and access within health optimization.



The environment is fast\-paced, the areas of responsibility are wide. This is an opportunity to work closely with a highly involved CEO and have a front\-row seat to two growing organizations.


**The Role**
------------



We are looking for an Executive Assistant who protects the CEO's time, runs his calendar and inbox with judgment rather than instruction, and closes loops without being chased.



This is a classic gatekeeper role performed at a very high level. AI usage will be expected; the right candidate will work smarter, improve systems, and increase the capacity of the executive function.


**What You'll Own**
-------------------


* **Calendar and time management:** Own the CEO's calendar end to end, resolve conflicts, protect focus time, and serve as the first filter for inbound meeting requests.
* **Inbox and communication:** Triage email and Slack, surface what requires the CEO's attention, draft correspondence in his voice, and ensure important items never sit unresolved.
* **Meetings and follow\-through:** Prepare agendas, capture notes and action items, track commitments, and drive follow\-up across the leadership team.
* **Projects:** Own discrete projects from start to finish, including research, vendor coordination, document preparation, and operational initiatives.
* **Travel and events:** Coordinate domestic and international travel, itineraries, event logistics, and contingency planning.
* **AI and systems:** Use AI for drafting, research, summarization, meeting notes, and data cleanup. Build templates, automations, and SOPs that reduce recurring manual work.
* **Executive and personal support:** Handle administrative and personal requests with discretion, including appointments, reservations, expenses, reimbursements, and other executive logistics.
* **Relationship management:** Serve as a trusted and professional point of contact for internal leaders, physicians, partners, vendors, and other external relationships.

**Experience \& Qualifications**
--------------------------------



We're looking for someone who brings:


* **2\+ years of experience** supporting a senior executive, founder, or entrepreneur, ideally in a smaller or fast\-growing organization where you have worn multiple hats.
* **Genuine interest in health and wellness, longevity, health optimization, supplements, or life sciences.** A clinical background is not required, but an interest in the space is.
* **Exceptional attention to detail.** You catch the wrong date, missing attachment, typo, or unfinished follow\-up before it becomes a problem.
* **Strong project management skills.** You can take an ambiguous request, break it into steps, establish priorities and deadlines, and follow through without constant supervision.
* **Clear, concise, and professional communication skills**, both written and verbal.
* **Working knowledge of AI tools.** Experience using tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to improve your work is a plus.
* **Absolute discretion** when handling sensitive business, financial, and personal information.
* **Comfort with ambiguity and change.** Plans change and priorities shift; you can adapt and re\-sequence without losing momentum.
* **Proactive ownership.** You anticipate what is needed, bring solutions rather than problems, and do not wait to be chased.
* Fluency with **Google Workspace, Slack, and project management tools**, with the ability to learn new systems quickly.
* Ability to work from the company's **Chicago office on a hybrid schedule**.

**Nice to Have**
----------------


* Event or conference coordination experience
* Experience with e\-commerce, training, accounting, or other operational platforms
* Social media management experience
* Experience building automations using tools such as Zapier, Make, or n8n

**How We Work**
---------------



The team values clear communication, agility, generosity, conscientiousness, and curiosity. People are expected to communicate early, adapt quickly, do the small things well, help without keeping score, and ask thoughtful questions rather than simply accepting the status quo.



This is a high\-accountability environment for someone who enjoys moving quickly, solving problems, and making the people around them more effective.


**Compensation \& Benefits**
----------------------------


* $75,000\-$95,000 base salary, can vary depending on experience
* Performance bonus eligibility
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Paid time off and company holidays
* Wellhub
* Learning and development allowance
* Employee product allowance
* Direct exposure to the leadership of two growing organizations

**Position Overview**

The Client Services \& Operations Coordinator plays an important role in creating an organized, responsive, and welcoming experience for both families and staff. This position serves as a key point of contact for prospective and current families, while also supporting the daily scheduling and operational needs of the tutoring center.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, an excellent verbal and written communicator, comfortable working independently, and able to think creatively when helping families find scheduling solutions. This person should have a strong understanding of our tutoring programs and services and be able to confidently educate prospective and current clients about the support we provide.

This role works closely with approximately 15 part\-time instructors each day to communicate schedule changes, prepare the center for daily operations, and ensure instructors have the information and materials they need to successfully support students. The position will also provide administrative and onboarding support to the

Director of Operations and work closely with the rest of the Lead Instructors that run the center from 4\-9 p.m. This role will also have insight into Management Meetings to ensure alignment with company wide initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client Services \& Scheduling**

● Answer incoming phone calls during non\-operational hours and assist families with scheduling, program questions, and general inquiries.

● Provide an exceptional customer service experience by being responsive, professional, patient, and solution\-oriented.

● Listen carefully to each family’s needs and make every effort to accommodate their scheduling requests.

● Think creatively when offering scheduling options and identify solutions that meet the needs of both the family and the center.

● Maintain a strong understanding of our tutoring programs, services, scheduling options, and policies in order to confidently educate prospective and current clients.

● Communicate the value of our programs and help families understand which services may best meet their needs.

● Serve as a reliable point of contact for parents who have questions regarding their accounts, communicating information provided by the Accounting Department and ensuring messages are relayed accurately and professionally.

● Ensure instructors have the appropriate materials and information needed for

their scheduled sessions.

● Support the Director of Operations in maintaining efficient systems and processes throughout the center.

**Customer Success Manager**  

Daybreak Health \| 100% Remote \| Full\-time


**About the role**  

You'll own a portfolio of 50\+ school districts and make sure they launch fast, run smoothly, and keep referring students. Your people are counselors, social workers, and school admin. Your job is to get them equipped and excited to send kids to care. This is execution at scale: technical onboarding, staff training, troubleshooting, adoption campaigns, and data analysis, with AI and internal tools handling the repetitive parts so you spend your time with people instead of building workflows from scratch. When you do this well, more kids get help.



**About Daybreak Health**



Daybreak partners with school districts to make sure any student who needs mental health care can actually get it. The gap we're closing is real: the recommended ratio is one school psychologist per 500 students, and the national reality is closer to one per 1,200, which means families wait months while counselors carry impossible caseloads. We match every student to a clinician based on language, culture, identity, and what they're actually working through, usually starting care within a week or two of a referral and at no cost to the family. It works. 81% of students improve on standardized clinical measures, 92% of families report meaningful behavioral change at home, and 80% of school staff see better attendance, grades, and behavior. **We're backed by Union Square Ventures, Lux Capital, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Maven Ventures, and Y Combinator**, and we already serve districts representing more than a million students. That still leaves most of the country without an answer, which is exactly where this role comes in.



**What you'll do**


* Lead district onboarding, staff activation, and dashboard training
* Troubleshoot account access, referral submissions, and scope questions, with white\-glove support for strategic districts
* Run staff trainings and info sessions that get people genuinely bought in
* Build training capacity models across your cohort so you can flag capacity risk before it turns into a launch delay
* Set the support and engagement strategy per district, with real autonomy to choose the approach
* Execute adoption campaigns: campus visits, email outreach, webinars, data\-driven interventions
* Find creative ways to reach teachers and parents, not just counselors and admin
* Watch leading indicators like non\-contributor district rates and escalate a rising rate as a structural signal, not a seasonal dip
* Turn district data into action, and keep your portfolio documented in shared tools so your work compounds for the team
* Use AI to build personalized training decks, campaigns, and district talk tracks, then apply your own judgment on context and tone
* Use AI to review activation pacing and referral trend lines so you can spend more human time on the districts that need it
* Bring what you learn to weekly GTM meetings, where AI fluency is a shared practice rather than a personal hack


**Skills**


* District and campus onboarding and implementation
* Live training and facilitation for adult learners
* Adoption and engagement campaign execution
* Project management across many concurrent launches
* Data analysis and simple modeling (capacity, pacing, funnel)
* Independent technical troubleshooting
* Practical AI fluency for drafting, analysis, and pattern\-spotting
* Cross\-functional collaboration
* Strong written and verbal communication
* Documentation in shared tools (Notion, Google Docs and Slides)


**Who thrives here**


* Great communicator and idea generator
* Natural problem\-solver who figures things out without being handed the answer
* Connects dots across teams, products, and initiatives
* Knows when to jump in and help and when to hold people accountable
* Takes pride in support so fast and pleasant it creates champions
* Scrappy and adaptable, comfortable in constant startup change
* Sees AI as a way to do more of the job well, not a shortcut around the judgment parts

### **Qualifications**



Must\-haves


* Experience in EdTech, education, or healthcare partnerships, product support, and enablement
* K\-12 background
* Track record driving adoption at scale, think 100\+ customers and thousands of end users
* Strong project management across multiple launches at different phases
* Tech savvy: picks up new systems fast, troubleshoots independently, uses AI tools daily
* Exceptional organization across deadlines and deliverables
* Self\-starter who sees what needs to happen and makes it happen
* Strong written and verbal communication
* Comfortable turning data into insight, including building simple models


Nice\-to\-haves


* Experience with mental health or SEL products
* Previous work inside a K\-12 district or on a campus
* Salesforce or similar CRM experience

Apprentices will then join a Google team to train on\-the\-job, while continuing to engage in track\-specific learnings and career workshops throughout the program. The Talent Administrative Coordinator provides day\-to\-day administrative support to the Talent Manager and helps ensure that new hires and employees move smoothly through Active Learning’s onboarding and employee processes.This is a highly organized, communication\-focused administrative position. The primary responsibilities include coordinating new hire onboarding, communicating with candidates and employees, collecting and tracking required documentation, maintaining employee records and compliance trackers, assisting with employee updates, and supporting offboarding processes.The Talent Administrative Coordinator will frequently communicate with new hires, prospective employees, and current staff and must be professional, responsive, welcoming, and comfortable following up consistently regarding deadlines and outstanding requirements.This position reports directly to the Talent Manager and supports the Talent Manager in maintaining organized, accurate, and efficient Talent operations.

**Employee Documentation \& Records**

* Maintain accurate and organized employee personnel records.

* Review employee records regularly for missing, incomplete, or expired documentation.
* Follow up with employees regarding required updates or missing information.

**Compliance \& Certification Tracking**

* Maintain administrative trackers for employee certifications, clearances, and required employment documentation.

* Strong administrative and organizational skills.

new_jobs.description:
**About Glide**
GLIDE is a nationally recognized center for social justice, dedicated to fighting systemic injustices, creating pathways out of poverty and crisis, and transforming lives. Through its integrated comprehensive services, advocacy initiatives, and inclusive community, GLIDE empowers individuals, families, and children to achieve stability and to thrive. GLIDE is on the forefront of addressing some of society’s most pressing issues, including poverty, housing and homelessness, and racial and social justice. GLIDE’s mission is to create a radically inclusive, just, and loving community mobilized to alleviate suffering and break the cycles of poverty and marginalization **Position Summary**:
GLIDE’s Women’s Center is seeking a compassionate and organized Program Coordinator to support the delivery of services for individuals who identify as women who are in immediate need of housing, essential needs (e.g., food, clothes, hygiene supplies) health and mental health services, navigation, and case management support, group support, etc. due to homelessness, gender\-based violence, and trauma. The Women’s Center will assess client’s needs, provide information and support to overcome barriers, provide early intervention, and case management. The Women’s Center Program Coordinator will assist the Senior Director to plan, coordinate, and implement the Center’s programs and services, provide direct services, and support other general operations of the program, such as facilitate/co\-facilitate groups and plan Center events. This individual will collaborate with the director, staff, and community partners to ensure compliance with multiple\-funding sources and their requirements.
### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**


* Develop, coordinate, and maintain relationships and collaborations with GLIDE’s programs, established and new community partners to benefit participants and promote GLIDE’s Women’s Center.
* Be responsible for the coordination, creation, maintenance of service and/or staff schedules and business documentation (e.g. reports, flyers).
* Working in collaboration with case managers, develop and document Individualized Service Plans (ISPs) for clients, including data entry and reporting through CRM tools. Be responsible for organizing and managing Women’s Center events, which will involve coordinating all logistical aspects.
* Provide data coordination and quality assurance checks to ensure services meet predetermined standards and client satisfaction.
* Provide low\-threshold advocacy and case management, which includes referral, linkages, and assistance to health, health services, legal aid, and other human services and resources to support the client to reach their goals for improved safety, wellness, and quality of life.
* Conduct street and community outreach and attend community events to reach women and to promote the Women’s Center.
* Collaborate with Director to assign administrative tasks, referrals, cases, etc. to program staff. Ensure timely referral processing and allocation of new cases to other Women’s Center staff.
* Perform triage, intakes, needs assessments, service planning, service coordination, and follow up contacts in person, by email or phone with clients and other providers.
* Apply strength\-based services that are centered around motivational interviewing, cultural humility, and trauma\-informed care.
* Plan, organize, and oversee group sessions, activities, workshops, and individual support servies for clients Lead/co\-facilitate women educational and empowerment groups virtually and onsite.
* Maintain files and database records to track client progress. Prepare reports, success stories and challenges for internal review and reporting to external funders and stakeholders,; Ensure timely and accurate compliance with all reporting requirements.
* Adhere to professional boundaries and standards. Understand and follow basis ethics, values, and principles of regulatory practices. Adhere to all laws and requirements regarding HIPPA, confidentiality, child protective services, contractual agreements, etc.
* Meet professional obligations through efficient work habits such as collaborating with co\-workers, meeting deadlines, honoring schedules, attend and actively participating in staff and individual meeting, community meeting, supervision, case conferences, client conferences and in\-service trainings.
### **Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in relevant field (e.g., psychology, social work, sociology, criminal justice) preferred; or at least four years of experience providing services (e.g., case management, or coordination of services) to women experiencing homelessness, domestic violence, gender\-based violence, and/or have been incarcerated.
* Demonstrated understanding of the psycho\-social and economic issues that impact women.
* Group facilitation experience helpful.
* Facilitates collaboration among Women’s Center staff and other GLIDE departments.
* Ability to develop processes and operations to support the implantation of new ideas and approaches.
* Knowledge of trauma informed approaches in supporting vulnerable women with a range of complex needs, particularly women of color experience houselessness, poverty, and other traumatic experiences.
* Has the ability to work effectively across cultures.
* Ability to plan, prioritize and organize tasks and meet deadlines, Strong attention to detail, particularly documentation of case files and updating database.
* Works well under pressure and manages stress effectively in a demanding and fast paced environment.
* Commitment to the mission, values, and philosophy of GLIDE.
### **Physical Requirements**


Reasonable accommodations can be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* Ability to work on a computer and see details of objects at close range.
* Ability to hear within normal range, and communicate effectively (in person, telephone or Zoom).

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Excellent written, verbal, organizational, and administrative skills, with strict confidentiality always.
* Excellent organizational and multitasking skills with the ability to manage simultaneous projects of varying complexity and meet deadlines.
* Proven accuracy and attention to detail.
* Demonstrated supervisory and critical\-thinking skills.
* Highly proficient with Macintosh, MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, database and graphics programs.
* Strong proficiency with office management technologies and video conferencing software.
* Experience planning and scheduling meetings and seminars, including national and international travel and coordination of AV needs with IT
* A lifelong learner committed to the Buck’s mission.

Our success will ultimately change healthcare. The Buck Institute aims to end the threat of age\-related diseases for current and future generations by bringing together highly capable and passionate scientists from a broad range of disciplines to identify and impede the mechanisms of aging.

new_jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 40\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. -----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. -----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.
