new_jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager, Paid Social
new_jobs.description:
**About Decagon**


Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.


Our technology enables industry\-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.


We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world\-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.


We’re an in\-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.

**About the Role**


We're looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to scale Decagon's paid social programs internationally, with an initial focus on EMEA. This role owns paid social spend end\-to\-end—LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, emerging platforms—and is responsible for standing up and scaling an EMEA motion. You'll partner closely with EMEA sales leadership to make sure spend allocation tracks where the deals actually are, not just where measurement is easiest.


This is a channel\-owner role for someone who's spiked in paid social specifically and has managed large budgets where efficiency and allocation decisions really matter. While paid social is the core of the role, you'll also flex into adjacent demand gen work—ABM, landing pages, email—as EMEA\-specific needs come up.

 **In this role, you will**

* Own paid social end\-to\-end: Run LinkedIn, Meta, X, and emerging platforms from creative brief through launch, optimization, and reporting. You're accountable for efficiency and output across the full paid social budget, not just execution.
* Scale spend into EMEA: Stand up and grow a paid social motion in EMEA from its current early stage. Adapt targeting, creative, and budget pacing to local buying behavior, currencies, and compliance requirements (GDPR and beyond).
* Align spend to sales opportunity: Partner with EMEA sales leadership to make sure budget allocation tracks where the actual pipeline opportunity is by market and segment, not just where measurement is easiest.
* Build the attribution story: Own how paid social spend connects to pipeline and revenue by market and channel. Bring your own point of view on what's working, backed by data, not just activity metrics like CTR and CPL.
* Test and systematize: Run structured experiments across creative, audiences, and channels, and turn what works into repeatable playbooks the rest of the team can use.
* Flex into adjacent demand gen: Support EMEA\-specific ABM, landing pages, and email work as needs come up, in partnership with the broader demand gen team.

 **Your background looks something like this**

* 5\+ years in performance marketing with a clear specialization in paid social (LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, TikTok, or similar) rather than search.
* Managed paid social budgets at meaningful scale (six\-figure\+ monthly spend) and can speak to how you allocated across campaigns, audiences, and markets.
* Have run or scaled paid social programs in EMEA specifically—different currencies, buying behaviors, compliance considerations (GDPR, etc.), and local nuances in creative and targeting.
* Analytical and comfortable owning your own attribution story: connecting spend by market/channel to pipeline and revenue, not just CTR and CPL.
* Used to working cross\-functionally with regional sales teams to align spend with where the pipeline opportunity actually is.
* Can flex beyond paid social into adjacent demand gen work (ABM, landing pages, email) when EMEA\-specific needs call for it.
* Thrive in a fast\-paced startup environment, where you're expected to take ownership, move quickly, and learn as you go.

 **Even better if you have**

* Have experience with Clay or similar audience\-building tools and are comfortable building and iterating on paid audiences
* Have stood up a paid social program in a new region from scratch (rather than inheriting one already built).
* Speak a European language relevant to key EMEA markets (UK, DACH, France, Benelux, Nordics).
* Bring point of view on emerging paid social channels or formats worth testing in EMEA.

 **Benefits**


We proudly offer the following benefits for our full\-time employees:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family
* Life Insurance and Disability Benefits
* Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)
* Parental Leave
* Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot
* Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work\-life balance
* Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best
* Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave)

*These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.*


Compensation Range: $160K \- $210K

new_jobs.title: Territory Sales Representative - Entry Level / Full Time
new_jobs.description:
Territory Sales Representative – Entry Level / Full Time
  
  

San Francisco CA
  
  

Break Into Pharmaceutical Sales with Pivya® at ImpactBio supporting Alembic Therapeutics
  
  

Do you have work experience that demonstrates drive, energy, and transferable skills that will lead to being a strong salesperson?
  
If you are looking to launch a career in pharmaceutical sales, this is your opportunity!
  
  

Alembic Therapeutics, in partnership with ImpactBio, is launching Pivya®, an FDA\-approved oral antibiotic for uncomplicated urinary tract infections (uUTIs). With over 40 years of success in Sweden, Pivya® is now entering the U.S. market—and we’re building a high\-performance sales team to support this launch.
  
  

As a Territory Sales Representative, you don’t need prior pharmaceutical sales experience—we’re looking for motivated, coachable individuals who are eager to learn, follow a proven sales model, and build a long\-term career in the industry. You’ll receive the training, tools, and mentorship needed to succeed while gaining real\-world experience calling on healthcare providers.
  
  

This full\-time role is with ImpactBio, a premier commercial partner in Life Sciences, with the potential to transition to Alembic Therapeutics based on strong performance.
  
View Openings \& Apply Here Job Openings \- ImpactBio
  
  

Why This Role Matters
  
  

This is more than a sales job—it’s a career entry point into pharmaceutical sales. You’ll be part of a national product launch, gaining experience in a highly competitive industry while developing the skills and discipline needed to grow your career.
  
  

**We’re looking for individuals who are:**  

* Hungry to succeed
* Open to coaching and feedback
* Willing to follow a structured plan
* Ready to put in the work to build something meaningful


If that sounds like you, we’ll teach you the rest.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Promote Pivya® to healthcare providers within your assigned territory
* Learn and execute a structured sales process and messaging strategy
* Build relationships with physicians, nurses, and office staff
* Consistently apply training and coaching in the field
* Develop and execute territory plans to achieve sales goals
* Provide timely updates, insights, and field feedback to leadership
* Maintain full compliance with all company and industry regulations


What We’re Looking For
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required
* 1–3 years of experience meeting or exceeding goals/metrics (some sales experience would be helpful, B2B sales, Pharma sales, outside sales, customer facing)
* A strong desire to break into pharmaceutical or healthcare sales
* Proven work ethic and demonstrated a track record of going above and beyond to succeed
* Coachability—someone who takes direction well and applies feedback quickly
* High level of motivation, resilience, and accountability
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently while following a defined sales plan
* Willingness to travel extensively within territory
* Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record


Pharmaceutical experience is not required—drive, attitude, and willingness to learn are.
  
  

What We Offer
  
  

* Competitive base salary with a generous performance\-based incentive plan
* Comprehensive Medical, Dental \& Vision coverage
* Car allowance \& mileage reimbursement
* 401K plan with company match
* Paid time off and holidays
* Structured training program designed to help you break into and succeed in pharmaceutical sales
* Ongoing mentorship and field coaching
* A clear path for career growth and advancement
* The chance to be part of a major U.S. product launch


About Alembic Therapeutics
  
  

Alembic Therapeutics LLC, a U.S. subsidiary of Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., is committed to delivering high\-quality, patient\-focused branded pharmaceuticals. Our mission is to bring innovative, reliable medicines to the U.S. market while upholding the highest standards of safety, efficacy, and quality.
  
  

About ImpactBio
  
  

At ImpactBio, we build and launch commercial teams with a focus on performance, development, and long\-term success. We’re known for investing in our people and creating opportunities for driven individuals to grow into high\-performing professionals in the life sciences industry.
  
  

The annual base salary for this position is $65,000\. Compensation is aligned with the position’s scope and internal pay structure.
  
  

Apply Now
  
  

View Openings \& Apply Here Job Openings \- ImpactBio
  
  

ImpactBio is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)
  
  

We appreciate your interest in our company, however; only candidates meeting qualifications will be considered.

new_jobs.description:
Description:
**Why Join ADAPT?**


It's more than a job; it's a calling. It's where passion meets purpose. ADAPT Community Network, formerly United Cerebral Palsy (UCP) of NYC provides a multitude of services to people with developmental disabilities. At ADAPT, we are 3,000 strong, and it takes every one of us to empower the lives of the people we support. With caring and great resources at hand, we know what it takes to help people live fuller, happier, healthier lives. Our employees show their commitment to the people we support every day, and we all deliver on our promise to provide innovative and comprehensive services to individuals with developmental disabilities.


For your next career move, apply with us at ADAPT Community Network! Wherever you work among our many locations around New York City, ADAPT offers paid training, competitive benefits, and we foster a team culture of learning, support, collaboration and career growth.

**SUMMARY**


Under general supervision, is responsible for devoting their attention to the care and development of the people we support in one of the Agency’s residential facilities. Interacts in a manner which fosters dignity and learning in a way that helps lead to greater independence. Helps create a homelike atmosphere for the people we support in an agency facility.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**


The duties and responsibilities of the On\-Call Residence Program Specialist will include but are not limited to the following:

* Provides care and assists with personal development and independence of the people we support.
* Ensures that all measures for safety and well\-being are maintained at highest level.
* Provides training for the people we support in activities of daily living and in development of self\-help and social skills.

* Administers appropriate first aid based on visible symptoms and medical history of the people we support in accordance with established guidelines and accepted first aid practices.
* Summons police, fire, ambulance or other emergency personnel if situation warrants it.
* If an emergency has caused a person we support to exhibit behavior that is threatening or dangerous, may have to utilize strategies for crisis intervention in accordance with OPWDD approved Behavior Management guidelines.
* Assists with transportation for the people we support to and from work, shopping, programs, restaurants, movies, doctor’s appointments, etc.
* Assists with meal planning and preparation as well as with purchasing of food and supplies.
* Demonstrates an understanding of and implements behavioral programs.
* Participates fully as a member of interdisciplinary plan.
* Maintains an ongoing informal exchange of information. Maintains written logs for recording daily activities.
* Performs housekeeping, cooking, laundry, light maintenance and light preventative maintenance duties as needed to maintain a safe and homelike environment.
* Supervises any other activities as may be necessary to maintain quality of the program.
* Completes all activities related to skill buildings as outlined in individual program plans
* Provides support around personal hygiene, i.e. toileting, bathing and changing as needed.
* Handles all personal documents of the people we support in a secure and confidential manner.
* Performs related duties as requested.


Requirements:
**QUALIFICATIONS**


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Ability to read, write, speak and understand English
* Good oral and written communication skills
* Good interpersonal skills necessary to interact effectively with co\-workers, employees, residents and their families
* Ability to analyze problems and determine corrective measures

**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE**

* High School Diploma or GED required
* Six months of related experience is preferred but not required

**COMPENSATION:** $16\.49/hour

**At ADAPT, we value diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and belonging**. We strive to ensure that our employees are comfortable bringing their whole, authentic self to work and that the people we support can also be their authentic selves. We value diverse backgrounds, opinions, ideas, and ways of thinking. We aim to build an inclusive and diverse workforce that is empowered and supported with leaders who create diverse and inclusive teams. We continuously seek opportunities for the organization to foster a more positive, respected, united, and collaborative culture.


ADAPT Community Network is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Qualified candidates of diverse ethnic and racial backgrounds and status are encouraged to apply for vacant positions at all levels.

We are seeking a Client Success Manager to own the post\-sale client journey for assigned new business accounts\- from signed deal through launch, activation, early adoption, and handoff into ongoing account management. The goal is a seamless transition from signed account to active, engaged client\- reducing friction, accelerating time to value, surfacing risk early, and bringing in the right specialist resources at the right time.


The Client Success Manager is the primary post\-sale relationship owner and "quarterback" across the early client lifecycle, accountable for client readiness, launch coordination, onboarding progress, standard\-account adoption execution, early engagement, and risk management. The role doesn't personally own every specialist workstream, but ensures each one happens successfully.


This is not a quota\-carrying role. Success is measured by how effectively clients launch, activate, adopt key products and workflows, engage early, and transition cleanly into ongoing account management.

* Serve as the primary point of contact from signed deal through onboarding and early adoption.

***Partner with Engagement and Lifecycle teams to deepen usage***

* Use engagement reporting and health signals to prioritize interventions.
* Connect clients to the right in\-life programs as they move from onboarding into sustained engagement.

***Monitor account health and manage risk***


* Track usage, activation milestones, and health signals to catch stalled onboarding, weak adoption, or early churn risk.
* Escalate early and coordinate support across Adoption, Engagement, Customer Care, Operations, and Account Management.
* Ensure critical issues stay owned and teams stay aligned on actions and timing.

***Act as the voice of the client internally***


* Share feedback, adoption insights, and emerging needs with Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Care, and Client Success leadership.

***Support a clean handoff into ongoing account management***


* Ensure a clear transition from early post\-sale ownership into the ongoing account management motion once onboarding and early adoption are complete.

**Success Measures**


Measured on adoption, engagement, readiness, and handoff outcomes rather than direct revenue. KPIs may include:

* Time to onboarding completion and time to first value
* Activation and seat activation rate
* Adoption of priority products, workflows, and features
* Usage frequency, engagement depth, and health score movement
* Participation in training, webinars, and lifecycle programs
* Early identification and escalation of churn risk or stalled onboarding
* Quality of handoff into ongoing account management

**Cross\-Functional Partnerships**


* **Sales Account Executives** — post\-sale handoff and continuity from signed deal into launch
* **Regional Sales Coordinators** — order processing, account setup/changes, billing coordination
* **Operations and Fulfillment** — provisioning, entitlements, technical readiness, launch execution
* **Adoption Specialists** — onboarding strategy, playbooks, training, high\-touch support
* **Engagement Strategy \& Performance / Customer Lifecycle Marketing** — health monitoring, engagement plays, in\-life programs
* **Enterprise Customer Care \& Voice of Customer** — escalations, white\-glove service, feedback loops
* **Account Managers** — transition planning and ongoing relationship continuity

**You Have:**

new_jobs.description:
New York
Product
In office
Full\-time
**What is Bilt?**
Bilt is the membership for where you live.  

  

What started as a way to reward people on their largest expense has turned into an ecosystem connecting our members, property managers and local merchants.
Travel, dining, fitness, everyday spend. We are building systems across payments, credit, loyalty, and commerce all at once.  

  

We run lean and move quickly. Every person here has a real impact on what gets built and how fast it happens.  

  

This role comes with real ownership and high expectations. If you prefer clearly defined lanes and structure, this will feel uncomfortable. If you want to build quickly, have a real say in what gets built, and work on products used by millions, you will likely do your best work here.
**What’s the role?**
As a Technical Account Manager, you'll own the technical relationship for a portfolio of our enterprise and retail partners, making sure the product we build actually fits how they operate — both for their initial launch and for everything we build after. You'll be the connective tissue between what partners need and what our product and engineering teams ship, translating real\-world partner requirements into roadmap input while also owning the technical integration work that gets them live. While this person must have strong technical acumen and relationship management skills, they must also demonstrate a self\-starter attitude and creative problem\-solving. This is an exciting opportunity to join at the ground floor of a new product line at Bilt: a retail platform that orchestrates a seamless, personalized user experience across every merchant in the neighborhood. Experience in the payments space is strongly preferred. Experience supporting enterprise partners, along with retail \& POS integrations, is a plus.  

  

**In this role, you will…**
* Partner with product and engineering during pre\-launch to make sure new integrations and capabilities are scoped to fit the actual needs of enterprise and retail partners, not just the technical spec.
* Own the end\-to\-end launch process for your assigned partners, ensuring our API\-driven platform fits seamlessly into each partner's ecosystem from day one.
* Act as the voice of the partner internally, surfacing recurring needs, gaps, and feedback to product and engineering to influence what we build next.
* Be an expert on our integrations and capabilities, able to present these concepts concisely to client management, executive leadership, and the partner itself.
* Own and manage a book of assigned partners post\-launch, troubleshooting recurring technical issues, driving escalations to resolution, and documenting bugs with a focus on completion.
* Run technical calls spanning our retail partners, payment device team, and payment processors, aligning all parties on a single path to launch
* Serve as the technical escalation point for your portfolio, working in a rapid\-pace environment to analyze urgency and collaborate across internal teams.
* Collaborate with product and engineering on ticket documentation, test plans, end\-to\-end validation in test environments, and monitoring data after deployments.
* Identify new capabilities, technology partners, and integration opportunities that expand what we can offer partners.
* Facilitate knowledge sharing across teams by creating internal and external training material, such as configuration setup guides, FAQ documents, and flow diagrams.
* Have a base knowledge of SQL and Postman to quickly validate information and resolve integration issues.
  

  

**In terms of qualifications, we’re seeking:**
* 5\+ years in a technical account management, solutions engineering, implementation, or partner engineering role
* Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, webhooks, and how to read/write API specifications
* Working knowledge of SQL and Postman to independently investigate and validate issues
* Experience in payments (processing, card networks, or payment operations) — strongly preferred
* Familiarity with loyalty/rewards programs and POS/retail hardware — a plus
* Track record of owning technical relationships with external partners, including scoping, launch, and post\-launch support
* Comfort operating across ambiguity — this is a new product line, and priorities will shift as we learn
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to flex between engineering\-level detail and executive\-level summary
* Experience troubleshooting production issues under time pressure, including coordinating across multiple internal and external teams
  

  

**Benefits:**
* **Compensation** \- We offer a competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity and our performance bonus program
* **Health insurance for you (\& your loved ones) from day one** \- Enjoy a One Medical Membership, wellness stipends, family programs and more, on us. We’ve got you and your family covered from day one.
* **401k plan with a match** \- Retirement may feel more like a pipe dream than a reality but we’re here to help you get there.
* **Commuter FSAs** \- We believe the best ideas come from being together in one place. We just don’t think getting there should be so expensive.
* **UNLIMITED PTO** \- Because we believe that working hard shouldn’t mean always working. Take time for you as often as you need it.
* **Exclusive Employee only Bilt Points** \- We give our employees unique opportunities to earn points throughout their time at Bilt.
* **Team Events** \- We believe in human connection so we hold events to help our employees break from the monotony of the typical work week.
  

  

At Bilt Rewards, we believe in transparency and we do our best to make sure the company and our candidates are on the same page as it relates to compensation. * All contracted assets and deliverables are clearly tracked, communicated, and executed on time

* Client materials are clear, accurate, polished, and ready for senior\-level audiences
* The account operates with a high level of responsiveness, organization, accountability, and attention to detail

  

**Job Requirements**
* Essential duties are performed onsite in the New York, NY office with some nights weekends and/or travel for client programs and events

### **Who We Are**



VML is a leading creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce, creating connected brands to drive growth. VML is celebrated for its innovative and award\-winning human\-first work for clients including AstraZeneca, Colgate\-Palmolive, Dell, Ford, Microsoft, Nestlé, The Coca\-Cola Company, and Wendy's. In 2026, VML was named *Campaign's* Global Network of the Year and ranked \#2 Creative Network of the Year at Cannes Lions. VML's global network spans 55\+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.



VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.



For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn \#WeAreVML.

**Who we are looking for:**



VML is seeking an Associate Account Manager to support the day\-to\-day activities and creative execution of integrated campaigns over a notable global consumer packaged goods brand. You will be a client liaison overseeing delivery of work for a global new product launch, ensuring client approvals are secured, client objectives are achieved, and timelines and budgets are met. You will play a role in communicating externally with the clients while supporting our internal teams to keep all apprised of project status, updates and changes.


**What you'll do:**


* **Client Support \|** Build rapport and credibility with client based on trust, sound counsel, responsiveness to client needs and flawless execution. Develop and update both client and project documents including: creative briefs, estimates, project timelines, media plans, status reports, conference reports and other supporting materials.
* **Team \|** Collaborate with creative, project management, production, and/or media teams to develop marketing programs and solutions for client. Keep agency team informed of client requests and changes, anticipate potential problems, and proactively develop solutions.
* **Process \|** Review all documents and creative work prior to submitting to client for review. Organize client presentations, meetings and conference calls, and prepare relevant documents, including agendas, meeting materials and conference reports. Capture and interpret program results, summarize findings, and work with senior team members to recommend program enhancements and/or changes to improve going forward


**What you'll need:**


* 0\-1 years of advertising agency experience or equivalent internship experience
* Knowledge and interest in CPG marketing and 360 integrated campaigns
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
* An ability to build relationships and collaborate across teams, departments, vendors and clients to successfully accomplish work
* Strong attention to detail, organization, and professionalism
* Ability to effectively managing multiple projects, timelines, and deliverables simultaneously


**What we offer:**


* **Passionate, driven people** \| We champion a culture of people that do extraordinary work.
* **Consciously cultivated culture** \| We aim to embody the behaviors to build an inclusive community that is in it together, bringing both positivity and active listening into the workplace as we simultaneously strive to empower creative bravery.
* **Competitive benefits** \| What we offer full time hires ranges from the full spectrum of group health coverage options (medical, dental, vision) to a generous 401k match (100% dollar\-for\-dollar match, up to 5% of salary contribution), and a variety of paid time off offerings that reflect our investment in all aspects of your overall life balance and wellness.
* **Growth\-minded opportunities** \| We aim to nurture a culture of real\-time feedback, growth\-oriented mindset, and plenty of training opportunities through VML and WPP, so you can continue to grow personally and professionally.


We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

new_jobs.title: Etsy Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
Etsy Account Manager — Fine Jewelry (Full\-Time, On\-Site)

**About the role**

We're a fine jewelry company selling lab grown diamond engagement rings and jewelry online. We're looking for someone to manage and grow our Etsy shop. This is a hands\-on role for someone who already knows Shop Manager inside and out and wants full responsibility for a growing catalog.

**What you'll do**

* Create and maintain and update listings
* Keep pricing, variations, and inventory accurate across hundreds of listings
* Write and optimize titles, tags, and descriptions for Etsy search
* Respond to buyer messages and custom order inquiries within Etsy's response window
* Manage orders, shipping labels, tracking, and post\-sale follow\-up
* Run and monitor Etsy Ads, and report monthly on revenue, fees, ad spend, and conversion
* Handle returns, refunds, and cases while protecting shop metrics

**Requirements**

* 3\+ years managing an Etsy shop through Shop Manager, not just selling on Etsy
* Experience with listings that use multiple variation sets and large option matrices
* Working knowledge of Etsy SEO: titles, 13 tags, categories, attributes, and shop sections
* Comfortable in Excel or Google Sheets, including bulk upload and edit files
* Strong written English for buyer messages and product descriptions
* Detail\-oriented with SKUs, pricing, and inventory data.
* Able to follow a set process exactly, including naming conventions, character limits, and draft\-before\-publish rules

**Preferred**

* Fine jewelry or diamond industry background, or familiarity with carat, center stone shapes, 14K, lab grown, halo, pavé, solitaire
* Experience running Etsy Ads and reading the stats and traffic dashboards
* Basic photo work: cropping, resizing, reordering images, white background cleanup
* Familiarity with Star Seller metrics and case handling

**To apply**

Send your resume and a link to at least one Etsy shop you've personally managed.

Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

Full time

**About the Role:**


As the Account Manager for Oxford Analytica and Dragonfly (Global Risk Insights) you will be tasked with executing revenue growth in the Americas region for your existing client book with Oxford Analytica and Dragonfly clients predominantly. You will be directly responsible for owning the renewal success of your accounts. You will be responsible for establishing and maintaining strong relationships with our existing clients, ensuring their satisfaction, and driving increased revenue through cross\-selling and upselling opportunities. You will work closely with the Head of Account Management GRI, to implement effective client retention and revenue growth strategies. Your role requires effective collaboration with Client Success teams and Business Development Managers.


**You Will:**


* Manage a book of business allocated by Head of Account Management GRI, within your geographical territory securing renewals and upsell
* Cultivate long\-term relationships with our key clients, understanding their business objectives, pain points, and challenges to identify opportunities for upselling and cross\-selling

new_jobs.title: Account Manager | Growth
new_jobs.description:
**About Ramp**
==============


Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.


The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving.


We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.


The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.


If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the Role**
==================


As a member of the Growth Account Management team, you will deliver value to our customers and revenue for our business by owning expansion and retention of a scaled portfolio of current Ramp customers. You will help identify growth opportunities within your portfolio and operate a set of scaled touch\-points to engage with these customers. As an early member of the team, you will have the opportunity to help build and refine Ramp’s scaled account management motion.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Identify expansion opportunities within a scaled portfolio of Ramp customers and own the entire sales process through close
* Develop and execute upsell/cross\-sell strategies and maintain a robust expansion pipeline
* Develop a deep understanding of Ramp customer personas and act as a trusted advisor and consultant to help them achieve their goals with Ramp
* Leverage sales methodologies to uncover customer needs and pain points
* Gather and provide customer feedback to directly inform Ramp’s product roadmap \& customer communication strategy
* Collaborate with cross\-functional partners to continuously improve operational efficiencies while also advocating for your customers

**What You Need**
-----------------

* Minimum 2 years of customer\-facing or direct sales experience
* Proven track record of achievement in a high velocity business environment
* Prior CRM experience (preferably Salesforce)
* Experience with outbound prospecting and conducting product demonstrations, with a high level of comfort with sales tools \& processes
* Consultative sales approach and comfortable leveraging analytical \& quantitative skills, with a deep interest in understanding business challenges
* Ability to discuss Ramp's value proposition with C\-level executives, finance teams, and decision makers
* Consistent track record of hitting or exceeding sales targets in a fast\-paced and metrics\-driven environment
* Dedication to tracking and improving performance and efficiency on a daily basis
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to deliver compelling sales pitches and presentations
* Organizational, project management, and time management skills
* Sense of entrepreneurship: a self\-starter with a high sense of urgency and ability to work within undefined processes

**Nice\-to\-Haves**
-------------------

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university
* Experience with financial services sales
* Experience at a high\-growth startup

**Benefits available to all full\-time Ramp employees (Global)**
----------------------------------------------------------------

* Flexible PTO
* Centralized home\-office equipment ordering
* Health and wellness stipend
* Budget for intra\-office travel
* Weekly coffee stipend

**United States**
-----------------

* 100% medical, dental \& vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents
* One Medical annual membership
* 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp
* Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay
* Pet insurance
* In\-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more
* Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

**Canada**
----------

* Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life
* Life, AD\&D, and disability coverage
* Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)
* Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP \+ DPSP)
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay
* Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

**United Kingdom**
------------------

* Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite
* Virtual GP and at\-home care via eMed x Livi
* Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

**Referral Instructions**
-------------------------


If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

  

**Other notices**
-----------------


Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

 *Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @**Ramp.com* *email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.*

new_jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

The Client Services Onsite Support Engineer is a full\-time position placed onsite at one of our client locations. Working as an embedded member of the client’s team, you serve as the primary frontline resource for users who need prompt, courteous, and effective technical support. In this role, you will respond to requests for assistance in person, by phone, and through support channels, while troubleshooting hardware, software, and basic system issues. The ideal candidate combines strong customer service skills with sound technical judgment, maintains accurate documentation, and delivers reliable support that helps end users remain productive. This position also plays an important role in escalating complex issues appropriately, following standard operating procedures, and contributing to a positive client support experience. This is a full\-time, onsite placement at a single client site and is not a remote position.  

  

The work schedule for this position will be 12:00PM \- 9:00PM ET Monday \- Friday.  


  

The ideal candidate will bring 2–5 years of experience in a helpdesk, desktop support, or technical support environment, with a demonstrated ability to troubleshoot common hardware, software, and user\-access issues effectively. This individual should be comfortable working directly with end users as an embedded member of a client’s team, managing multiple requests, and maintaining a service\-oriented approach in a fast\-paced setting. Basic industry certifications are a plus and may include credentials such as CompTIA A\+, CompTIA Network\+, Microsoft fundamentals, or similar entry\-level technical certifications.  


  

On a typical day, this role involves working onsite at the assigned client location, monitoring incoming support requests and assisting users with a wide range of technical needs. You will communicate with end users to gather relevant details, troubleshoot problems methodically, document actions taken, and ensure each issue is followed through to completion or properly escalated. Success in this role requires balancing responsiveness with accuracy, maintaining a professional and helpful demeanor, and contributing to a dependable support experience that reflects the standards of the Client Services team.  

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the first point of contact for the client’s end users and IT staff seeking technical assistance.

  

* Develop working familiarity with the client’s environment, systems, users, and standard operating procedures.

  

* Coordinate with the LISS Technologies Client Services team on escalations, documentation, and reporting.

  

* Respond to inbound incidents and service requests through phone, email, ticketing systems, and in\-person support.

  

* Troubleshoot and resolve basic to intermediate hardware, software, connectivity, and account access issues in a timely manner.

  

* Maintain end\-to\-end ownership of support requests, ensuring timely follow\-up, clear communication, and appropriate resolution.

  

* Document incidents, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and user interactions accurately within the designated support system.

  

* Escalate unresolved or high\-impact issues to the appropriate LISS Technologies support teams in accordance with established procedures.

  

* Provide users with clear, easy\-to\-understand guidance and updates throughout the support process.

  

* Assist with setup, configuration, and basic maintenance of workstations, peripherals, and standard business applications.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Customer Success Manager**  

Daybreak Health \| 100% Remote \| Full\-time


**About the role**  

You'll own a portfolio of 50\+ school districts and make sure they launch fast, run smoothly, and keep referring students. Your people are counselors, social workers, and school admin. Your job is to get them equipped and excited to send kids to care. This is execution at scale: technical onboarding, staff training, troubleshooting, adoption campaigns, and data analysis, with AI and internal tools handling the repetitive parts so you spend your time with people instead of building workflows from scratch. When you do this well, more kids get help.



**About Daybreak Health**



Daybreak partners with school districts to make sure any student who needs mental health care can actually get it. The gap we're closing is real: the recommended ratio is one school psychologist per 500 students, and the national reality is closer to one per 1,200, which means families wait months while counselors carry impossible caseloads. We match every student to a clinician based on language, culture, identity, and what they're actually working through, usually starting care within a week or two of a referral and at no cost to the family. It works. 81% of students improve on standardized clinical measures, 92% of families report meaningful behavioral change at home, and 80% of school staff see better attendance, grades, and behavior. **We're backed by Union Square Ventures, Lux Capital, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Maven Ventures, and Y Combinator**, and we already serve districts representing more than a million students. That still leaves most of the country without an answer, which is exactly where this role comes in.



**What you'll do**


* Lead district onboarding, staff activation, and dashboard training
* Troubleshoot account access, referral submissions, and scope questions, with white\-glove support for strategic districts
* Run staff trainings and info sessions that get people genuinely bought in
* Build training capacity models across your cohort so you can flag capacity risk before it turns into a launch delay
* Set the support and engagement strategy per district, with real autonomy to choose the approach
* Execute adoption campaigns: campus visits, email outreach, webinars, data\-driven interventions
* Find creative ways to reach teachers and parents, not just counselors and admin
* Watch leading indicators like non\-contributor district rates and escalate a rising rate as a structural signal, not a seasonal dip
* Turn district data into action, and keep your portfolio documented in shared tools so your work compounds for the team
* Use AI to build personalized training decks, campaigns, and district talk tracks, then apply your own judgment on context and tone
* Use AI to review activation pacing and referral trend lines so you can spend more human time on the districts that need it
* Bring what you learn to weekly GTM meetings, where AI fluency is a shared practice rather than a personal hack


**Skills**


* District and campus onboarding and implementation
* Live training and facilitation for adult learners
* Adoption and engagement campaign execution
* Project management across many concurrent launches
* Data analysis and simple modeling (capacity, pacing, funnel)
* Independent technical troubleshooting
* Practical AI fluency for drafting, analysis, and pattern\-spotting
* Cross\-functional collaboration
* Strong written and verbal communication
* Documentation in shared tools (Notion, Google Docs and Slides)


**Who thrives here**


* Great communicator and idea generator
* Natural problem\-solver who figures things out without being handed the answer
* Connects dots across teams, products, and initiatives
* Knows when to jump in and help and when to hold people accountable
* Takes pride in support so fast and pleasant it creates champions
* Scrappy and adaptable, comfortable in constant startup change
* Sees AI as a way to do more of the job well, not a shortcut around the judgment parts

### **Qualifications**



Must\-haves


* Experience in EdTech, education, or healthcare partnerships, product support, and enablement
* K\-12 background
* Track record driving adoption at scale, think 100\+ customers and thousands of end users
* Strong project management across multiple launches at different phases
* Tech savvy: picks up new systems fast, troubleshoots independently, uses AI tools daily
* Exceptional organization across deadlines and deliverables
* Self\-starter who sees what needs to happen and makes it happen
* Strong written and verbal communication
* Comfortable turning data into insight, including building simple models


Nice\-to\-haves


* Experience with mental health or SEL products
* Previous work inside a K\-12 district or on a campus
* Salesforce or similar CRM experience

**Job Description**  

NOTE: ONLY CANDIDATES WHO HAVE A PERMANENT PRINCIPAL ADMINISTRATIVE ASSOCIATE OR COMPARABLE CIVIL SERVICE TITLE WILL BE CONSIDERED FOR AN INTERVIEW. PLEASE INCLUDE YOUR EMPLOYEE IDENTIFICATION NUMBER (EIN) WHEN APPLYING AND INDICATE IN YOUR COVER LETTER IF YOU ARE A PERMANENT PRINCIPAL ADMINISTRATIVE ASSOCIATE OR IN A COMPARABLE TITLE.  

  

THE AGENCY  

The Department of City Planning (DCP) plans for the future of New York City, working to create thriving and dynamic neighborhoods with access to housing and jobs, resilient infrastructure, and a vibrant public realm. The Department engages communities to develop inclusive plans, expands housing access and economic opportunity, and plans for long\-term sustainability.  

  

DCP supports the City Planning Commission in its annual review of hundreds of land use applications. The Department also advises on citywide strategic and capital planning, analyzes data, conducts policy analysis, and creates open data and civic engagement tools.  

  

The Department of City Planning offers staff meaningful opportunities to help shape the future of New York City and address some of its most pressing challenges. The Department values public service, collaboration, and creativity, and supports professional development. Learn more about DCP and view current job openings at www.nyc.gov/planning.  

  

THE DIVISION  

The Executive team coordinates the policy direction and management of the Department of City Planning. The team consists of the Office of the Director, Office of the Executive Director, Office of the Chief Operating Officer, the General Counsel and Communications and Intergovernmental functions. The team is responsible for setting the vision of the Department and directing resources to accomplish our goals.  

  

This motivated team works closely together and across all planning and support divisions to support a diverse set of activities that advance our mission to plan for the City of New York.  

  

THE ROLE  

The Executive Assistant will support the executive team by performing senior administrative work and other related general office duties, with latitude for independent judgment, including but not limited to the following:  

* Performs administrative work, including managing the executive team calendars, scheduling appointments, answering the telephone, referring, and routing calls, answering routine questions, and other general office work.
* Coordinate communications between multiple stakeholders; including agency staff, sister agencies, commissioners, and the mayor’s office.
* Utilizes Microsoft Office to perform complex word processing assignments involving independent performance of work, such as setting up and/or completing assignments that require the application of other than standard document or file formats; may perform data entry functions.
* Proactively distributes or collects materials in preparation for meetings and post\-meeting follow\-ups, may assist with the preparation of materials for speaking engagements and presentations.
* Updates and maintains a list of critical contacts; prepares and edits correspondence, reports, and presentations.
* Makes travel arrangements and manages travel reimbursements.
* Sorting and filing mail for Exec Office and General Counsel, assist with Chair Correspondence.
* Provides backup administrative support to fellow Executive Assistant’s as needed within the Executive Office
* Manages special projects and initiatives as assigned by supervisor, and or executive team.
* Perform administrative duties for Employee Engagement Program.
* Provide coverage to Reception Desk as needed.


  

Authorization to work in the United States is required for this position. The NYC Department of City Planning does not offer sponsorship, of any kind, for any type of employment opportunity. Applicants are responsible for ensuring that they meet all minimum qualifying requirements for this position at the time of application.  

  

Only applicants under consideration will be contacted. Appointments are subject to Office of Management and Budget (OMB) approval.  

  

NOTE: If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation during your visit or have questions regarding the accessibility of our facilities, please reach out to accessibilityinfo@planning.nyc.gov or call 212\-720\-3508 at least three business days prior to your arrival.

A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and three years of satisfactory full\-time progressively responsible clerical/administrative experience, one year of which must have been in an administrative capacity or supervising staff performing clerical/administrative work of more than moderate difficulty; or  

2\. An associate degree or 60 semester credits from an accredited college and four years of satisfactory full\-time progressively responsible clerical/administrative experience including one year of the administrative supervisory experience described in "1" above; or  

3\. A four\-year high school diploma or its educational equivalent approved by a State's department of education or a recognized accrediting organization and five years of satisfactory full\-time progressively responsible clerical/administrative experience including one year of the administrative supervisory experience as described in "1" above;  

4\. Education and/or experience equivalent to "1", "2", or "3" above. However, all candidates must possess the one year of administrative or supervisory experience as described in "1" above. Education above the high school level may be substituted for the general clerical/administrative experience (but not for the one year of administrative or supervisory experience described in "1" above) at a rate of 30 semester credits from an accredited college for 6 months of experience up to a maximum of 3½ years.

new_jobs.title: MEP Assistant Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Batska Consulting Group is a dynamic team of skilled engineers, architects, and construction management professionals with vast experience in project management, design, commissioning, and construction across diverse fields such as Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, Fire Protection, Fire Alarm, and Architecture. Our team serves prestigious Healthcare, Higher Education, and public institutions throughout the tristate area.

  

We are currently seeking a dedicated and skilled MEP Assistant Project Manager to join our team. The MEP Assistant Project Manager will support the Project Manager in the coordination and management of MEP systems throughout all phases of a project. This role requires a solid understanding of MEP construction, project management processes, and the ability to effectively coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal project teams.

  

Duties and Responsibilities:

* Demonstrate a clear understanding of MEP construction drawings, specifications, and project documentation.
* Assist in reviewing and interpreting Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, Fire Protection, and Fire Alarm drawings, specifications, and submission requirements.
* Support the Project Manager in identifying potential coordination issues, scope gaps, constructability concerns, and conflicts between MEP systems and architectural or structural components.
* Assist with coordination between MEP design consultants, contractors, subcontractors, vendors, and field installation teams.
* Support the management of RFIs, submittals, equipment schedules, material lead times, change orders, and other MEP project documentation.
* Assist with project forecasting, budgets, schedules, and scope tracking through project management software.
* Participate in MEP coordination meetings, prepare meeting minutes, track action items, and follow up on outstanding issues and resolutions.
* Assist with the development of MEP bid packages and procurement of proposals in accordance with client policies and procurement requirements.
* Support client and stakeholder communication throughout the project, including progress updates and coordination related to MEP systems.
* Assist in identifying potential project risks, including system outages, shutdowns, sequencing issues, and existing\-condition conflicts, and contribute to mitigation strategies.
* Assist in developing and maintaining project schedules, including phased MEP implementation plans that accommodate active building operations and minimize disruptions.
* Conduct site visits and assist with field verification of existing MEP conditions, installation progress, and coordination requirements.
* Maintain accurate project records and documentation and ensure timely distribution of project information to relevant stakeholders.
* Support the Project Manager with overall project coordination, administration, and successful execution of MEP\-related scopes.

  

Essential Skills and Abilities:

  

* Strong understanding of MEP systems and the ability to review and comprehend MEP construction drawings and reports.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with clients, consultants, contractors, and subcontractors.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities concurrently.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proactive and solutions\-oriented work ethic.
* Ability to identify coordination issues and contribute to practical solutions related to MEP systems and project implementation.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Project or Primavera P6, Microsoft Office Suite, and Bluebeam.
* Familiarity with MEP coordination software such as Navisworks or Revit is a plus.
* Ability to understand the integration of MEP systems with architectural and structural components, with a focus on constructability, sequencing, and coordination.
* Ability to work effectively in active and occupied facilities where project phasing and coordination are critical.

  

Required Education \& Experience:

  

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Construction Management.
* 3–5 years of relevant construction industry experience with exposure to MEP systems and project coordination.
* Preferably experienced in healthcare, higher education, institutional, or infrastructure construction projects.
* Experience working in active or occupied facilities and coordinating MEP upgrades or renovations is a plus.

  

At Batska Consulting Group, we prioritize your health, financial security, and professional growth. Join our team and enjoy benefits such as comprehensive health insurance, a 401(k)\-retirement plan, generous paid time off, professional development assistance, and more.

  

Salary: $70,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a **full\-time Project Coordinator** to support our project and proposal teams with the administrative and technical coordination of industrial construction projects.

This position will assist with project documentation, construction schedules, progress billing, change orders, cost estimating, material procurement, subcontractor coordination, and project closeout activities.

The ideal candidate is organized, detail\-oriented, comfortable working with construction documents, and able to communicate effectively in both **Korean and English**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support daily and weekly project progress reporting and maintain project schedules and documentation.
* Assist with reviewing piping drawings, including **AutoCAD drawings, P\&IDs, and isometric drawings**.
* Prepare and assist with **material take\-offs (MTOs)** and quantity calculations.

new_jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced, well\-connected **Outreach Coordinator** to join our growing outpatient behavioral health and substance abuse treatment program in **Chamblee, Georgia**.

This is **not a traditional entry\-level marketing position**. We are looking for someone who already knows the local healthcare, behavioral health, and substance abuse treatment community and has **established professional relationships and referral connections throughout the Atlanta area**.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of developing referral relationships and will be comfortable getting out into the community, meeting with referral sources, and creating new opportunities for our program.

What You'll Do

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective referral sources throughout the Atlanta metropolitan area
* Leverage established professional relationships within the behavioral health, substance abuse, healthcare, and community services sectors
* Conduct regular in\-person visits with referral sources and community partners
* Build relationships with hospitals, detox and residential treatment programs, therapists, psychiatrists, physicians, private practices, case managers, social workers, EAPs, attorneys, community organizations, and other appropriate referral partners
* Introduce referral sources to our outpatient programs, services, admission process, and treatment philosophy
* Identify and pursue new referral opportunities
* Represent our organization at networking events, professional meetings, conferences, community events, and other outreach opportunities
* Maintain consistent communication and follow\-up with referral partners
* Collaborate closely with Admissions and Clinical leadership to ensure a smooth referral experience
* Track outreach activity, referral relationships, and results
* Monitor the local behavioral health market and identify opportunities for growth
* Provide leadership with feedback regarding referral trends, community needs, competitors, and potential partnerships

What We're Looking For

**We are specifically looking for someone who already has relationships in the Atlanta behavioral health and substance abuse community.**

The ideal candidate will:

* Have established professional connections throughout the Atlanta behavioral health and/or healthcare community
* Be familiar with treatment providers and referral networks in the **Chamblee, Brookhaven, Dunwoody, Sandy Springs, Buckhead, Atlanta, and surrounding areas**
* Understand how behavioral health and substance abuse referrals move through the local healthcare system
* Have a proven history of successful community outreach, business development, or referral development
* Be comfortable making face\-to\-face visits and developing relationships with referral sources
* Be outgoing, confident, professional, and highly self\-motivated
* Have excellent communication and relationship\-building skills
* Be able to work independently while maintaining strong communication with the internal team
* Understand the importance of confidentiality, HIPAA, and ethical referral practices

Qualifications

* Minimum of **2 years of experience in behavioral health, substance abuse treatment, healthcare outreach, business development, admissions, or a related field**
* **Established Atlanta\-area referral relationships strongly preferred**
* Existing relationships with hospitals, treatment providers, therapists, physicians, mental health professionals, or other behavioral health referral sources highly desirable
* Bachelor's degree preferred but not required with relevant experience
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation required
* Ability to travel throughout the Atlanta metropolitan area on a regular basis
* Strong organizational and follow\-through skills
* Experience using CRM or referral\-tracking systems preferred

This Position Is For You If...

You already know the Atlanta behavioral health landscape.

You know who the major treatment providers are. You know the therapists, hospitals, discharge planners, social workers, case managers, and other professionals who make referrals. You know how to get a meeting, how to maintain a relationship, and how to turn a professional connection into a trusted referral partnership.

If you have an established network and enjoy being the person who knows **who to call, where to go, and how to get the conversation started**, we'd like to meet you.

Why Join Us?

You'll have the opportunity to help grow a new and expanding outpatient behavioral health program while making a meaningful impact in the community.

We are looking for someone who can **hit the ground running** and bring both experience and relationships to the role.

**If you already have a strong Atlanta\-area behavioral health network, we want to hear from you.**

* Excellent communication skills (verbal and written)

* Must be detail\-oriented and highly organized

**Account Executive / Sales Representative**
============================================

**Location:** Atlanta, GA  

**Job Type:** Full\-Time

**About Primary Vascular Care**
-------------------------------


Primary Vascular Care is a specialized vascular group dedicated exclusively to serving the long\-term care community. We bring a clinic\-like experience directly into skilled nursing and long\-term care facilities, providing comprehensive vascular care at the patient's bedside.


By delivering personalized, high\-quality care in a familiar environment, we reduce the need for unnecessary transportation while ensuring patients receive timely evaluations, treatments, and advanced vascular procedures. Our mission is to improve patient outcomes through exceptional clinical care and strong partnerships with the facilities we serve.

**Position Summary**
--------------------


Primary Vascular Care is seeking an experienced, driven, and relationship\-focused **Account Executive / Sales Representative** to support the continued growth of our services throughout the Atlanta market.


This is a dual\-role position that combines business development with account management and operational coordination. The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying and developing new facility partnerships while ensuring existing accounts receive exceptional support and operational oversight.


Success in this role requires someone who is proactive, highly organized, and comfortable building relationships with nursing home administrators, Directors of Nursing, Social Workers, Case Managers, and other healthcare professionals. The ideal candidate understands that growing an account goes beyond making the sale—it also means helping ensure our services are implemented successfully and that ongoing operations run smoothly between our clinical team and partner facilities.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Identify, prospect, and develop new long\-term care facility partnerships within the assigned territory.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with facility administrators, Directors of Nursing, Social Workers, Case Managers, and other key decision\-makers.
* Present Primary Vascular Care's services and educate facilities on the benefits of bedside vascular care.
* Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting through contract execution and successful onboarding.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, ensuring a high level of client satisfaction.
* Coordinate with internal clinical and operational teams to ensure seamless scheduling, communication, and service delivery.
* Monitor account performance, proactively resolve issues, and identify opportunities to strengthen facility relationships.
* Assist with operational initiatives to support efficient clinic workflows and successful implementation of services.
* Maintain accurate documentation of sales activities, account interactions, and business development efforts.
* Represent Primary Vascular Care professionally at networking events, facility meetings, and industry functions.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in sales, business development, account management, healthcare operations, or a related client\-facing role.
* Experience working with healthcare providers, long\-term care facilities, home health, hospice, physician groups, or medical sales is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to generate new business while maintaining long\-term client relationships.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Self\-motivated, results\-driven, and comfortable working independently.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and CRM systems.
* **Valid driver's license, reliable personal vehicle, and willingness to travel throughout the assigned territory are required.**

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base salary with performance\-based bonus incentives.
* 401(k) retirement plan.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Comprehensive onboarding and ongoing training.
* Supportive, collaborative, and mission\-driven team environment.
* The opportunity to make a meaningful impact by improving access to specialized vascular care for patients in long\-term care facilities.


If you are passionate about building relationships, driving business growth, and ensuring operational excellence while making a difference in healthcare, we encourage you to apply and join the Primary Vascular Care team.

**Customer Success Manager**  

Daybreak Health \| 100% Remote \| Full\-time


**About the role**  

You'll own a portfolio of 50\+ school districts and make sure they launch fast, run smoothly, and keep referring students. Your people are counselors, social workers, and school admin. Your job is to get them equipped and excited to send kids to care. This is execution at scale: technical onboarding, staff training, troubleshooting, adoption campaigns, and data analysis, with AI and internal tools handling the repetitive parts so you spend your time with people instead of building workflows from scratch. When you do this well, more kids get help.



**About Daybreak Health**



Daybreak partners with school districts to make sure any student who needs mental health care can actually get it. The gap we're closing is real: the recommended ratio is one school psychologist per 500 students, and the national reality is closer to one per 1,200, which means families wait months while counselors carry impossible caseloads. We match every student to a clinician based on language, culture, identity, and what they're actually working through, usually starting care within a week or two of a referral and at no cost to the family. It works. 81% of students improve on standardized clinical measures, 92% of families report meaningful behavioral change at home, and 80% of school staff see better attendance, grades, and behavior. **We're backed by Union Square Ventures, Lux Capital, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Maven Ventures, and Y Combinator**, and we already serve districts representing more than a million students. That still leaves most of the country without an answer, which is exactly where this role comes in.



**What you'll do**


* Lead district onboarding, staff activation, and dashboard training
* Troubleshoot account access, referral submissions, and scope questions, with white\-glove support for strategic districts
* Run staff trainings and info sessions that get people genuinely bought in
* Build training capacity models across your cohort so you can flag capacity risk before it turns into a launch delay
* Set the support and engagement strategy per district, with real autonomy to choose the approach
* Execute adoption campaigns: campus visits, email outreach, webinars, data\-driven interventions
* Find creative ways to reach teachers and parents, not just counselors and admin
* Watch leading indicators like non\-contributor district rates and escalate a rising rate as a structural signal, not a seasonal dip
* Turn district data into action, and keep your portfolio documented in shared tools so your work compounds for the team
* Use AI to build personalized training decks, campaigns, and district talk tracks, then apply your own judgment on context and tone
* Use AI to review activation pacing and referral trend lines so you can spend more human time on the districts that need it
* Bring what you learn to weekly GTM meetings, where AI fluency is a shared practice rather than a personal hack


**Skills**


* District and campus onboarding and implementation
* Live training and facilitation for adult learners
* Adoption and engagement campaign execution
* Project management across many concurrent launches
* Data analysis and simple modeling (capacity, pacing, funnel)
* Independent technical troubleshooting
* Practical AI fluency for drafting, analysis, and pattern\-spotting
* Cross\-functional collaboration
* Strong written and verbal communication
* Documentation in shared tools (Notion, Google Docs and Slides)


**Who thrives here**


* Great communicator and idea generator
* Natural problem\-solver who figures things out without being handed the answer
* Connects dots across teams, products, and initiatives
* Knows when to jump in and help and when to hold people accountable
* Takes pride in support so fast and pleasant it creates champions
* Scrappy and adaptable, comfortable in constant startup change
* Sees AI as a way to do more of the job well, not a shortcut around the judgment parts

### **Qualifications**



Must\-haves


* Experience in EdTech, education, or healthcare partnerships, product support, and enablement
* K\-12 background
* Track record driving adoption at scale, think 100\+ customers and thousands of end users
* Strong project management across multiple launches at different phases
* Tech savvy: picks up new systems fast, troubleshoots independently, uses AI tools daily
* Exceptional organization across deadlines and deliverables
* Self\-starter who sees what needs to happen and makes it happen
* Strong written and verbal communication
* Comfortable turning data into insight, including building simple models


Nice\-to\-haves


* Experience with mental health or SEL products
* Previous work inside a K\-12 district or on a campus
* Salesforce or similar CRM experience

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. All full\-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

  

  

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

**About the Role:**



As a Dedicated Service Advisor, you will act as the single point of contact for all support inquiries, enhancing their user experience and serving as a subject matter expert for Gusto's core products. You will guide customers through our newest product features, provide proactive customer education and support, partner cross\-functionally, move quickly to strategize and creatively solve problems, act as their advocate internally to influence our product decisions and roadmap, and holistically support the customer/Gusto partnership. **Customer Success Manager**  

Daybreak Health \| 100% Remote \| Full\-time


**About the role**  

You'll own a portfolio of 50\+ school districts and make sure they launch fast, run smoothly, and keep referring students. Your people are counselors, social workers, and school admin. Your job is to get them equipped and excited to send kids to care. This is execution at scale: technical onboarding, staff training, troubleshooting, adoption campaigns, and data analysis, with AI and internal tools handling the repetitive parts so you spend your time with people instead of building workflows from scratch. When you do this well, more kids get help.



**About Daybreak Health**



Daybreak partners with school districts to make sure any student who needs mental health care can actually get it. The gap we're closing is real: the recommended ratio is one school psychologist per 500 students, and the national reality is closer to one per 1,200, which means families wait months while counselors carry impossible caseloads. We match every student to a clinician based on language, culture, identity, and what they're actually working through, usually starting care within a week or two of a referral and at no cost to the family. It works. 81% of students improve on standardized clinical measures, 92% of families report meaningful behavioral change at home, and 80% of school staff see better attendance, grades, and behavior. **We're backed by Union Square Ventures, Lux Capital, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Maven Ventures, and Y Combinator**, and we already serve districts representing more than a million students. That still leaves most of the country without an answer, which is exactly where this role comes in.



**What you'll do**


* Lead district onboarding, staff activation, and dashboard training
* Troubleshoot account access, referral submissions, and scope questions, with white\-glove support for strategic districts
* Run staff trainings and info sessions that get people genuinely bought in
* Build training capacity models across your cohort so you can flag capacity risk before it turns into a launch delay
* Set the support and engagement strategy per district, with real autonomy to choose the approach
* Execute adoption campaigns: campus visits, email outreach, webinars, data\-driven interventions
* Find creative ways to reach teachers and parents, not just counselors and admin
* Watch leading indicators like non\-contributor district rates and escalate a rising rate as a structural signal, not a seasonal dip
* Turn district data into action, and keep your portfolio documented in shared tools so your work compounds for the team
* Use AI to build personalized training decks, campaigns, and district talk tracks, then apply your own judgment on context and tone
* Use AI to review activation pacing and referral trend lines so you can spend more human time on the districts that need it
* Bring what you learn to weekly GTM meetings, where AI fluency is a shared practice rather than a personal hack


**Skills**


* District and campus onboarding and implementation
* Live training and facilitation for adult learners
* Adoption and engagement campaign execution
* Project management across many concurrent launches
* Data analysis and simple modeling (capacity, pacing, funnel)
* Independent technical troubleshooting
* Practical AI fluency for drafting, analysis, and pattern\-spotting
* Cross\-functional collaboration
* Strong written and verbal communication
* Documentation in shared tools (Notion, Google Docs and Slides)


**Who thrives here**


* Great communicator and idea generator
* Natural problem\-solver who figures things out without being handed the answer
* Connects dots across teams, products, and initiatives
* Knows when to jump in and help and when to hold people accountable
* Takes pride in support so fast and pleasant it creates champions
* Scrappy and adaptable, comfortable in constant startup change
* Sees AI as a way to do more of the job well, not a shortcut around the judgment parts

### **Qualifications**



Must\-haves


* Experience in EdTech, education, or healthcare partnerships, product support, and enablement
* K\-12 background
* Track record driving adoption at scale, think 100\+ customers and thousands of end users
* Strong project management across multiple launches at different phases
* Tech savvy: picks up new systems fast, troubleshoots independently, uses AI tools daily
* Exceptional organization across deadlines and deliverables
* Self\-starter who sees what needs to happen and makes it happen
* Strong written and verbal communication
* Comfortable turning data into insight, including building simple models


Nice\-to\-haves


* Experience with mental health or SEL products
* Previous work inside a K\-12 district or on a campus
* Salesforce or similar CRM experience

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Chicago, IL, USA; Los Angeles, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* High School Diploma, GED equivalent, or practical experience.
